themes.label: Excessive ads flooding main feed
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say ads now make up a large share of the home feed and search results, often every other pin or more, with many ads being carousels that take several swipes to pass. Several reviewers also mention AI-generated pins and inappropriate or sexual ad content mixed in, and some say they now misclick ads or have stopped using the app.
themes.recommendation: Pull ad-to-organic-pin ratio data by surface (home feed, search, boards) and app version for the last 12 months, then set and enforce a maximum ad density per scroll window, with a test that measures session length and churn against the current rate.

themes.label: Excessive ads flooding feed
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say ad density has grown so high that ads outnumber organic pins, with some reporting roughly one ad in every two to three items and ads appearing in their own boards and during searches. Many also tie this to AI-generated content and irrelevant or repeated ads, and several say they are considering uninstalling or switching to alternatives. Several recent reviews reference app version 14.x, suggesting the increase may have followed a recent update.
themes.recommendation: Audit ad load per feed, search, and board surface against the prior baseline (especially releases from v14.24 onward), set a hard cap on consecutive ads, and ship a user-facing control to reduce or hide ads that is tested for effectiveness, since current opt-outs for auto-play ads and ads in boards are reported as broken.

themes.label: Unwanted UI changes and feature removals
themes.summary: Long-time iOS users say recent updates keep removing or relocating familiar features, such as the All Pins view, the board save picker, section handling, and swipe navigation, often without announcement. They also complain about the "More ideas" section appearing first when opening their own boards and about heavy ad and shopping content being pushed into their feeds and profiles. Many describe the app as frustrating despite still liking Pinterest overall.
themes.recommendation: Audit the last several iOS releases against a changelog of removed or relocated features (All Pins, board picker on save, section creation, swipe-to-exit, "More ideas" placement on own boards), then restore or make configurable the most-cited ones, starting with a settings toggle to hide "More ideas" in users' own boards.

themes.label: AI moderation falsely flags saved pins
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say Pinterest's automated moderation is removing or deactivating pins they only saved, often for categories like adult content, self-harm, or copyright that don't fit the pin, such as art, eyes, plushies, and fandom or romance images. Many say they receive violation notices without being shown which pin triggered them, and the appeal process feels pointless, leading some to fear losing accounts with thousands of pins. Frustration with heavy ads and AI-generated content in feeds runs alongside these complaints.
themes.recommendation: Audit the automated moderation classifier's false-positive rate on saved (non-creator) pins, prioritizing self-harm and adult-content labels, and ship a change so violation notices identify the exact pin and attach it to the original uploader rather than the saver.

themes.label: AI slop and ads flooding feed
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say their Pinterest feeds are dominated by AI-generated images, recipes, and tutorials plus heavy ad load, even after turning off the AI-related settings. Many feel the AI toggles do not work, and they want a way to block or report AI content specifically, especially for art, references, and DIY content where accuracy matters.
themes.recommendation: Audit the 'GenAI' and AI-content filter settings end to end on Android v14.2x to v14.35 to verify they actually suppress AI-labelled pins in home and search feeds, and add a dedicated 'Report as AI-generated' option plus a per-topic AI block that is tested against a sample of flagged pins.

themes.label: Frequent crashes, offline errors, and load failures
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS, mostly on recent app versions (v14.2x to v14.36), report the app freezing, crashing, or falsely showing an offline or "something went wrong" message even on fast Wi-Fi, with boards, search, and pins failing to load until the app is force-closed and reopened. Several say support only suggests reinstalling, which doesn't fix it. Many describe this as a steady decline over the last year or two rather than a single bad release.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and network-error logs segmented by app version (v14.24 through v14.36) and Android device model, and test the offline-detection logic on stable Wi-Fi to find why connectivity is reported as lost and why search and board loading stall after backgrounding.

themes.label: Frequent freezing and crashes in app
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report the app freezing mid-scroll or on a pin, going blank or unresponsive, and losing their place when they force-close and reopen. Several mention freezes after saving a pin, after swiping down on the home feed, or after a recent update, and some say restarting the phone or reinstalling does not help. Many reviewers frame this as part of a broader decline alongside ads, AI features, and unwanted changes.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and freeze telemetry from the last several app versions (especially 12.x through 14.x) segmented by iOS and Android, identify the screens and actions preceding freezes (pin view, save, home feed swipe-down), and prioritize a fix with a regression test covering those flows; also check whether the app restores scroll position and the open pin after a relaunch.

themes.label: Praise: inspiration and idea saving
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster are enthusiastic praise for Pinterest as a source of inspiration across recipes, fashion, decor, DIY and creative projects, with users specifically valuing how easily they save ideas to boards. The cluster is mostly positive but includes a minority of older reviews from 2019 to 2025 that mention ads, shopping and video content crowding out saved pins, and a few complaints about board navigation and freezing.
themes.recommendation: Protect the board save and organize flow that users praise most, and audit whether ads, shopping modules and video pins are displacing saved-board content for users who open a board, since that complaint recurs across lower-rated reviews.

themes.label: Accounts deactivated without explanation or appeal
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android report their long-standing Pinterest accounts were suddenly deactivated or suspended, often for vague reasons like spam, community guidelines, or copyright claims tied to saved pins rather than uploads. Many say appeals go unanswered or get only automated replies, and some lost years of boards and pins with no way to recover them or create a new account on the same email.
themes.recommendation: Audit the automated account-enforcement pipeline for false positives on saved (re-pinned) content, and add a human review queue with a guaranteed response time for appeals, including a recovery path for accounts deactivated in the last 12 months.

themes.label: Excessive ads and AI content
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say ads now appear nearly as often as pins, with some seeing them every other image or in clusters of three or four, and many also complain about unwanted AI-generated images even after turning the AI feature off. Several long-time users say the app felt simpler and more inspiring before, and a few say they are considering leaving. The complaints are mostly about feed quality and ad density rather than any single bug.
themes.recommendation: Audit ad frequency and clustering in the home and search feeds by app version (v14.2x to v14.36), and verify that the 'see fewer AI pins' setting is honored across all feed surfaces, then ship a fix and track ad-to-pin ratio and AI-content complaints.

reviews.t: This app raised me and I’m so so so angry at its changes.
reviews.x: I hate the ads. I hate them. I hate them. I have never been glad Pinterest advertised a million things to me when I searched for something stylistically inspiring. I cannot stop my blood from boiling at all the AI. If people wanted AI art inspo, they could make it themselves. Pinterest is not the freaking place. It’s not. It’s not. The pins the site is removing for “adult content” are the reason for why I know how to draw, even if the muscles I learned to draw came from statues of women who had swimsuits on instead of thick cardigans. Pinterest doesn’t need to remove all this “adult content” from its site because the users are freaking adults. And even if they weren’t, the “adult content” it’s removing didn’t scar me when I was 14, it taught me to draw. If I became 14 again suddenly and re-visited Pinterest to try learning to draw again, I’d be eternally stunted because all my sources would be gone. And not just for drawing…. For so many (female) outfits, silly comics, memes, recipes, writing tips. These things are being removed to appeal to the social panopticon, not to save people’s innocence and sanity. Plus people don’t need to be unconditionally innocent forever. Adults use this app. Let them encounter new information. Let them see an anime girl in a swimsuit, posing so that the artist who drew her can draw green arrows twisting around her bent elbow to show the viewer what a bent elbow looks like. Nobody’s been saved from some sort of visceral trauma just because Pinterest said a tube top on a mannequin is evil.

reviews.t: NOT SAFE FOR CHILDREN - Developers Are Incompetent
reviews.x: Check r/Pinterest to know how people really feel about this app. I have been using Pinterest for over 10 years, and my account currently stands at 7k followers. I have never been so disappointed, so disgusted, and so angered by a company’s attempts to run its own creation into the ground. With every update, there are a slew of glitches and disgustingly ugly UI changes forced upon users who have been BEGGING for the exact opposite FOR YEARS NOW. Every update increases the amount of ads on screen, now including: full-screen pop-up videos that prevent you from saving the pins you click on + crash the app, INCREDIBLY EXPLICIT and/or AI-generated advertisements, and tons of other app-breaking nonsense. Pinterest is definitively no longer safe for children to use, given the amount of sexually explicit advertising being allowed by the development team. Pinterest used to be a space for creatives. What made Pinterest special, what attracted its massive user base, was its creative and unique approach to social media. Now, it seems like the development team wants Pinterest to function only as a glorified browser window, resigned to cycle through endless Temu products before flashing you with the most morally depraved, AI-generated piece of content you’ve seen in your entire life. Heart. Breaking. Dis. Gusting.

can you please implement a button to remove specifically the haptics/vibrations. I know there is a button that allegedly controls sound but I cannot seem to disable them even in my phone’s settings and they can be really inconvenient and loud. also I remember in the 2010s it was so much easier to find people to follow/get followers. I can’t remember exactly what changed but it’s a bit of a struggle now. even using the proper tags it’s nearly impossible to get any reach. also I dislike that now when you search for something, your search is no longer displayed at the top of the screen while you scroll. I often get confused when I click on a pin and then want to return to my original search because I can’t tell if I’m still in the offshoot of a pin or on the original search page. When I organize my boards it doesn’t actually register for a long period of time. ONE LAST THING, I think your AI detection is insanely bugged. So many posts getting removed and comment sections disabled because the AI is too stupid to properly analyze what it’s looking at. thanks! <3

The people giving this app five stars are either paid or fake. I have watched this app decline so sharply, it’s astounding. I’ve been using Pinterest since 2012, and it quickly became my favorite app. I used it to help plan my wedding in 2014, I’ve found some of my favorite recipes that I use to this day, I used it to come up with ideas for a nursery, and then to start homeschooling in 2019. I’ve always used it as inspiration for whatever project I’m working on; paint, house, random DIY. Years ago I would leave 5 star reviews every time because I got so much out of the app. Now? It’s more like wading through a swamp to find anything worthwhile at all. I cannot believe this has happened to my Pinterest. It used to be so full of life and ideas! Now it’s full of ads and AI garbage. Searches only lead to more ads, and most of the time the results are not even related to what you typed in the search bar. The ads outnumber the actual posts about 10 to 1, maybe more. The app no longer feels like the escape it once was…it just feels like a continuation of the rest of the world. It no longer reflects true creators, it’s just another dead-eyed machine.

Pinterest is such a creative and inspiring platform. It allows you to make your experience truly your own. I enjoy how you can combine different photos, ideas, colors, styles, and aesthetics to create a vision that represents exactly what you have in mind. It’s more than just an app for saving pictures; it’s a place where you can explore your creativity, discover new interests, develop your personal style, and bring ideas to life that you may not have known how to express before. I especially love how it helps you visualize your goals and dreams by turning thoughts and inspiration into something you can actually see. Whether you’re planning your future, designing a space, finding your style, or simply looking for inspiration, Pinterest makes it easier to imagine the possibilities and turn those visions into reality. It encourages you to think outside the box, trust your creativity, and create a life that reflects who you are and who you want to become. Pinterest truly makes inspiration come to life!

I love this app. It’s perfect for any project I’ve worked on HOWEVER, and I’m not exaggerating, I’ve scrolled past TEN ads in a ROW followed by two pins, then eight more ads when looking for similar content to a pin. It’s no longer easy to look for related content after the initial post and is insanely saturated with ads. That being said, I’m glad they added sections for boards because it makes it so much easier to organize. I also love that you’re able to collaborate with other people. The search has recommendations based on what you like and what’s popular in general which can be helpful when you’re in a creative rut. Also, if it has anything to do with makeup or hair it will have skin tone and hair texture options which is amazing. However, after you search something it can have a ton of ads at the top of the results with an option to shop. That can be a pro or con though. I do LOVE the community and how the app doesn’t value comments and likes as much as others do. I think that’s a really healthy aspect of social media that Pinterest embodies.

I absolutely love Pinterest, I don't know what I'd do without it. I use it every second of the day for making aesthetic boards for my over 30 ocs and fandoms I'm in. I adore it. But I've been having trouble using it for on the smaller end of a month now. Anytime I load in it shows me a max of 5 pins minus ads. And it wont let me scroll unless I click multiple pins and wait till it loads by itself. Sometimes it can take up to 3 minutes to load. And it can crash or reset very easily which causes me to have to wait for it to load again. This had been happening for a very long while, as I said almost a month now. And no update has helped or fixed it. It's not my internet and it's not my iPad itself. Everything else works perfectly except Pinterest. Today I've deleted it and re downloaded it after the new update because it STILL wasn't loading. And now it won't load at all. It barely gets past the Pinterest logo loading screen. And if it does its just endless loading. I love Pinterest and I would hate to have to stop using it because of this but. But honestly I'm so exhausted with this app because of it. I have been using Pinterest for almost 3 years now. And I'm feeling like I might have to cut ties and delete it because it's just too laggy and glitchy. Not to mention all the ads and ai inside the app. I hope you see this and I hope you fix this.

reviews.t: Like I downloaded a virus or something
reviews.x: Start by saying I love Pinterest. I’ve been using Pinterest for years. I think it’s the best form of social media. It’s a great place to share and save ideas. That being said the increase of ads on this app is absolutely insane. I literally can barely scroll at all or find something. I’m looking forward without accidentally clicking on now. It takes me application and slow down my phone. It is so annoying that I’ve stopped using it as much because instead of being excited about the next crochet project I’m going to make more recipe. I’m going to say I’m overwhelmed with an existential dread of what the world has come to. We can’t even share ideas online anymore, without there being the constant harassment of trying to buy our attention. I love to browse art from smaller artists on Pinterest. But I swear to God just today I was scrolling through looking at beautiful paintings and I scrolled through seven hours in a row. This is absolutely insane. Imagine you were at an art gallery and seven people walk up to you trying to sell you some absolutely ridiculous product. I used to love Pinterest because It felt like it was immune to this push to make the most addicting app possible. Looks like they meet up for it by dozens of ads per scroll.

reviews.t: It’s great, but then isn’t. All at one
reviews.x: The variety of pictures are amazing. The updated categories help you find what you need more efficiently. Clean layout. Fresh ideas. Yada yada. However the amount of adverts is OUT OF CONTROL. If I get 20 regular pictures I get 15-25 ads in between. So I’m literally opening the app to look at 50% ads. Insane. Make Pinterest premium, I would pay $10 a month to get rid of it all. ALSO everything is getting reported. Seemingly normal pins that I pinned months ago get reported and I get a violation. I have tens of thousands of pins. So why put the pins up for months. Why is copyright infringement a violation for ME. Some say child safety but it’s hard to tell a late teen from early twenties in a face full of makeup. Bikini photos are allowed but also reported. Photos of thin / model-like women are also frequently reported for disordered behavior. Healthy small meals too. Certain words in a pin - even if small can be reported like in a collage. And they’re taken down + invisible to me before I can even appeal. Also the boards are sensitive to certain words. I can’t search up the word “girl” in the search engine. Or use the word “hot” or “girl” in my boards without it being locked from additional ideas. Sometimes the boards just randomly lock, then unlock because apparently what’s inside is inappropriate (?) but why even put it up if they’re not being reviewed. Then deleting them & sending violations when thousands have already saved them. Please fix this app.

reviews.t: This app is a shell of its former self
reviews.x: I use to love Pinterest and now I hate it. I’ve had Pinterest since I was a high schooler, I am now in my late 20’s. I use to use it on a regular basis but now, I can barely use it for longer than 2 minutes before I start getting mad and just swipe out of the app because of the infinite amount of ads! For every 2 pins there’s 3-4 ads that immediately follow which completely defeats the purpose of going on Pinterest. It’s also just unrealistic af! This economy is trash, people barely have money to buy gas and groceries; let alone bs from Pinterest ads. The last thing people want to do at the end of their work or school day is scroll on Pinterest and have 16 ads telling them to SPEND MORE MONEY than they already do on basic necessities! You can’t even eat a fortune cookie without there being an ad shoved down your throat (I’ve literally had a fortune cookie with an ad in it as a “fortune”) people deserve to go somewhere without being negged to spend money. Also Pinterest is big enough of a company to not need this many ads on their app, they use to function perfectly fine with less ads when I was in high school so it feels like they’re literally doing this out of greed which I hate. Lastly I hate the integrated Ai in the app; what’s the point of giving us the option to turn off Ai pins only to integrate Ai into the app itself? I hate when companies give their consumers the “illusion of choice” and hope no one notices. Nope we always do. Anyways that’s my rant, Pinterest is no longer the app it use to be and I hate that because it was amazing.

Take away the ads, or put them on their own tab away from the home feed and our personal boards. I HATE seeing all these ads, and you’ve made it impossible to block them which is incredibly frustrating and annoying. Do something about this. Quality of this ap is going downhill fast with the introduction of more and more ads, some of which cannot be blocked like certain ads for games. It’s now becoming more of an ap for a collection of ads than a collection of interests and wasn’t that the whole point of Pinterest? Your header describes this app as “fashion, home design, and ideas”. Let’s keep it that simple and that way. The ads really take away from the ideas and inspiration that Pinterest was originally designed to be and I really miss that. I have no interest in ads especially when there are more ads than interests as you scroll down, much of them the same ad you have already seen 3 previous times at least. If you absolutely have to have ads on Pinterest for whatever reason you have them there, then at least have the curtesy to put them on their own page and only on that page so if someone wants to look at an ad for something they can make that choice. If you did that Pinterest would be better and you could take it further and let people choose what kind of ads they would prefer to see on the ad page. I’m sick and tired of seeing ads on the boards I have created, ads I don’t want on my boards. Please do something about this. It’s getting ridiculous and out of hand. Please take the Plague game app off Pinterest. It’s dark. It’s pornography and kids are likely to see it. I don’t want to see it, and I’m sure I’m not the only one. Please remove it.

reviews.t: Used to be great but now not so much
reviews.x: I’ve had the app for quite a while and love it. I get most my ideas and things for new hobby’s from there but anymore I’m constantly getting emails about being reported for copyrighting pins. I never repost pins claiming they are mine or anything else along those lines for anything to be considered copyrighted. As much as I love the app this is starting to get annoying especially when the whole point is sharing ideas, designs, etc. to make boards centered around them. Not only that but pins are constantly being taken down for supposedly violating guidelines even though most of the time they clearly are not. I’ve also been given strikes for saving a pin that was supposedly against guidelines even though I wasn’t the one who posted it which once again there was nothing violating the guidelines. I mean what about saving an image of a picture frame arrangement for an idea to hang my own pictures in my bedroom go against guidelines or copyright? If it’s not those two issues then it’s the insane amount of ads that’s progressively gotten worse over the months. You can’t even scroll two pins without a whole line of ads popping up before you even make it to anymore actual pins. I used to love this app but now it’s being more of a hassle to use than it is for its original purpose. Honestly I miss the old Pinterest when it was actually a good app.

reviews.t: Way to many ads and ai is starting to take over the entire app
reviews.x: I’ve been using Pinterest for a while and it has been going down hill fast recently. Many other people that I’ve talked to have agreed that the app is slowly becoming unusable. There are ads everywhere some even look like the pins so you click on them, and it almost feels like the app is pushing ai content. There is just so much ai and even the little trick to fix it only does so much. My biggest issue is the ads, they are even popping up on my saved areas which used to be my safe space from the add, and where I could peacefully look through the pins I liked. I am starting to think I should delete the app at this point. I used to love this app so much, and I still somewhat do, but there are more ads than pins and I just can’t get inspiration out of this app anymore. EDIT: It seems like the issue with tons of ads has been fixed for me. I am very happy that there are none on my personal boards, and there are less on the regular for you page. I am going from 3 to 5 stars, but I swear if it goes back to how it was in my original review I am giving it 1 star.

The whole idea of creating and sharing inspiration boards is amazing and useful, but trying to figure out how to do simple things (like copy a direct webpage link to a product instead of the pin link) that are usually highly intuitive on other apps and sites is just a headache here. It’s also now flooded with ads, AI content, and paywall links that make me not want to click on anything (I just add my own stuff and ignore anything else) because it’ll just lead to disappointing and annoyance. I think its current goal is just to feed doom-scrolling and offer clickbait rather than trying to genuinely inspire people and help them collaborate. It’s a bummer given how fun and useful this tool could be (which is how I’m assuming it was in the past). I already committed to using it for a current project, but once that’s done I’ll probably delete my account and try to find something else that’s designed better to gather and share ideas.

reviews.t: AI ruins everything Pinterest was for.
reviews.x: I’ve been on Pinterest since I was about 11- it was my very first social media experience and I immediately was charmed by it!! Seven years later- Pinterest is still my favorite social media because it felt to me like a creative escape from overconsumption. For most of my life I have used pinterest to help build my skills as an artist, find ideas for projects and fashion, read old tumblr posts, and generally cultivate a space that truly feels like my own. Pinterest is still my favorite social media- and is LEAGUES ahead of other platforms in terms of not being overstimulating- but as of late I’ve been struggling a bit due to ads on here becoming more and more prevalent, as well as AI generated images saturating the post-base on here. I miss when Pinterest felt like a quiet space for me to get inspired- as due to the factors i just mentioned, the app feels more and more like an advertisement. The increased AI presence on the app is demoralizing as well, because Pinterest- for me at least- has always been an incredible showcase of humanity and human creativity. AI robs pinterest of its humanity, and is actively harming the user base because AI models are being used to monitor content on the app- leading to unjust bans on users who haven’t actually violated Pinterest’s policies. With the most recent AI update I find myself using the app less and less. I do not want to admire an outfit and see an empty AI-generated criticism of human creativity. I hope the app can address this and maintain it’s human premise, as I would be heartbroken to watch Pinterest devolve into something soulless after so many years of it being the sole social media dedicated to the soul.
