Nothing was wrong with the old format. I hate having my viewing interruppted by that stupid banner over and over again. Please leave to format alone and let me decide when I scroll down to view more related pins.

I find myself using this app less and less everyday lately. which honestly breaks my heart because I used to use this app daily It was one of my favorites. but every time I go on here I get so many ads in my face it's a distraction from what I'm trying to focus on which is images and inspiration. It's really difficult to find inspiration for anything except shopping when I see constant Amazon ads. You've really disappointed me Pinterest. at least offer a way to pay to get rid of ads or something

ive been using pinterest for years, and i have a specific way of doing things, one board for all my fandoms, where I collect art. the new layout where you have to scroll horizontal to see all the sections, makes it hard to find anything anymore, when it used to be quick an easy, if youre going to change something to make it worse, at the very least add an option to keep the original formatting.

I love this app! ads are few and far between and you always have the option to just scroll by them if youd like. the one thing I dislike is that at times the search is hard to refine as it tends to show only the most viewed or liked pins but thats okay!!!

I had an account, under a different email, and they banned me this summer. I have never posted ANYTHING. They refused to tell me why I was banned, if maybe it was a comment, or the stupid glitch that shows that I posted a pin I really only saved. I had this account for 5 years. I re downloaded the app under a new account just to leave this review. Don't get this app if you like to know what you did wrong.

Whilst Pinterest used to be one of my favourite apps, the amount of adverts is overwhelming. Recently I've seen adverts which have been leading to scam websites. I understand that it's important for apps to make money and therefore have adverts, but this feels extreme. The amount of adverts I see is equivalent to the amount of pins, making them feel inescapable. Moreover, the places the adverts come from (ie. the scam websites) make Pinterest feel unsafe.

I've been using Pinterest for a long time, but this issue is incredibly frustrating. Comments on some of my posts keep getting turned off automatically, and even when I manually enable them again, they switch back off. There is no explanation, no warning, and no way to fix it. I enjoy interacting with people through comments and reading their feedback, but Pinterest keeps taking that away for no reason. My posts don't violate any rules, yet this keeps happening. Please fix this bug.

Pinterest was my favorite app for wallpapers, but removing the download option makes it far less useful. Instead of blocking everyone, you should let creators decide whether downloads are allowed. Most wallpapers are AI or widely shared, so a blanket restriction doesn’t make sense. If this continues, many users like me will stop opening the app and move to other platforms.

it's like if Tumblr and tiktok had a baby/neg. First of all everytime I open the app it looks different, PLEASE stop changing the layout. Second of all, way too many ads, I'm tired of seeing ads all the time. Third, when you make a new board and go try to save a pin it dosent show up on the list of boards, you need to save like 20 thousand things for it to show up. Fourth, moderation SUCKS. Considering there's a lot of kids here, moderation is so bad, please stop having AI moderate the site.

It's a beautiful app, I'll recommend it any day anytime. i have a suggestion, please make it possible to select multiple pins on the "all Pins" interface and delete them regardless of the board they're saved on. this would make it easy for anyone to curate their previously saved pins as their taste evolves over time

The app is absolute trash. Sometimes it's great for getting ideas, but it mostly bombards you with ads, AI slop even if you turn all that off in the settings, has links to blogs that are riddled with ads and if you happen to show even an inkling of interest in one post, your feed gets flooded with similar posts. Then if you scroll too much it'll start flooding your feed with things from the past you've shown interest in. If you do a search, your results will get get flooded with the same garbage

This used to be an amazing app for artist reference and various kinds of inspiration, however now there is nothing but ads and AI generated images. A filter was added to turn off AI generated images which helped, but these are really too many ads. Hiding each one is tedious. SDly this has gone downhill. I only keep it because of everything I have saved from years past.

I love Pinterest and have been using it for a long time, but I'm constantly facing the "Oops, something went wrong. Try again." error. The only temporary fix is uninstalling and reinstalling the app, but the problem always comes back after a few days or weeks. Email login often fails too, although Google login works. Please fix this issue - I really enjoy the app, but this recurring bug is very frustrating.

Your in-game ads are the absolute worst. First off, I already have (had?) Pinterest downloaded so it's like harrasing me to buy a cemetery plot for my own corpse after I already bought one. Second, after it shows the 30 second ad, it opens the Pintrest app and you have to leave and reopen the game you were already playing! I'll just buy a deck of cards and play Solitaire; no risk of the Jack of Clubs screaming at me to buy myself a second coffin!

I have since changed my opinion on the 5 stars. I do not like the automatic refresh it refreshes when I am looking at something else and go back to pin what I liked, even though I have turned off all AI I still get some that slip through the cracks. The ads are insane. Thank you and goodbye.

Edit: My original complaints from nearly 2 years ago on ads still apply, and if anything things have gotten worse. At this point there are more ads than actual pins, and a lot of the time I will find my entire screen being just ads instead of actual pins. I used to love pinterest and would tolerate some ads, but it is so unbearable now and very discouraging. The AI slop is also is frustrating - even with the settings turned to not recommended. The false violation flags are also annoying.

App is basically unusable with all the AI bs thats been added. Hate. It. I hate all of it. Can't even scroll on a post without it asking if I want to remix it. No, I'm actually just trying to read! The ads are out of control, and the majority of information is wrong. You can't even get inspiration without it being AI slop that is impossible to do anything with. I turned all AI options off, and it still gets through somehow. I also don't have the option to turn off the search privacy either!

I used to genuinely really love the app since its the main source for drawing references and moodboards. the only reason I rated it low is for its customer service. I've received no notice that my account was deactivated. I've only learnt it when I tried to sign in. I sent an appeal from them only to get a response that my account is permanently suspended because of "violating guidelines". Even though I havent uploaded nor save any pins that violated guidelines at all.

I keep getting this pop-up asking me to confirm my email every time I open the app and when I click confirm it says update in settings so I go to settings and it has the right email. then, not even a minute later, it asks the same thing again. and again. it was originally just mildly irritating but I even changed the email connected and it still does it so it's getting to a point that the app is unusable. I can't view anything because of this stupid pop-up that happens almost every minute.

before the last couple of updates the app used to be perfect. now I literally can't use it. It's beyond frustrating. always says I'm offline even when. switching to WiFi, or no user account. I can't attempt to create a new account or search anything. the app is absolutely useless point blank. Complete disappointment

Too many ads, like half the page is ads. And for some reason a bunch of purple themed items and wedding themed items keep popping up. I hate the color purple and I sure as hell don't plan on getting married soon. never searched for the stuff either. If I try and say to see less if it, it shows up even more. It's starting to get annoying. Edit: I am no longer using Pinterest. It's ridden with Ai and Ads. I'd rather just use Google to get craft ideas at this point. STOP WITH THE DAMN AI!!!!!!!

The app constantly removes all of my interests and instead shows me AI after stating I am not interested in AI content. My boards are constantly disappearing and I cannot bring them back no matter what. I also cannot search for any ideas without being shown ads and shopping links. It's annoying as heck.

It has too many bugs; lately when I log in, my folders don't appear, and all it shows are pictures of clothes, food, nails, landscapes, etc., normal things, but which have nothing to do with the type of pins I save; the content that should appear doesn't show up, and even though I search for and save pins on those topics, they still don't appear in the fyp, It just keeps showing content that has nothing to do with my interests, fix that.

Way WAY too many ads, so much so it's impossible to scroll two pins without hitting a new ad. Disgusting overrun of AI and not tuning the feed to not include it despite having a button specifically to turn it off- Oh, and by the way, NOT TUNING THE FEED AT ALL ANYMORE. The app is actually so broken it's disgusting, it's so money hungry it hurts, it's all just ad after ad and no longer taking any effort to show you what you want.

There are so many advertisements, I literally can't even use it. For every two pins, there are four ads, I'm not even joking. Hiding the ads doesn't even do anything as they just show up again two pins later. I can't even see the pins in my feed because of the sheer amount of ads. It used to be so good. :(((

I love pinterest and have been using it for many years, but the ads are absolutely insane. I decided to count and out of 100 pins in a search I got 55 ads and 42 of those ads were Amazon. If I wanted to find something on Amazon, I know where to go, but that's not what I want to see when I'm looking for the next project to crochet or the recipe for a crazy desert I want to attempt to make. I really don't want to scroll through ads, but that's what this app is starting to feel like.

I have used this app for many years but now want to change my rating to only two stars. I keep seeing adds for movies from China that are against my principles and very offensive to me. I do understand that they need to show adds, but there is no way for me as user to block those that I really do not want to see.

Still love this app, but I'm just having more and more new problems with it. Boards won't load, it will tell me I am offline even if I am on high speed internet, I pin something and then ten seconds later all the "save" "share" etc. icons disappear when I try to pin something else, I have to close out the app and reopen it multiple times in a 30 minute window just to get a search in, I get the "something went wrong on our end" message a lot and have to close out for sometimes up to an hour.

I'm sick and tired of this app. only reason I haven't uninstalled it is because I've had many inspiration photos from years. when the feature to favorite pins came out, I really enjoyed that but they removed it for no reason?? and then they also removed notes and the "more ideas" toggle on the bar when you click on one of your boards. don't get me started on the amount of ads and ai slop that I see. Way too ridiculous, removing helpful features for what??

I used to love this app, I enjoyed finding unique art/artist and used it alot for finding good references but its practically unusable for a normal artist now. I get the ad links I guess since it is free but there are so many now, over flowing everywhere. and the main thing that makes me want to give up on this app is the Ai. I thought this might be the one app safe from it but no. Ai is everywhere. its so hard to find special meaningful pieces from REAL people. not robots.

I'm taking away stars because you brought the comments section back. Bad move. Removing it was the best decision you've made in years. Also, please don't ignore the desktop version in favor of the app. Desktop Pinterest hasn't been working right. Can't upload anything. Can't create boards or sections. Please fix. But people are still being weird saying there's too many ads on Pinterest when they have decreased exponentially recently.

I love the app! There's nothing actually needing changing for this except for the ads. I don't know if it based off the apps I play but they sure are interesting and sometimes funny. But I don't really mind them at all. I love using Pinterest to find photos and references. Everyone is usually very kind on the app. edit: I've been using this to text my friends and I haven't gotten any notifications for it even with them on, it may be a bug, but I don't like missing my friends messages :<

Hi, I'm having a problem with Pinterest. After I cleared the app data and signed in again, my account seems to have changed. It still has the same name and username, but all my saved Pins, boards, followers, and everything else are gone. Also, the "Download image" option disappeared - I only see Copy link, Collage, and Share now. I've already updated the app, but nothing changed. Has anyone had this problem? Do you know how to fix it? Thank you!

I am so sick of seeing an image, trying to click on that image to expand it, somehow hitting the home button and then the image disappeares. The app will show me every other image except the one I'm looking for. It's like the app is trying to intentionally irritate me.

Honestly I do love this app, but the amount of ads is atrocious. Oh, and not to mention how I'll look up jewelry, looking for a pin, and all I get is products. It seems like they're shoving the products down our throats because I have no way to turn it off. I'm tired of only getting products when I want a pin. No, I don't want to shop, I want to add to my boards. Otherwise I genuinely like this app.

pintrest is a very good app.... for ideas and stuff and anything else... but lately I've been facing an issue regarding the ads... there's one ad that's very disturbing to me....and even if I want to stop it from appearing it won't go... it's really an issue to me ..... i expect some kind of solution to this ....

Used to really love the app but there are way too many ads now. The interface has also changed for the worse. Clicking the pin used to bring you to the underlying site. Now it just gives you access to save the picture which is annoying. They also regularly try and change how pins are accessed which is annoying. Keep the simplicity and stop trying to make things fancy.

very useful and good app, though I do have a few complaints. this could just be result of my own device, but at times it crashes for no reason. if you're playing music with another app, it'll 9 times out of 10 stop the music, if you click on a notification, theres a chance it wont even direct you to the comment it notified you about, and it doesn't show all of your notifications in the notification bar.

Pretty simple to find recipes and crafts and DIY ideas, when I started out over a decade ago. I've been using Pinterest since 2014. But, I've noticed more ads and pop-ups and sometimes harder to actually get the recipes without having to follow them or offer up your email. I still enjoy it. sometimes its easier to just Google recipes.

used this app for 10 years without issue. days ago, i was hacked, which pinterest alerted me of and changed my password for me. but then a day later, my account was banned completely for "spam", that the hacker made. ive submitted 3 appeals and they were all denied, with an additional note that i need to "read their rules on spam". im being punished for being hacked, when they were the ones who told me i was hacked in the first place. this is apparently a common occurrence. also too many ads.

What I don't like is having an account on your phone and on your tablet and Pinterest switching them on you taking all my friends and pins along with it making me start all over because I was waiting for a new phone. I deleted that off my tablet as I wanted to. and you think AI is bad this app is too! there was no need for switching!

Pinterest has been very disappointing. I've tried to appeal one of my boards being taken down and I have been unsuccessful for almost a whole month. Whenever you appeal on their website, It's just a bot speaking to you and eventually telling you they found that it couldn't be appealed. I hope they fix their AI issue within the app as well as the search engine is truly buggy.

The craziest thing on Pinterest outside of content no longer being organic or original, just Ai 🙄...is how counterproductive Temu ads are. I literally clicked on the ad to BUY an item and Temu immediately sent me into their typical psycho spastic tedious childish video games. I backed out of them and the feed immediately refreshed to suggestions rather than this item that I immediately loved. I scrolled, nothing exact to this item emerged. Such an EPIC fail for advertising and landing a sale.

This is a really great app, perfect for looking for inspirarion, refrences, and so much more! Majority of post are from people who are using the app and are either reposting content or posting their own content. I truly wish their was a filter where you could filter out the ai content and theres too many ads. you can't go a single scroll without seeing 5 ads. So much ads that theirs been multiple time where I found something cute press on the photo and take me to another website/app.

Since February, I've had this one issue that on mobile, my filter for analytics won't change from 30 days, and on desktop, my analytics doesn't show at all! And every time I bring this up, support disappears on me until I have to bring it up... again... The last time I contacted support, they told me they tried to replicate my issue and couldn't do it... so they automatically closed my case. Unless they were inside my account, I think it's obvious it wouldn't be replicated on other accounts.

it's an amazing app for looking at references for anything. But I do wish that there was a dark mode setting on computer because it flash bangs me everytime I open it at bight to draw or whatever. I do also wish that instead if being banned/reported for saving a pin that it doesn't like it fave us a heads up before we save it. like I'm not the one who created it so why do I get in trouble kind of situation. other than those two things it's great at giving new feed you are looking at recently.

I've had Pinterest for years and I love the app and it helps to much for finding inspiration. but recently the app has become FLOODED with AI and it's one of the most frustrating things ever to try find something and all that shows up is a bunch of AI slop. I have turned off all the AI stuff in my settings but it is completely useless. there are still images on my page that clearly have a AI logo in the corner and Pinterest doesn't pick it up.

I really dislike the constant flow of ads It's so distracting. one thing that made Pinterest so enjoyable than other social media apps have been that it wasn't constantly trying to push products in your face. y'all could have rather made it a for pay platform considering people who would use your service would do so repeatedly. also that new edition of not being able to directly download images. hell no. I'm really not liking this. y'all could have put a watermark on the images.

The app is quite good, though. If anyone needs an idea about anything, they can easily find it.But for the past few days it is not working at all. Meaning if I open the app , it's not working even though my wifi is perfectly fine? Every 3 or 4 days it is written here that "something went wrong try again". All other apps are working perfectly fine like TikTok, YouTube... And when I look at my pins, this is what is written there"you have not visited any pin yet"what does this mean? is it a bug????

They deactivated my account. After using this app for >10 years I've now lost my vast library of pins. So many of these pins were referenced in everyday life for my cooking, Journaling, and writing. I am devastated. I know the deactivation was invalid because they said I was spamming?! I was saving pins to my boards. isn't that the whole point? There is no way to contact a real person on pinterest and I can't figure out any other way to get my account back. Will NEVER EVER use again.

it used to be good but recently I've got way to many sexual or suggestive ads and pictures I've blocked them and still keep getting suggested similar stuff I am someone deeply uncomfortable with seeing such things and am annoyed by the amount of time I've had to block or report things and still being suggested or shown on my feed.

Used to be great now after I transfer my pins I will be deleting and saving room on my phone. Firstly, the ads are out of control and are comically excessive. My last search was for 'cats'. Out of the first twenty pins 9/20 were ads and 5/20 were AI. The platform is quite literally half ads and disguising ads as creative pins is not it. There are also so many repetitive pins it's like the pins on my feed are all from the same twitter/whisper posts. Yikes!

love Pinterest, but the adds are getting very invasive. I'm not going to buy anything from a flashing add. I like when shops up load a picture and you can enter their site if you wish, and save their photo. with no sales. often the algorithm gets super boring. and I see the same stuff continuously. Generally lose the invasive flashing adds, which, for me, are a waste of my time and their money. but it's a great way to be introduced to new designers, and talented people, no adds. T-y.

ZERO STARS. I've had Pinterest for 10 years and it has gone from having an ad every seven or so pins to having AT LEAST three video ads playing simultaneously with one pin showing if you're lucky. There are literally more ads than pins, and most of the pins are linked to shops. So it's basically an ad-scrolling app. Not worth ANYONE'S time. Half the features don't work, like moving pins from one board to another and organizing the order, AND NOW YOU CAN'T EVEN SAVE ANY IMAGES TO YOUR PHONE.

Still a fan even though it's changed a lot over the years. The ability to keep boards private until you're ready to share them is pretty cool too. The collage feature is fire too. I love that they give suggestions to real items for sale on things you pin. Currently updating, hopefully it keeps getting better.

i have no real complaints since the app is amazing, but.. I've been having a weird problem lately, it keeps telling me to "confirm or change my email" when I've already done that, not sure if this is happening to anyone else but it's impossible to use the app when that pop up keeps interrupting me, i don't know if i did something wrong but it's frustrating considering I've been having the same one for years and never changed it..

I absolutely LOVE this app!! I love how it has things that I like and new things that inspire me! I found great art and makeup ideas, and found a bunch of edits about my fav movies, tv, and books. The one thing that I am annoyed about is almost everything I saw on there was ads. If I saw something I liked half the time it turned out to be some ad and not somebody's pin. Another thing is the AI content. It's kinda getting annoying. But still appealing at times. I overall love this app tho!!! :)

I do love this app but recent updates have cause it to completely hide my notifications and Satus bar unless I swipe down, without a way to turn this off this is a complete no for me. I'm very absent minded so I need to be able to see my notifications stack and my timer active at all time, change this and my review is subject to change. Thank you.

The amount of ads is absolutely ridiculous. For every two pins, there are at least 4 ads that follow. It really ruins the app when viewed on a phone. I've had this app for years, and I'm to the point of deleting the app because of the ads. Beware.

reviews.t: I give it 3/5 stars on this app 🍎🪽
reviews.x: I’m really disappointed when I discovered that Pinterest has Al stuff and everything I save people arts I away see those Al “arts “ in my feed it start to annoy me every time I try to report someone the app doesn’t do anything about it it bugs me so much and I hate it when they sent me a email saying that the pin I save it taken down ??? Like hello please fix this app and improve it more Ik I sound very aggressive when I said it my apologies i didn’t mean to come out as a aggressive mad person I’m just blunt honest when I say stuff but I’m just really annoyed and upset that this app is shoving Al stuff on my feed and I don’t wanna see that stuff anymore 💔🥺… I do enjoy and love this app because I have good times in this app and save some funny videos or drawings but my only problem is Al stuff and not doing anything about taken the person account when I reported for a good reason it fine if you don’t wanna hear my helpful advice that on you and your crew team but yeah I wanna share my own experiences and my thoughts on this app -zip 🍎🪽

I love this app but every since the new update a few months ago, it's become glitchy. I can't listen to music without it glitching my audio, I can't scroll as fast as I want to. the app overheats my phone. I love this app but it didn't used to be such a hassle. now? I don't get on it as much because it overheats my phone.

Pinterest used to be a great tool for organizing my ideas and interests. Now, I can't stand it because of AI and ads. There are more ads than pins per page-it's overwhelming! I see a lot of reviews that appear fake/paid for which claim this is a great app. Pinterest is a prime example of technology getting out of hand with pushing consumerism. Also, the majority of "pins" are just random tik toks. It's no longer creative-friendly. The "collage" feature is not cool enough to make up for the ads.

I used to like Pinterest, however recently it has just become AI slop and non stop ads trying to sell you something. I used to use Pinterest to find original ideas, inspiration, and recipes. But now, more than half of what i search is just AI garbage. Even the recipes are AI. its just not what it used to be

I've been using Pinterest for a while, and it's one of the best apps for finding inspiration. Whether I'm looking for healthy recipes, business ideas, home decor, fashion, or DIY projects, I always find useful and creative content. The app is easy to use, the recommendations are relevant, and I love being able to save ideas to boards for later. It's a great platform for learning, planning, and discovering new trends. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys creativity and organization!

Not sure what changed recently, but I see nothing but products for purchase when I search anything. I was looking for midcentury bookcase decorating and/or refurbishing, but no matter what keywords I use, I just get brand new junk to buy from Amazon, Target, etc. This is so sad. I guess I'll have to find a new app.

Where to begin? I’ve been using this app for years and I loved it so much until about a year ago. I had tens of thousands of pins, but all of a sudden it seemed like half of all the pins I saved were ai without me realizing. I also noticed a sudden abundance in ads. Seriously, I couldn’t scroll through three pins without an ad popping up. Between the ai and ads, only really a fourth of the pins suggested to me were actually things I wanted to save. That’s not insane, considering it’s probably the same on Tiktok or other social media - but when you consider how incredibly tailored Pinterest used to be, it’s astounding. Then, like a final blow to the once incredible apps reputation in my own life, I was banned. I’ve had my account since sixth grade and had a seriously mind boggling amount of pins saved, and my account was deactivated. I had posted maybe three pins that were just collages I made of cute outfits and I didn’t save anything ridiculous or inappropriate, and yet my account was permanently banned with no opportunity for recovery for no real reason. It truly is heart breaking because of how many different phases of life this app has seen of me, and they’re all now gone for no reason known to me. I have reached out to Pinterest multiple times but all of the replies are automated, and I truly believe my account was a victim of an account checking system ran fully by ai, leading to the deactivation of my account and thousands of other users. Seriously, how can an app go this downhill??

The things that bother me are the "back" and "magnifying glass" symbols on the top left and down right corner, sometimes they cover the image I'm seeing. Please don't make the recommended posts hover over the image! Just regular scroll like it was before is fine! Also, I wish it'd be easier for fans/regular users to report reposted artworks with no credit.

it's basically unusable now without paying for an ad blocker. Its like 10% pins and 90% ads now and not like ads that are also pins but ads that if you accidentally click on it itll take you out of the app. it'd be one thing if the ads were pins too that you could save for later but the app is just horrible now. I've also had times when I search something and it's entirely ads, which is ridiculous. it's so bad I downloaded and screenshotted all of pins and moved them to the app cosmos instead.

90% of my use of this app is saving recipes I like and exploring new ones. An important part of cooking and baking is making notes on the recipe if you tweak it or the results are different than described. I HATE the update that took the note to self option away. I am not going to comment on a post and waste my time scrolling through the comments to find my notes. It was such a helpful and practical feature that didn't need to go. I can ignore the insane ads for an app that does what I need.

I'm into arts and craft and pinterest is my favorite place to find inspiration. It’s less noisy than most other apps and I can get lost scrolling through it for hours. Wonderful that it is free to use as well. I have so many moodboards and collections which I create on desktop. But when I have to wait somewhere and you see me staring at my phone it is most likely pinterest

Pinterest always had issues like randomly deleting pins that aren't even mine and giving me violation notices over them. Now there are even more bugs; random letters and numbers disappear from comments, comment section turns off, and I can't archive my boards at all. None of the recent updates have helped this.

why does an error popup appear every time I try to change my description? it's not like i spam edit, it doesn't even work on first try. I've been using this app for years and to be fair, every update = more glitching. another problem, it's also getting infested by ai slop, and that pisses me off. genai is FAR from creativity. there are also more ads than pins, the hell is this supposed to be useful for?

Edit: I have deleted my account with thousands of pins. Pinterest has put the app under intense AI moderation which has and banned swaths of accounts and pins due to its errors. They treat saving a pin you did not make as a strike you can be banned for. Not only that, the app is now riddled with AI-generated images, making it next to impossible to use Pinterest for its original purpose.

reviews.t: Use to Love It and Used It for Personal, NON-BUSINESS nor Advertising Use, But Cannot Login Anymore
reviews.x: I used to LOVE the Pinterest app and use to use it to get ideas for various things for myself from things for my home, to things for my dog, even to things to get for others as gifts. I never, ever, ever use to use the app for any personal gains nor personal business nor advertising nor influencer purposes. Heck, all of my Pinterest boards that I created for myself were private. I spent a lot of time using Pinterest, getting ideas for things for myself, and saving items to my various PRIVATE Pinterest boards when one day all of a sudden I no longer had access to, or was even able to log on/in to my Pinterest account for some reason. And even after numerous tries to, over numerous different days and long time spans between attempts, I still cannot get in to my Pinterest account. And I cannot understand why. I was not even one who made their own Pinterest pins! Everything that I added to one of my Pinterest boards was something that another [someone who was and is unknown to me…aka not a friend or someone else that I knew who also used Pinterest] Pinterest user created and posted to Pinterest first as a pin, as one of their Pins.

its okay, a few things bug me: Too many ads. I'm on for 15 seconds and get hit with 36 ads. every 3 pins you get like 4 ads is unbeatable. and i get it chase that bag but still, it hurt my experience, ive gone 5times today and have left after 10secs bc of the ads Too much AI-generated content. Please add an AI filter. The "Enhanced with AI" label is confusing. Real art gets tagged, obvious AI doesn't. What does it even mean? Can't tap to fix typos when editing comments. It just won't let me.

The app is a great source of inspiration with beautiful visuals and personalized recommendations. Users enjoy the extensive and diverse content. Scrolling is fun and relaxing. However,"My Pinterest doesn't save Pins instantly anymore. Even though I mainly use one board ('saves'), it always opens the 'Save to board' screen and asks me to choose or create boards. I want Pins to save directly with one tap like before, without asking every time."

The ads are bordering on insane. I remember the days when there were very few ads. Now there are more ads on my feed than there is actual content. And half of those are links to various online stores. What used to be a fun app is now just overwhelming. No one in their right mind is going to want to keep scrolling past three or four large ads just to see three pins, and then three or four more ads for another three actual pins. Bring back the days of being able to find diys and recipes and how-to’s without having to scour through various ads and purchase options. I went from spending hours a day or a week looking for craft and hairstyle ideas back before 2020 to maybe spending a few minutes a week lately because being constantly bombarded by ads is ridiculous. While I greatly appreciate being able to filter out a decent amount of ai slop, seeing more ads than pins is as bad of an issue. If you are trying to get people to not want to use your app anymore, congratulations. It’s working. I’m not even saying that it’s all or nothing. I would just love to go back to being able to find what I’m actually looking for on your app without seeing at least forty different things I definitely don’t want to buy or waste my time with before I find anything even remotely close to what I was originally trying to find.

No matter the interests you select, you will get aggressively bombarded with ads with sexual contents with no option to even block the advertisers one by one, you can only report, and pointlessly too, because a few pins later, that same ad will very likely pop up again. I can tolerate ads since they show up as pins, not pop-ups, but the contents matter more than the frequency! It would be an understatement to say those ads ruin the experience.

It was great a long time ago but now there's painfully too much (Gen)AI and ads on that platform. I even turned that thing on to show me less Ai but it's still too much. And why exactly is Pinterest turning my music (from another app) volume down? All my ads are silent but it acts like it's playing sound. I had that problem on iOs and now on Android. It's really annoying and I don't have fun when using the App – I end up just closing Pinterest.

I am extremely dissapointed. When I first started using this app about a year ago i saw very few ads on my feed. Probably about 10% of it. Since then it has gone up to about 75% of my feed. Whenever I search for something all I get is ads for Ebay or Amazon. I don't want to shop for clothing. I want reference images and this is, no, WAS the best place to find them.

ive genuinely never seen an app more buggy and laggy than this one. It randomly stops working and the pins in my board suddenly disappear telling me its an error, everything i do in this forsaken app is an error, and when i want to save a pin in a board it wont even work, i have to do it multiple tries. Also the amount of ads while i scroll?? hello?? this app genuinely WORSENED over the years.

The massive amount of ads are getting increasingly frustrating and make me click off the app within 3 seconds at this point. Feels like my feed is 70% ads, 15% AI, 10% re-uploaded tiktoks and only 5% authentic content. There's way too much AI generated slop, and also an alarming, unprovoked push of content promoting eating disorders when I first started using the app (clearly targeted towards young women and girls)

Terrible app now. Ads are everywhere and you can't tap on any pin without being redirected somewhere else. Way too many generative ai pins and no way to filter them out. Clunky notification settings where it doesn't always tell you if someone's replied to your comments or commented on your pin. Again with the clunky notifications, sometimes on the rare chance that you do get a notification, it won't let you tap on it to see what it's from. Used to be a good app, now it's awful.

Fix your ads. My page should never be only ads at one point; this is ridiculous. I used to love this app so much, but now I can't stand to be on it. All of us hate the ads; get rid of them. It would be five stars without the ads and the ai.

This app has been my favourite app ever but I'm giving one star now bcoz of the annoying amount of ads it has started showing!! Every scroll I get an ad!! The number of ads shown per pins SHOULD go down! And don't even get me started on the amount of ai slop it shows instead of content made by real people. Srsly something needs to change for the platform to go back to being the same amazing one it was earlier

Keeps glitching and keeping my archived or deleted boards on my main profile. There are more ads than pins at this point on the main page and stop pausing my music for a *muted* ad I haven't even scrolled down to yet. Also keeps labelling NON-AI pins as AI modified. You have to go through a lengthy email process everytime to fix it. Your ai system instead of real human moderators is infinitely terrible. The app refuses to work on data, only wifi gets everything to load.

Honestly, a huge fan and have been using this app for years! I think the app could be better about filtering out AI posts. There is a way to generally do so, but you need to individually select every category instead of there being a "catch all" flip switch like other settings like notifications. Overall, as a person who loves finding inspiration and art references, love the app.

This app used to be fun and useful for craft, design, and renovation inspiration and ideas. About 5 years ago, I'd use it daily. Now it is just endless ads (I counted, more than half the feed is ads), highly repetitive in what it actually shows, the search function is useless, and it's filled with useless AI slop (just love seeing patterns and plans that aren't physically possible). There's no point using this app anymore.

New version is awful. Tips don't STOP after being read, super annoying. Pushing back takes me out of search. how does it keep getting worse. do you guys have ai programming the app? the top and bottom of the entire app are blacked out and inaccessable... 😒 cant search. cant comment.

I used to live on the app, but since the rise of AI, I've been very disappointed. Theres so many AI pictures, the tags saying AI only pops up when you click on the image. There's no opinion to not see AI images or flag something as AI. It's also so heavy on ads recently. about every 4 images, there seems to be an ad. And they seem mostly me AI nonsense ads. Very disappointed.

Hi 👋🏻 I don't usually write reviews but in this case I just have to. I absolutely love using Pinterest for digital content creation inspiration! However....for the past two weeks the app hasn't been working properly. It takes forever to load, and it keeps buffering on my laptop's Chrome browser as well. Could you please fix this? I don't understand why this is happening.

If I could negative star a review of this app I would. It used to be my go to app for scrolling and gathering inspiration but it has gotten so ridiculous over time. Now this app has nothing but ads, literally, I have one actual pin on my screen and the rest are ads, to the point where it's borderline unusable. Then any pins that aren't ads gave about a 50/50 chance of it being ai which is also ridiculous. I wish I could love this app again

3 stars. I love using pinterest and it's helped me organize a lot of my thoughts, except there is some things that I would appreciate if they were fixed. 1. Too many ads! There is a bunch of ads and websites that want me to purchase their items, if I wanted to buy things related to what I was searching up- I would've gone to Google. 2. Sometimes malfunctions? 3. Can you please make boards be able to have a password in order to unlock it? I have a word limit, so I'll stop there. - Thanks!

Pinterest is my absolute favorite app for finding inspiration! Whether I'm looking for home decor ideas, outfit inspiration, recipes, or creative DIY projects, it always delivers exactly what I need. The visual layout is beautiful, and the algorithm is amazing at suggesting things that match my taste. It's my go-to place whenever I want to get creative."

As of late, there are WAY too many ads. Every 3rd pin is an ad or is something from their sponsors. There is AI everywhere and when looking at clothing for inspiration, they aren't pins. Instead they are ads from retailers trying to sell their ugly merchandise. The app is unusable to the point that I stay on my computer now because at least on there I have ad block that blocks at least some of the ads. UPDATE: I TURNED OFF NOTIFICATIONS FOR A REASON. STOP ASKING ME TO TURN THEM BACK ON.

Love the app, been using it for years. It's great at curating aesthetic photos and references for art, and you could probably find anything on there. My only issue is the amount of ai on the app. They have implemented means for you to avoid it, and to mark things that are ai, but it sometimes misses things. More recently, an 'ai insight' has been appearing below pins offering useless tips about things you can see plain as day with your eyes, and I can't find a way to turn it off.

it's kind of gone downhill lately. I get more ads than posts anymore, mostly fast fashion. the AI filter is nice, but it can't catch everything. a way to report AI posts that slip through would be great. the body type filters aren't very effective beyond skinny and plus sized. otherwise, the app is great for organization and finding ideas.

Ads and Ai galore. This used to be such an amazing app but its become too riddled with ads and Ai its such a shame. I really hope they change this I have deleted the app and I'm using the web browser with an ad blocker so I can use it in peace it does keep asking me to use the app but whatever. Also let me just take a screen shot stop asking me after to pin it or share it so annoying. Its just become so frustrating to use the app.

Love the app, there's always constant improvement in the running of the app and it catches up to trends and works well. 10/10. Edit: the new layout change erased the messaging area, where do I go to find the messages, there's only home, search and profile on the bottom now.

reviews.t: I’m putting this as a five star review so there’s a better chance of it being seen.
reviews.x: I love Pinterest. I always have. I’ve been using this app since early 2020 and I have loved every single use of it. Until now. When you go on your feed, your bound to see ai images everywhere that aren’t even flagged as ai by their bad reviewing system controlled by robots. When there is a post that isn’t ai, Pinterest just… Marks it as ai? This can cause hate to the original creator and has the potential to just overall mess up their reputation. Pinterest will also take down other people’s pins that you saved for reasons that aren’t even true. My pins are full of art and cool objects like cute colored buttons and stuffed animals and such. I get an email every single day telling me that my posts were taken down for, “self harm related content”. This is not true for any of my pins and it then they tell you that they will have to take, “action” on your account (AKA banning you) for something that you didn’t do and have overall no control over. Pinterest also does not show you the pin that their ai has taken down for quite literally no reason, so you cannot make an appeal because you don’t know what they took down. Please fix this, Pinterest. I want to delete your app, along with many other people agreeing with me online and in real life. Goodbye.

it's a great app in theory, they really need better moderation though, but they can be said about literally any social. the advertisements are horrible, it's 60% ads 40% actual content, another detail is that I wish you could have more power over board merge and sectioning, it'd be great to be able to put sections inside of sections for even better organization.

Pinterest is one of the best apps for finding inspiration. Whether it's art, fashion, room decor, study motivation, recipes, or DIY ideas, there's something for everyone. The interface is clean, easy to use, and the recommendations get better over time. A must-have app for creative people!

I have been on Pinterest since the very beginning and used to love it. Sadly that is not the case anymore. This app is so close to being 100% ads to the point that navigating through the app is genuinely difficult as I keep misclicking either the terrible ad or the Ai slop next to it. What a waste of a great platform.

I have been using this app for years and it's gotten to the point where it not as enjoyable to be on. There are too many ads and they are not related to any of my interests. 1 out of 5 post are from other creators and the rest are ads. I end up going on my computer with ad blockers on to get to content.

im having issues with pintrest only showing me maybe 5 photos when i click on one of the little tabs in the homepage from my created groups been happening for maybe a month or 2 now its annoying. Niow im getting a slow down message for literally opening the app and it pops up randomly even if im not doing anything. lastly ai 🥀 ik theres a setting for it atleast thats there but alot still slip through the cracks and i dont see a report as ai button which would be a nice addition

I absolutely LOVE Pinterest. I have no problems with it because I can easily scroll past the ads and go on with my day. I love to make folders of funny things and more. The only thing I will say is that my phone lags if I try to put something in a folder slowly, and I can't put it in. but that happens rarely. But I do really recommend Pinterest for literally anything.

for the most part I love Pinterest. I like getting the recommendation emails too, except there are just way too many. please add an option for less frequency, eg one email a day or week etc. I am being bombarded with up to 5 a day, it's too much. I might have to unsub all together
reviews.a: Daughter of God Warrior of Christ

reviews.x: Pinterest, what is wrong with your app? I tried to remove a link from a Pin I created, but I kept getting an error message saying, "Sorry! Your request could not be completed." I even restarted my phone, but the issue continued. This has also happened when I tried to edit my bio. At this point, it seems like a problem with the app, not my phone. This issue has happened multiple times and is becoming very frustrating.

I used to love Pinterest and used it for everything. over the last year I have noticed that so much of the content is AI and there is no way to opt out of it like on other platforms. the ads are more frequent than the real posts and you can't stop those either. There must have been a recent update in the last week or so because now the home button doesn't work 90% of the time (it takes you to search) and makes the app super glitchy unless you are searching for something, there is no more feed.

reviews.t: Inappropriate violations in the wrong places
reviews.x: Pinterest has told me that I have violated their community guidelines countless times. Though Pinterest is a great app for inspo and many other things, everything I save gets a violation. Mind you I would NEVER save something smutty or s*xual. Though I have seen many normal images that I have only saved get a violation warning, I have come across many images on the app that SHOULD be violated. I report these images at once but normally they only get “restricted access”. For instance, I saved a pin recently with a bunch of people standing around a guy with his hair on fire which was meant to be a funny reaction picture I could draw later. It got a violation warning. I have saved a picture of Darth Vader and have gotten violated for copyright. I have reported pins of nearly nude and suggestive poses AND EVEN SUGGESTIVE ADS meant for everyone to see, and yet they don’t get taken down completely. Please Pinterest I do love your app but don’t send me a violation warning for completely normal posts that I’ve saved and not even posted myself. If I save something actually bad please feel free to call me out on it, but clearly I haven’t. Please actually take down the things that the general audience shouldn’t be seeing that comes up in one easy search. Thank you for your time.

Too much AI. Pinterest used to be great. Now most of the images are generated. Some people are even so desperate for clicks that they generate recipes that don't work. There is a way to lessen them but not fully remove them. I would like to see an option to "report as AI". I would also like to see the "AI insight" removed because it's a waste of energy for every picture.

I love this app, obviously. but I really hate the constant AI pins, and while I appreciate that they added a toggle setting of it, it still doesn't catch all the AI posts. I also can't stand the change in the position of the search bar. They moved it to the bottom, and it blocks pins, and I am constantly hitting it on accident, I wish they kept it where it was.

reviews.t: Don’t use if you don’t want to work with AI.
reviews.x: Despite the app working totally fine, it’s now reduced to working hand in hand with AI. For an app all about creativity and inspiration, something about implanting AI features feels as scummy and slimy as when any other app decides to force it upon their users. Used to be easy to navigate the search engine, now it’s about 10x more complicated than it needed to be. Instead of the filters being there at the search from the begging, well now you’ve got to search, let its pathetic AI think it’s “helping” you, wait for a SMALL icon on the bottom left of your screen, and only THEN do you get the option to filter your search. It was already impossible to use given the fact you fill it to the BRIM with ads, which if you’re listening to music, will often be shut off to PLAY THE AD INSTEAD. The ads were already a huge problem, now that you’ve decided to unnecessarily add AI into the system, it’s becoming even more unusable. As an artist who’s hesitant to ever post their art, due to the amount of art theft people can now get away with due to AI, this app cemented my fear and refusal to ever share my work with the world. Congrats, Pinterest! Hope integrating AI made you the money your ad revenue clearly wasn’t making for you!

As someone who only uses Pinterest as my main form of media consumption, I would like to see some beneficial changes to the app. For instance, I feel there should be a way to toggle AI Insights off/on. These AI Insights are practically useless and the photos it does generate on, it has no idea what it’s talking about. It’s just garbled nonsense. Additionally, for years users have wanted the option to choose themes or color schemes that would change the UI. I believe that this change would enhance the personalization experience of the app, I mean, that’s the whole point of the app isn’t it? Personalize and pin your interests. Not only would this enhance user engagement but it would also bring in new users. People love to customize things, especially things they like. There are so many ads now it’s ridiculous, AI has completely taken over as well. I click on an image only to find out it is AI when I have ALL of my AI setting disabled. The reports and violations are utterly ridiculous. I get multiple notifications every day saying “we’ve taken down this pin you saved because XYZ” and for one, stop having AI do your job or all of these pins wouldn’t be taken down. Secondly, it doesn’t even show what pin it is half of the time, the ones it HAS shown me weren’t even remotely close to what it said it was in violation of. You need a better system instead of having AI do your work for you. I knew that as soon as Open AI came into the app, that there would be issues. As someone who uses the app, multiple times a day, every day, I feel these changes would improve the app tremendously. Thank you.

I have been using Pinterest since I had internet access as a young teen and I used to religiously. Within the last few years, though, the quality of it all has degraded significantly and I live in fear that my profiles will be “deactivated” over violations to their guidelines. Within the last week, I have suffered having Pinterest send me an email EVERY DAY FOR FOUR DAYS advising me that a pin I saved was “removed” then “reinstated” then “removed” again for a new reason, then “reinstated”, etc. I genuinely worry that my account is in jeopardy because their AI or whomever is flagging these things cannot make up its mind. This app is becoming unusable with the new updates and the horrific ad placement. I understand there are guidelines to follow, but why am I being punished over a Pin I did not make? Some of the reports that I have received have been for things not even inappropriate, like a HAIR MOD for a video game where NO nudity was displayed. I genuinely have begun using the app SIGNIFICANTLY less than I did even a year ago because it’s become so bad. Don’t download it. Don’t make an account. They are no longer worth your time and they do not care.

I genuinely enjoy using Pinterest but while scrolling through pins, the app jump back to the top of the page, and I lose my place and it make it harder to browse the content. And when I’m looking through saved pins or deleting saved pins, it sends me back to the top of the collection instead of keeping me where I was, and it’s time consuming, and it will be really helpful if u have a multi select option for deleting or moving, then individual deleting or moving (plus every time I delete or move, it sends me all the way to the top), and when I’m saving pins to collections, when I’m about to choose a collection, the list rearrange itself at last second and a different board of my colections appear in the exact spot I was about to click and I end up saving the pin to wrong board. And can u please also fix the thing where when I’m about to save a pin to a collection, can u please automatically put the board that is most relevant to the content of the pin so we don’t have to scroll through all of our collection/boards and find it. I geuailly love Pinterest and use it everyday, one of my favorite apps, but it would be amazing and helpful if u work on these issues.

The number of ads now is absolutely staggering. On the mobile app on iPhone 13 Pro, 3 out of the 4 ‘pins’ on my screen are ads. Unreal. Honestly, I only really use Pinterest on browser with an ad blocker now because the clunkiness of browser use is less annoying than the amount of ads on the app if you can believe that. They also need to get a report flag for AI content or do a better job filtering. It’s almost impossible to search any architectural or recipe content now without 80-90% of pins being AI-generated content. Then those pins are then just repeated ad nauseam, which is a waste of time. It’s now easier to buy the cookbook, architectural digest, or even just to find a few creators you like on IG or blogs, and follow them there or sign up for their emails to know you’ll get real content. I’m sure Pinterest is making money off both of these strategies in the short term, but in the long term, this will absolutely kill this brand, which is really a shame. I’m in the creative industry and am (was?) avid Pinterest user for both work and my personal life. If *I’m* starting to walk away, casual users are long gone. Sad.

reviews.t: Pin is in the worst place
reviews.x: Pinterest changed it again. This time the pin button is is the WORST possible spot! When you hold on a image to pin it, and the options pop up, where's the pin button? Behind your thumb where you can't see it? Off the screen? Somewhere else? Ugh I HATE IT! I've used Pinterest since the beginninng and have seen it go through countless iterations, becoming more monetized and less enjoyable. I can deal with all the ads. I can tolerate that even the slightest touch opens a link. I can even manage to ignore the fact that a search brings up links to buy whatever you searched for instead of actual pins. It's annoying but, fine, I get it. But the UX is almost unusable. What would possess your developers to do this?? It's awful! The app is constantly changing, which is annoying when the user is used to it working a certain way where you don't even have to think about it. You change the icons so they're confusing. But now you've moved the pin button so you can't even see it. The first rule of design- put the most important thing on top. How your developers failed to do that is beyond me.

reviews.t: Good, But There’s a Big Problem
reviews.x: This app is awesome for collecting inspiration of things you want to use to help you create something cool in real life. I use this app for makeup inspiration, clothing inspiration, and even take my own pictures and post them, which is super fun. However, something seriously needs to be done about the number of concerning bullying accounts. There is a disgusting amount of accounts that are blatantly racist, sexist, bullying people for their looks, and even explicit adult content accounts that are not being removed at all. It’s a big issue and makes the app a very negative place. I’ve contemplated deleting the app just to avoid these kinds of negative posts many times. It needs to stop. No one deserves to be judged my a stranger online for how they look or made fun of because of their ethnicity. It’s horrible and I’ve seen this happen many, many times. I’ve reported a ton of accounts that posted content bullying others and nothing ever happened with those accounts, which isn’t fair at all. This is why we can’t always trust AI to get the job done for us all the time. We need real people looking out for these issues. And also, I find the app a bit difficult to navigate. It isn’t very easy to see your notifications and I’ve seen a few people here and there complain about the new update changing the app’s look. I unfortunately would have to agree with them. Anyways, thank you very much for reading this, it means the world to me, and I really hope something can be done about these issues in the future.

Good grief, can we dial back the ads??? I can't turn away from a recipe for 5 seconds before I have to close ad, close ad, close ad, close ad. This is super annoying. Not at all user friendly. Please do better. *Edit - years ago I would have given this app 5 stars. Recently I changed to 2 stars. Now it gets 1. Much easier to just use a search engine for recipes and save them that way. Absolutely terrible.

I loved Pinterest, it's a good tool for art and references. Half the time the app glitches out and my pins are gone (then come back), there's so much AI stuff even when I try to censor it, it's kind of depressing. I wanted to give it a 3/5 but I'm annoyed at it randomly getting rid of my boards. I've used Pinterest for like... 14ish years? The Ads are overwhelming too.

Genuinely I don’t know where to begin. The last few updates have been annoying at best. First they roll out a new layout that is supposed to be more streamlined with three tabs at the bottom and the messaging at the top. The issue is the banner at the top goes away so if I do want to check my messages I have to scroll all the way back up. It’s not like it minimizes slightly and then reappears with a little scroll up. You have to go allllllll the way back up to access thar bar again. They rolled it back for a bit and now today that “streamlined” set up is back. They also continue to mess with the share feature so it now takes me 4 steps to send a pin to my friend within the app whereas before it took 2 steps. For some reason despite her being the only one I really message on that app, she never appears in the quick share area anymore. I continue to get more and more ads than actual content. I’ve also noticed that some of the ads are way brighter than my screen settings which is especially annoying in lower light environments. It feels like I am getting hit with a flashbang. Also I have noticed more and more ads are cutting off my music in the background which is the fastest way to get me to leave an app. What gives you the right to cut off my music????? Lastly what is the point of tagging something as AI when half the stuff is tagged and its not AI and the other half is untagged and is AI??? Genuinely the second I find a better version if this app I’m gone. So sick of them breaking things every other update.

Normally I love the app. I use it often for ideas for my daycare. However, lately the search feature of the app has not been working correctly. Any and all subjects I type in the search bar, the results come back as a 'we couldn't find anything' message. I have tried logging out and back in, still the same. I also tried an uninstall and reinstalled still nothing. What is going on? Help!

I wonder how many people would pay for an ad-free version??? This would be a 5-star rating, if there was an ad-free version. I LOVE Pinterest- I get pretty much all my recipes and other great ideas from there! But, I CAN'T STAND the ads! Really annoying. as time goes on feels like more & more. The other thing that is irritating is trying to open a pin and there's not an option to do so. Lot of recipes look amazing, but no instructions. I also feel like I don't see a lot of new things in my feed.

Yeah. Once upon the time Pinterest was a great thing but that was long ago. Now it s nothing much than a garbage dump of advertising masquerading as useful images and sites. As for the Pinterest app which the site almost forces upon you, all it does is allow for it to be hijacked by countless garbage sites, videos, and multiple sites opening upon one another. Just like the good old days of the 90s when your browser would be hijacked by garbage sites, videos, etc., until it became overloaded and froze or worse…causing your system to freeze then requiring you to reboot. After trying to use this mess of an app I deleted it. And don’t believe the high rating for this app or many such occurrence especially should there be hundreds or thousands of reviews. It doesn’t reflect the current situation of what is being reviewed. And because there are so many old reviews from a point when something once deserved them, those old reviews far outweigh the negative changes that have occurred over the past year or more thus giving the false impression of high reviews. Companies know and use this to their advantage. Including Apple, who if you ever resort reviews to “most recent “, on most review sites you would be absolutely shocked at how disgusted many now are with Apple and have been for the past few years. But the many years of glowing old reviews far outweigh and throw of the statistics. Apple allows for the very same situation here in the apps store.

reviews.t: Warning⚠️ your story IS NOT SAFE on Pinterest.
reviews.x: I have spent months trying to process the deep disappointment this platform left me with. After more than 7 years of using Pinterest as my visual diary my account was deleted overnight. At first, I was in shock, but today, after months of missing my boards I’ve decided to speak up. The reason for the deletion? An alleged 'violation of rules.' The most absurd part is that my activity was limited to saving pins and scrolling; it was a personal and private account. When I asked for a logical explanation or specific proof of my mistake, I only received automated responses. They denied me the right to know why they erased nearly a decade of my inspiration. It is painful to see how a platform that markets itself as 'a positive place' treats its long-time users with such coldness and zero transparency. I lost plans, years of ideas, and memories that will never come back. If you are going to use Pinterest, know that your history isn't safe here; they can delete it by mistake, and no one will have the decency to tell you why.

Ive loved this app very dearly for years and it's truly great to get inspiration. One problem though is when a pin gets taken down for some reason you get in trouble for it even if you didn't create that pin?? And most of the time the pin isn't bad it's the system flagging it for no reason. I've seen pins of tattoos, bracelets,song lyrics get taken down for absolutely no reason and half the time when I appeal it still doesn't put them back up and I get in trouble when I'm not even creating those pins anyways??? And pins that actually do break rules don't get taken down!! Another problem is that they keep turning off comment sections for my pins without giving me a reason and each time I turn them back on they immediately get turned off again. I make bracelets and beaded dolls I'm not breaking any rules and no ai is being used. Please fix your system!! Start using real people instead of your useless ai system that can't tell the difference between a completely safe pin and one that goes completely against guidelines.

“I really enjoy using Pinterest because it has beautiful wallpapers, creative ideas, and inspiration. The app is easy to use and fun to explore. However, I’m giving it 4 stars because I had trouble deleting a wallpaper I saved or set. It would be better if deleting wallpapers was easier and clearer. Overall, it’s a great app, but it needs a few improvements.”

i don't know what's happening but after the update when i look up certain topics, it just shows this weird pattern, in this order: an ad, "refine your seach" with a few options, 3 actual pins, an ad, "refine your search" again, and one more picture, and then i can't scroll anymore. or sometimes it's just a repeat of that. keep in mind, what i search up is just characters from games so i would think it doesn't violate any rules?

I’ve had Pinterest for many years and went through the up and downs of the updates. I absolutely love many of the new features and bug fixes that Pinterest has had, I personally dislike the amount of AI I’ve seen lately but it is basically unavoidable. I’m thankful Pinterest has added a feature to detect AI pins although I’ve noticed it is often marking original works as AI which is a tad annoying. Besides this I’m glad I can turn on a feature to see less AI pins and I’ve also been thoroughly enjoying the section option on my boards! Speaking of the sectioning option I would like a feature where I can search for certain sections because one of my boards has over 100 sections and it can be quite a hassle to search for them manually. Although I love Pinterest and I carefully avoided saving pins that may result in removals or warnings I still get emails quite often that pin’s I’ve saved are marked as ‘inappropriate’ simply for artistic nudity, which can be frustrating. Anyway, another issue I’ve noticed lately is many users have been getting their accounts banned or suspended for these warnings, which terrifies me because my account holds many important pins for my projects. Many users suspect these bans are due to the AI Pinterest uses to check for these warnings but thankfully I’ve noticed this issue has subsided. Lastly, I would like to point out that I can no longer favorite pins? The feature has seemingly vanished so I hope this gets fixed! Thanks Pinterest!

I don’t normally write reviews but Pinterest has been very messed up lately. I’ve spoken to other to make sure I’m not the only one and I’m not. Recently, i only save some pins, can rarely download pins, I have to screenshot. It’s been glitching and freezing sm more than before and when I save a pin to a board with sections and I add it to a specific section, I’ll go back to look at it later and it’ll just be in the general board, not any section. Also, sometimes Pinterest flat out deletes my pins. I’ve saved like 10 pins and then I’ll go to look at them and they’re just gone. Not in my “all pins”, not in any board, just gone as if I never saved them at all. I also can’t use the Pinterest widget. I used to have a board widget on my home screen but it recently went black, wouldn’t let me edit it at all. So, I deleted it and then tried to add it again and there wasn’t even an option to add a Pinterest widget?? This all started about 3weeks ago. please fix this, Pinterest, been using your app since 2020 and I love it, but PLEASE fix this.

I’m a longtime user of the app and have stuck with it even as it implemented the excessive number of ads because of its convenience for finding pictures and recipes, but as ai generations and influx of ads has gotten worse and worse across the app and site I find myself wanting to use it less and less. Now with the addition of an ai voice “assistant” being added in the last update I am inclined to stop using pinterest all together. The company that owns pinterest has forgotten that pinterest is a product and that those who use it are not. Please remember that your users are your life blood and roll back some of these updates, such as the ai assistant and the use of ai in sifting through pins for removal, reduce the number of ads shown across the platform as it’s become less of an image sharing one and more of an advertisement space, and crack down on ai generated images by either implementing a more accurate means of identifying and labeling them or by allowing an image to be reported for ai usage and have a human check for legitimacy and if the image or recipe is found to be ai then to have it either tagged as such or removed. Overall I find that Pinterest is going downhill and if things don’t change I will likely be leaving the platform permanently.

reviews.t: New Update is Horrible! Cannot access my secret board sections!
reviews.x: Before the update I could access any of the sections on any of my boards but now I am completely unable to it’s like my sections don’t exist anymore. I have over 30K pins on a single board divided over 17 sections and yet it just shows all of them + a billion ads in between. It’s so disorganized and impossible to navigate. This is especially true with pins in sections of secret boards as I cannot access them at all!! Also half of the boards and app are tings don’t even load anymore since the update! The app is borderline unusable at this point and if I could I’d give it 0 stars. Another issue is that before the update, if a pin had a link attached to it I’d be able to click it and access the website it originally came from and go back on tabs after I clicked it (ex: click on pin with link to Wikipedia and click on a different article but could still use the back arrow to get to the original article). However after the most recent update, I am unable to go back after clicking the back arrow which is quite inconveniencing and annoying. Another factor is the introduction of AI to Pinterest has made the app harder to use and both these issues have overall made the app more difficult to use and not worth the hassle. Until Pinterest returns to how it could be used a month ago myself and many others will not use the app. Pinterest staff if any of you read this it would be a good idea to remove AI from the platform and go back to how the app functioned a year or two ago. Sincerely, an aggravated user of 10+ years

Pinterest is a very good app and amazing!! It's helpful for personal things or being creative I use Pinterest almost a lot because it's more useful than other apps, but there's only one problem the loading of it has been slower and mostly when i click search nothing shows up also when I usually reset it or wait for it to load it never loads I don't why this happens I often think its my Internet connection or something else but I hope you can get it fixed if you can and see if its another problem of why it's doing that Or maybe it's just the Wi-Fi getting bad and being slow I don't really know but I'm letting you know so you can see if it's another problem or it's the Wi-Fi. But overall Pinterest has to be the best app I've ever experienced gives a lot of useful ideas or tips I love it a lot I'm grateful that Pinterest was made it does a lot of things and hope you do good and continue what your doing Also yes please figure out why the loadings have been getting slower if you can I would really appreciate it thanks!!

I never write reviews but this warrants one. My account was recently deactivated for what Pinterest says is violating community guidelines and have received an email accusing me of copyright infringement. I carefully read their polices to follow the proper steps to be heard and receive help in reactivating my account by reaching out to the Help Center. I submitted 3 appeals as well as tried to submit a Counter Notification due to the copyright issue to which it says it was not necessary. I’ve tried to communicate respectfully and clearly to get this issue resolved since I have had this account and been a loyal user for years. My account is on the verge of complete deletion with the only “excuse” being that I saved one simple pin to my board as inspiration. I am not the original poster of that pin, nor was it explicit in anyway. A simple collage for a lock screen. I did not download it to my device, duplicate, distribute, or alter it in anyway. Extremely disappointing that users are being punished for using the app as the creators had intended it. Apparently this was an issue for many users last year as well and I suppose it is an issue still not resolved since it is now happening to me the same time the following year. Their help center is not worth the time since they refuse to help and send the same automated message to each of my appeals without further assistance or clarification on the matter. This issue is a massive blow to their platform and I hope more users speak out about this.

Really good place to look for art inspiration, and ideas when you are able to filter out AI. Lots of good art to look at for references etc. However, I see a huge amount ai generated garbage too, I'm sick of ai generated slop... And it takes away from my searches for actual art or ideas. Ads, There are WAY too much feels like all I see are ads with a few normal posts sprinkled in.. there are far too many.

I love Pinterest and have been using it for nearly ten years. I have boards from over six years ago that I still use, however I have been growing progressively more frustrated with the app. Everytime I open the app it is a gamble as to wether my Home Screen will have the same layout and if I will have to spend time relearning where all the buttons are or will be reverted to an old version. For example a few months ago Pinterest added a feature to the home discover page where you could swipe left and right between discover pages for each of the boards you’d like to see. At first I did not see the point of this feature but have grown to love being able to just open the app and scroll through similar ideas for my niche boards without having to go into the board itself selecting the section and then looking at “more ideas”. Today I opened the app and the function to swipe between boards on the Home Screen was gone. I am honestly just fed up at this point. I understand adding new features to accommodate changing trends and such but this has gone too far. I can’t tell you how many times I’ve opened the app to a new layout, shown my friends only to discover we all had DIFFERENT LAYOUTS on the goddam home page!!! The inconsistency is irritating. I would expect this from a new app/startup but Pinterest is neither of those. I am now looking for alternative apps. Pinterest I hope you’re happy because I am certainly not.

Over the years Pinterest has been dedicated to making their app more and more unusable, punishing their users for reblogging anything other than cooking and crafting pins, and refusing to listen to feedback. Their latest move is the nail in the coffin. Pinterest has been auto flagging pins using AI, to the point that people with no prior strikes on their accounts fully lose access to THOUSANDS of pins, to which Pinterest support shrugs and says “oh well!” Be warned that you could lose your account at any time for no reason. Also, their emails detailing your infractions don’t show you which pin it was, and the document attached carries a link - which doesn’t work when they deactivate the pin. So you won’t even know what it was that set off the alarm. I save fandom works and lord help you if two people are kissing or there is any skin showing. Their metric for “adult content” is puritan standards. Also I consistently get flagged for promoting self harm??? Which NONE of my pins do. AND THEY ARENT EVEN MY PINS. Email the person who UPLOADED THEM, not me!! I have never experienced Such dedication to alienating their long time users but they’ve consistently been making decisions that no one asks for or likes, while taking away features that were helpful and especially that actually made this place a community, for a full decade now. For no reason. The only reason people stay is because no one has made a good free alternative yet. But the time will come, Pinterest.
