reviews.t: frustrating changes to use and features
reviews.x: I have used this app for years and used to love it. However, recent updates have made it increasingly frustrating and inconvenient to spend any amount of time on and to access pins. Beyond actual bug fixes, there is no reason to continually edit the features of your app. This repeatedly has led to the removal of useful and widely liked features such as swiping between pins, swiping down to exit pins, hiding pins you aren’t interested in, viewing the title, caption, and creator of a pin, tapping underneath the pin to visit the site it’s from, and occasionally saving things directly to your profile (this has been removed and reinstated several times). Additionally, such a high percentage of what users see is ads now that it’s genuinely annoying to scroll through them all. The new way links pop up beneath the pin is annoying too. I have read so many reviews recently criticizing recent changes and have even contacted Pinterest myself (to an unsatisfying response). Please listen to your users and actually improve your app rather than making it worse. I just can’t use it anymore, and i’m sure i’m not the only one. [Edit:] While the key features for using the app have since been reinstated, it’s still so annoying and unnecessary to change the features every single week. I suspect there would be many fewer bugs to fix if there were fewer updates as well. I find myself seeing the same pins over and over interspersed with so many ads each with multiple slides, and it’s getting old. Please try listening to users to figure out what aspects of the app we actually like and don’t like, rather than continuing to make your app confusing by constantly removing and instating features.

Hello, I love Pinterest! It is an amazing app to use and helps me with wallpaper and ideas. It’s kind of difficult to understand stand how to use though, like how come some published pieces are a different size then my pins, and my pins already have a preset size. There’s no actual tutorial on how to work Pinterest, only when you’re making a pin and still that doesn’t really help. How do you make the background a photo? How come sometimes when I click on a cutout it give me the whole image? I’ve wanted to get likes on my profile but it’s so hard to understand I don’t even know if I even published it. How do you make videos on there and put links in the description? I also want to add Pinterest as a widget, but when I go to the directions it doesn’t make any sense. It tells me to select a board and then upload it on to the widget? I’m not sure how to do that. I’m very new, but I’m not getting the full idea of what everything means. All I know is how to download and send photos or videos. What are pins exactly? What are collages? What are boards? Please give a full-on explanation on how to create things like wallpapers and posters and how to upload a video so you can post it. Thank you!

I have loved this app for over half my life, ever since I found out what Pinterest was I had used it nearly every single day. I have well over 200,000 pins saved and spent solid months of my life on this app. Recently my account was deactivated, for seemingly no reason. They didn’t even tell me why, the whole time I used this app I commenced maybe 4 times and have never done anything inappropriate or wrong on it. I appealed and it got rejected and I’ve lost YEARS of work, trying to remove as many AI pins as possible, saving this for art, style, food EVERYTHING I probably had over 50 boards with certain ones having over 70 sections. After so much time and love put into this app you would think I’d have gotten a more diplomatic response but no. This app has been taken over by AI slop and money hungry greedy awful people that no longer want to protect one of the last safe and chill social media platforms. I’m so disappointed, I truly loved this app and cannot believe the treatment I’ve gotten after adoring it for so long. I can’t even start a new account because of the ridiculous amount of AI and ugly pins when you first start out on the app, it had taken me years of curating and removing AI pins to actually have a good feed and now it’s all been ruined. I actually cannot even begin to comprehend the sheer amount of disappointment I have for this app, you’ve ruined it.

I’m 22 years old, class of 2021, and have been using Pinterest since I was in the fifth grade. Over time, the suggested pin algorithm got better, but within the past year, it has progressively gotten worse and worse. I can excuse the UI issues that are worked out with each update, sure. But this moderation is insane. You seriously need to evaluate your priorities as a company, and what your guidelines consider “dangerous” or “adult” content, and you desperately need to have humans approve your deactivations for pins and users BEFORE they are instated, not after. YOU ALSO NEED TO DECIDE WHETHER YOUR APP IS FOR ADULTS OR NOT. It is absolutely ridiculous that so many longtime users have been losing their accounts permanently due to your own software’s failures and misfirings. Any hope you have of longterm users having any level of trust for your platform as a method of photo storage or archival is gone at this point. You may as well buy a hard drive, or a bunch of flash drives, and use that as your Pinterest. It’s much more trustworthy. That’s not even touching on the amount of AI content that has been permitted to be not only posted and circulated, but ADVERTISED on this platform. God, don’t even get me started on the progressive increased saturation of advertisement on this website/app within the past few years. If I have three rows of pins showing on my screen at a time on desktop, why are there 1-2 ads in EVERY row of photos? There should be one or two ads per scroll, at most. The oversaturation is ridiculous, but I should have known that that was where this platform was headed as soon as they added the shop option. Pinterest has ruined my experience on its platform despite it being one of the simplest platforms that exists online conceptually. Maybe I should just give up on social media altogether, if not even something as simple as a photo-sharing app is safe from the oversaturation of consumerism.

Love the app been using Pinterest for years but recently it seems like there is some kind of glitch or something because every time I delete a pin off of a board it automatically takes me right back to the top of the board which is really frustrating because I’ll have to scroll all the way back down to where I was then if I need to delete another pin off the board it still will take me right back to the top and I have to go through the process of scrolling all the way back down again which is really annoying when I’m trying to clean up my boards I’ve never had this problem before until recently and I tried deleting and reinstalling the app and trying to always update it but nothing has worked if the glitch could be fixed so that when I delete a pin it just stays where I left off instead of jumping me all the way back to the top of the board again and have to go through the constant scrolling up and down over and over again I would use the app more frequently like I used to

Make it make sense!! The other day I wanted to print and with all the ads my recipe was 37 pages long... 37!! That's absolutely crazy!! This app has turned into garbage. AND no I'm not upgrading and paying for it!!

I think having the more ideas in a different section is a really good idea but when I’m looking at the sections on a board, I don’t wanna scroll down and see just loose pins down there I would much rather them just being in a separate thing and then also when I go to my favorites that also happens as well to wear. I am an avid Pinterest user. Every couple months I go through and reorganize my pins so I know the little things that most might not notice. For example: 1. I could be scrolling through my saved pins like a gallery and long press on the pin and be able to delete the pin no problem. Now I have to come off the pin and scroll to find it just to delete it. 2. I could just save the pin and continue saving but now, every time I do, it goes right back to the top of my saved pins and I have to scroll to find where I was. 3. The AI pins are even worse because Pinterest is just a calm app and they’re trying to fix things that don’t need to be fixed. AI is already stealing from real persons, Pinterest does not need it to make their app better. 4. I used to could go in my boards and see my pins but now the first thing I see is more ideas and I have to be doing jumps just to find my saved pins. 5. The ads. You click on a pin and suddenly you’re on a website page. That is unnecessary. Everything is a money grab now and it shows. These most likely don’t bother other users but I’m an avid Pinterest user and it’s aesthetic makes it my favorite app but they keep making updates that aren’t needed and just making it hard to want to use it.

Pinterest was the best app until about a year ago; that’s when they updated their algorithm to show the same pins over and over again. If you like or save a pin in a specific category, you can guarantee that you’ll see those pins repeatedly anytime you look up something in that category, even if you search something completely different. I saved a pin of a girl wearing a sweater and a skirt, and afterwards, every search regarding clothing would show this same pin along with others; doesn’t matter if I change it to “feminine outfits”, “modest outfits”, “teacher outfits”, “summer outfits”, it’s always the same pins I’ve saved/liked before, even though they’re not related to my search! Same goes for anything: art, nail inspo, clothing, aesthetics, it doesn’t matter. I’ve read tons of “solutions” that involve adjusting the settings at a ridiculous level, which I did to no avail. This frustration has 100% reduced the time spent on this app, and I know I’m not the only one. There are tons of Reddit posts regarding the same thing, all within the past year. I don’t know what the developers did besides ruin a great app. Please fix it.

I moved my review from 5 to 3 stars. Pinterest has gone down hill very fast. I get violations for things that don't go against any guidelines, my account constantly gets error messages, and they really like to push AI images. The AI filters only catch the blatantly obvious AI images. In addition, the amount of ads that fill my feed is crazy. I get 1 ad for every 3-5 photos. It's really sad to see Pinterest shift in the way it has. I wish it would go back to how it was before

reviews.t: I love this app so much
reviews.x: So.. this app is my spirit animal. Aesthetic vibes, finding my mood and my style, it’s just so easy with this app. I have one request. Can you make something like a personal-business account? Like for example, those people who post like sunsets or cloudy skies have business accounts, because sometimes it just feels good to see that a lot of people saved your pin. It’s just that they don’t actually have a business or company, but they want to see the analytics on their pins. For example, I run a fan account for celebs and edit them with filters and things like that. But I don’t have a company, and I just want to post stuff like you post on TikTok. I just want people to see my pins and save them. It’s also frustrating when you run a account like that and somebody steals your pin, because to report the pin you have to enter your “company” details and your home address, and it’s a little bit much because it’s not really a business account I’m running. Ok, now that you understand, can you make a personal-business account? A account thats made to post pins, but doesn’t have the guidelines of an account thats made to promote a company. I hope you can make this, thanks!

hi, i’ve been using pinterest since the beginning, since i started buying phones. the app hasn’t ever changed much and i’ve always adored that about it. but my emails and friends emails are constantly filled with “ your pin was removed for __ “ while yes.. remove the pin if it isn’t safe for your platform. it does not affect US. we do not have anything to do with the the ORIGINAL poster. that should immediately fall onto them and they should receive the email. you’re putting a lot of accounts under stress by thinking they’ll be deleted. having the pins pop up as “ unavailable “ and not just completely removing them from the boards is so frustrating. please bring that back. i am tired of having to delete things from shared boards or my own because someone ELSES pin was deleted. you’re using ai to run your platform now which has made it practically unusable. there so many glitches, with specific board names you cannot update the board? half the time i can hardly even add a cover image to my account. while i do love this app and will continue to use it. i am just hurt about all these updates and glitches.. i fear for my account with THOUSANDS of my boards and pins being deleted because of someone else’s post.

BUT. the messages icon and option is completely gone. i have not changed a single setting, it just flat out disappeared and i cannot see pins that are shared with me, and i cannot use this app properly. i can’t save things to a board and share them no problem but cannot receive a thing. now. i love this app. it is my favorite one. but if this does not get fixed, i’m going to be upset.

reviews.t: ruined. dont bother getting this without an extension.
reviews.x: Pinterest is actively getting worse. The platform keeps incorrectly labeling real artwork and photos as “AI-modified”. they also decided to use AI moderation for some reason so no people are getting unreasonably banned or getting images deleted. also the app is flooded with AI slop from incredibly weird and creepy accounts upload hundreds of photos of AI generated children of organized ages…so yeah. On top of that, search is completely broken. I’m trying to find hair references for a haircut, and no matter what I search, it only shows Asian hair types even though I’m white and have a very different hair texture and structure. The only filter options are “curly, coily, wavy, straight,” which is not enough to stop east asians from flooding my feed??? There should be region or ethnicity based filters (European, African, Asian, etc) or wtv so people can actually find relevant references. This would also massively help artists, since Pinterest already has a serious issue with recommending the same images over and over no matter what your search. And the ads are suffocating. I would genuinely pay for a subscription just to remove ads, but instead the experience keeps getting worse.

reviews.t: They deleted my account of 10 years with no notice
reviews.x: I have been a loyal Pinterest user for more than 10 years. Had thousands of pins I wanted to go back to in the future. A few days ago, I clicked on the Pinterest app and I was logged out. I thought that was odd. So I tried to log back in and found out my account was nowhere to be found. I emailed them and they said my account was suspended due to spam. I tried asking them how to resolve the issue because I am not a spammer. I don’t even know what happened. They then said that they can’t give me anymore information and closed the ticket. I still don’t know why they closed my account. Over the years I have mostly re-pinned what others have posted. So, if I re-posed “spam” it was somebody else’s spam. Only time I posted original pins was when I had a recipe blog and I only posted one pin per recipe. Not spam. So why did the cancel me? Am I a danger to the public good? I had some boards with quotes about culture and Christianity. Is that what it is? It’s ok, they don’t care how they treat a loyal real human, non-spamming Pinterest user. I’m sure they made plenty of money off of me with the excessive amount of ads they have incorporated within the last couple of years. If they keep this up, Pinterest will be going under. A warning to all users: be aware that your account might disappear one day with all of your beloved ideas. Might want to start printing things out and keeping folders the old fashioned way.

Pinterest is not like TikTok or Instagram; it works more like a digital idea board where kids and teens can safely explore and save ideas such as art inspiration, room decor, outfits, recipes, workouts, crafts, and school project ideas. It focuses on images and creativity instead of short videos, which helps reduce screen addiction and removes pressure to post, compete for likes, or follow trends. Pinterest is very useful for learning because it encourages planning, organization, and creativity, and it’s often used for school projects, studying, goal setting, and discovering new hobbies. Accounts can be kept private, content filters and safe search can be turned on, and there is no requirement to message or interact with strangers, making it safer and more controlled than many social apps. There is much less social pressure since kids can use it quietly for themselves without worrying about popularity or online drama, and it promotes positive interests like journaling, healthy recipes, fitness ideas, DIY projects, art, and self-improvement. It is also not owned by TikTok or similar video-focused platforms, which makes it calmer and less overwhelming. Parents can stay involved by checking boards occasionally, setting screen-time limits, and keeping the account private, making Pinterest a low-drama, educational, and creative app that supports healthy interests and responsible screen use for teens.

reviews.t: Keep the and my beloved app here pls
reviews.x: Pinterest is going to be my first review I hope the rumors of Pinterest leaving the App Store and such are untrue as Pinterest has also as allowed me to express my creativity, create ideas and concepts and such from others pins, ideas and boards and being able to make my own also and even with ai some of the ai features I’m happy to say I can turn off basically all off them if you please (as I have done) and the organizing tools for the boards or projects only keeps me on there for hours more I could spend if not or more time on Pinterest than on some other social media apps and I leave feeling better about myself or abt my life in general which I can’t say about of majorly of other social medias and I feel like Pinterest is one of the very few places still left for one to be able to personalize and express there creativity in a more personalized and also less publicized way at times also apart from other apps which I find refreshing so I hope to continue to be able to use Pinterest over the following years just as family has done before me for years before I got my own phone as we’d plan meals, trips, outfits, activities and much more just from ideas/posts from Pinterest, it’s the one social media app I’d keep if I had to choose so please keep Pinterest here if the rumors are true - a Pinterest lover

I used to love Pinterest. Now there are way too many ads and I can't believe they took away the ability to add notes. I had a lot of info in the notes, especially for recipes. They could have kept my notes there.

When I click on any of the boards in my profile, it opens "more ideas" instead of the board I want to see. It's really annoying to have to switch tabs over to my actual saved pins. There's already a button at the bottom of the screen to see more ideas, so when I click on one of my boards, I just wanna see the pins I've saved. I also hate the fake AI pictures but overall a useful app~Edit: Current update seems to fix the issue so I'm happy thank you

advertisements often cover the entire screen for over a whole scroll's length without even leaving space for a full screen of normal pins (AND YOU CAN'T EVEN PIN THEM!!). It's visually overwhelming, UGLY, and makes me feel like I'm being squeezed out of impression money like a used toothpaste tube. And seriously, these ads are so ****ing ugly. Advertisers have absolutely zero grasp on how to make a pin look appealing as well. PLEASE reduce the frequency and size of ads or at least offer a reprieve between them that is larger than a micrometer. It's embarrassing for Pinterest's image and is the reason I'm using it on desktop instead with some DIY tools to resolve this problem, and if you're reading this as a regular app user like me, you should do the same (or at least log in on a mobile web browser). Also, clicking on a board takes you to the 'more ideas' section. The whole point of a board is to save and look back at ideas. It's very very obvious that it's just another way to force ads down our throats since you're too ***** to put them inside people's boards like you want to. To the devs that don't make decisions about the ads: I'm sorry and I love your app and web version, thank you!!!!!

they send out the worst possible updates known to man. change features that don’t need to be changed and only make the ui clunkier (like having “more ideas” be an entirely seperate tab on boards that comes BEFORE the tab with your pins, instead of just opening to your sections & unsorted pins) (or making the ‘pin this’ button so tiny that your chances of hitting it are .33%) and the app less enjoyable. i genuinely love the website & use it all the time but the app is just awful. the worst part about the updates is that you can’t opt out of them or return to what it was before, you’re just stuck with it. not to mention the fact that one of my accounts has this update and the other one doesn’t. honestly at this point i’m seriously considering we heart it😭i’m just so done with this bs. this is all without mentioning the rampant ai pictures that aren’t regulated whatsoever and end up contaminating everything, or the excessive ads that are practically every other pin. so much of the user base is just sick and tired of pinterest and i really can’t blame them!

reviews.t: i wish i could give 0 stars
reviews.x: [UPDATE] had to come back and update my review because pinterest has gotten so much worse… the experience is HORRENDOUS now. sooooooo many ads - more ads than actual pins. it’s like they want everyone to leave the app and keep challenging themselves to make the experience even worse. DO BETTER [OLD] I’ve been using pinterest for most of my life now, and have seen it go through many changes. Some were good, others not so much… but I’ve never lost interest. However, the changes made the past year or two have made this app terrible… it’s like they don’t want to drive away all of their users???? Firstly, the ads have become unbearable. I long for the days when you could scroll without every other pin being an ad. Additionally, The shop function has become increasingly irritating. For a while it was easy enough to ignore. But now it’s constantly shoved down your throat. Want to find similar pins to the one you’re looking at? Here’s a bunch of products you can buy instead!!! Want to search for fall outfit ideas? Well just show you a bunch of ugly, unrelated clothes you can buy instead! Ads and product pushing have gotten exponentially worse in the past few months, but I’ve stayed. But this last update may be my final straw…. The new look for boards is just terribly designed. Why is it that now when I go into one of my boards, I have to basically enter the board a second time?? Who thought that “see more” feature or whatever it’s called was a good idea?? Who actually likes that??? If I go into my boards, obviously I want to see my pins… why else would I?? So why do I now have to take these extra steps to view the pins in my boards??? I miss when pinterest was usable….

In the last two days, the app has had a bug where clicking on a pin results in the screen sliding over to see the pin. After a while, these pins can no longer be exited normally, and exiting the pin shows a zoomed out version of the main feed in which the screen is frozen. The only way to "fix" it is to exit the app and reopen it, which resets the pins and loses your place, but this does not fix the original problem. This happens with most but not all pins, seemingly at random, and it takes only a few minutes for the glitch to occur and make exiting the app necessary. This bug has rendered the app nearly unusable for more than a few minutes at a time. Updating the app did not fix the issue. Unrelated, but recently the app has also been completely overloaded with ads. The ads are not evenly dispersed among pins in the feed, but are all clustered together near the top, meaning you have to scroll to see any pins at all. This detracts from the user experience and makes using the app annoying and not worthwhile. I enjoy using Pinterest a lot, but the incessant ads have prompted me to find content elsewhere.

Overall the app is amazing. Until today. I went the app but it was as if I logged out. But I didn’t. There was either log in or sign up. I went in Log In, I put my email and password but it didn’t work. I tried again and again but nothing. I tried to sign up but when I put my email, it told me to Log In. Please fix this problem because the app won’t let me in. (I forgot my password😔). But I know that that’s my fault. So I decided to create a new account by using the email of my old iPad. Everything went fine, I put a strong password and saved it. But when I put my birthday, it kept saying I wasn’t eligible. I changed it a little bit to see if it would work but nothing. I asked my friends for help but they all told me that they put their birthday yet it worked. I checked to see if I needed to update Pinterest but I didn’t. Maybe it’s just me but there could be a glitch in the app. But besides that, Pinterest is amazing! When I used to use it, it had such great inspo and it worked perfectly. But now I cam’t use it because of this minor problem. Please fix this problem so that me and maybe even other people are allowed to use Pinterest.

I have had pinterest for so so many years and there has been improvements, but there have also been some steps back. For one, there was a steady removal of pins for little to no reason and we couldn’t even see what pins were removed so we could avoid saving them in the future. I know they were cracking down on certain inappropriate content, but it ended up bleeding into very normal content making it harder for regular users to enjoy. Another thing is the ads. It is a ridiculous amount of ads present on the platform to the point where it’s an ad every other pin. I understand a few here and there (like it used to be) but it’s starting to be the main thing on the feed. It’s very annoying and gives sell out vibes. My last grievance is the constant addition and removal of the favorites. It’s like sometimes I can add to favorites and sometimes I can’t, but either way I can still see the ones I previously added. This honestly pisses off the most about the app because why is it a gamble on whether or not a basic function will be available every single time I open the app. The last thing I will say is, what the heck is the problem with me naming a folder “memes”… Bring back the old pinterest at this point. I come here to escape the nonsense of other social media platforms and it’s starting to annoy me just as bad as the others. Update: It’s months later. App still horrible. All these random updates and the app is barely functioning. and ads ads ads everywhere…

I have been using this app for over 10 years, everyday. I love it for inspiration, organization and everything in between. The most recent app update has made me write my first Apple Store review, ever. I have two issues with the update that have made me close the app almost instantly upon opening. Firstly, the point of my boards is to organize my pins. When I go to my board I DO NOT want to see suggested pins and have to click on another tab to get there. My home page is where I browse or clicking on view similar in the board it’s self. This makes the app look messy and adds additional steps I need to take to see what I have organized. “Make it yours tab” adds additional stress. Please make this a tab at the top next to my saves that is optional to click on. Second, there has been something changed with the touch sensitivity. This is something I have never witness before, on any app. While scrolling just about every scroll my finger “clicks” on that post. Then I have to click the back arrow to continue scrolling. I’m not sure if this is to get people to click more adds but it has gotten me so upset I have stopped using the app.

I have been using Pinterest for YEARS (since 2012) and the ads have made this app and website near unbearable to use! The ratio is three ads for every one pin and they now put ads in your boards. It is extremely difficult to see and find things you enjoy especially because the ads almost always are videos and move which creates an optical nightmare to look at when just scrolling. I used to use this app several times a day but now I find that I can’t bare to be on it for more than 5 minutes before becoming annoyed, dizzy and disgusted by what this app has become. There isn’t even an option to opt out of the ads via subscription! Even if I saved one ad for yarn to my crochet board for later, now I can’t find it as it’s buried in a bunch of other ads that have nothing to do with the content of the board! Why am I seeing an Audi ad in my crochet board!? And coming from someone with issues with shaky hands, I can’t imagine the frustration many older people feel and others like me with disabilities that use this app for crafting reasons, having to constantly exit out of dumb ad pages because of accidentally clicking an ad on every scroll. Guess it’s time to buy an ad blocker because this day and age they are everywhere!!!!

reviews.t: Little to no care about users
reviews.x: I love Pinterest, it’s the only social media I will have but these updates show their lack of care for the users in how inconvenient they are making the app. I understand all apps have a million ads, but for everyone one post there are 5 back to back.. it’s a little excessive. But that’s not even the worse thing for me. It is the updates within the boards and saving process. They’ve taken away the fast scrolling method to save a pin, and for someone with a million boards since I’ve been a user probably like half my life at this point, it’s kind of annoying. They also have it so that when you open up YOUR Pinterest board the first thing you see is other suggested pins…. If I’m going on MY page to see that I’VE saved, what sense does it make to have other suggested items show first.. let that be what the homepage and search engine is for. Also another minor inconvenience is how to create sections inside your board.. I literally don’t understand why this changed?? In order to make a section you have to already have saved pins, so if you’re making a new board, you can’t plan out how to organize it first by creating sections then saving ideas accordingly. It’s not huge but it’s a silly inconvenience when it worked just fine and definitely in a more functional way before.

It's good!! I see no reason for anyone NOT to install it! Though, Pintrest needs more diversity in its report button. since there is a lot of art on this platform, it needs more art-based report options! I see too much fanart that isn't appropriate, but because it isn't nudity, and they're often fictional characters (anime characters) I don't know which option to use. For example. I see FAR TOO MUCH art of Rin Okumura being shipped (relationship) with Yukio Okumura, they are BROTHERS.
STOP MAKING YOUR SITE HARDER TO USE! JUST STOP!!!

reviews.t: Copyright infringement causing unfair strikes to the unsuspecting
reviews.x: I’ve had this app for coming close to a decade. That is a lot of memories, a lot of recipes and a lot of material that I will lose if I choose to close out and delete this app. The same for any of my friends that are also having this issue. Unclear copyright is making it to the point where you were putting strikes on unsuspecting individuals who are merely using the app as it was created for. I’m just a repost account. I repost things that make me feel something, that are useful, or even things that I plan to create. That’s going to become obsolete if every time someone fails to vocalize that a picture can’t be that you penalize someone who isn’t even re-creating it and uploading it. That I would understand penalizing. Because that’s actively infringing someone’s copyright. But striking the people who repent someone’s pin because they didn’t know that they weren’t the original. Is going to put a system in place where the pin portion of Pinterest becomes redundant. I genuinely hold love for this app. I grew up with this app. But come on now this is ridiculous. Remove it. I don’t wanna use something that I don’t have permission to have. But do not punish people who don’t deserve to be punished simply because you want to be lazy about how you approach the system. I understand that y’all want sidestep any potential legal liability. Genuinely I get it. But putting strikes on accounts that have nothing to do with the actual problem is hilariously reductive. I love y’all. And I will change my rating if this gets fixed. But if it doesn’t get fixed to my rating stays in my account will be shut down and I will just go to a different app… there has got to be a better solution to this

I loved you, Pinterest. You were a place of pure creativity and inspiration and art. It was far away from the other aspects that haunt other forms of more social media. But you’ve succumbed to the pressure of advertisements and forced us to look at curated boards that we have no option of getting rid of. You’ve begun shoving this consumerism down our throats just like every other place. You were my safe haven from the capitalism of other sites. My favorite trait of yours was your ability to offer me choice. I got to decide what to look at, what boards to create. There is a simplicity in sorting my silly boxes of interests into silly pages of boxes. And now you’re telling me what to look at. What to buy. What to invest my time into. You’ve taken my autonomy - the very thing you that was important to you at the beginning. Your original purpose and meaning. Handed over to corporate America. It’s not just you. I can’t blame you entirely. But I’m sad this world has seeped into you. I thought that if anyone could withstand the forces of corporation, it would be you. I’ll miss you, Pinterest. You’re now a shell of your former self. At least your skeleton still shines.

reviews.t: How do you guys manage to make it worse every single update?
reviews.x: I use pinterest a lot, generally I enjoy it, I’ve noticed a trend in the updates, the trend being either taking functions away or making them so much harder to use. First it was getting rid of the board tabs on the home screen (which did *eventually* get put back), then it was taking away hiding a pin from the hold down menu (which being able to hide a pin without having to click on it just got added back, but only with a tiny three-dot menu on each pin that’s hard to click on), sometimes the “more ideas” tab just disappears, and now when you open a board it shows the more ideas tab FIRST??? *before* the actual board you made. And now the alphabet next to your list of boards when you go to save a pin that you click on the first letter of the board you want to take you to that section, you know, the thing that makes it way easier to find the board you want, is just GONE completely. Can you please make one update i don’t dread knowing it’ll completely mess up my app, if it didn’t start glitching out my app after a while, i would just never update it. The automated pin-violations system is also entirely terrible and broken, I *constantly* get messages about completely normal, couldn’t even be construed as being inappropriate or a violation pins being temporarily taken down, and sometimes they aren’t even reinstated! It would also be nice to be able to see what the pin was that got deactivated so I know both if I should repeal it and if it was a violation, see what counts as a violation. Hire more people. Use less robots that don’t work. Even repealing a violation is terrible because it’s the same robot that tagged it in the first place! Thank you, fix your app.

Pinterest has been a great place to get inspiration, but it feels more and more like you’re sorting through ads than ever before. Pinterest made a recent change: when you open a folder where your favorited pins are saved, it doesn’t just automatically bring you to your favorited pins anymore - it instead opens up a “More Ideas” section where you’ll see suggested pins similar to your other pins you saved in that folder, along with a sprinkle of more ads. At that point, you can switch to “All Saves” where your favorited pins are. While seeing suggested pins related to that folder’s contents can be helpful, there were already ways to do that through the search function, or by going to the home page and choosing one of your folder topics at the top of the screen to show related pins. It’s less convenient now to actually navigate to the pins you saved. And although it takes just one extra click to get to your saved pins by changing from the “More Ideas” tab to the “All Saves” tab, it feels like another way that Pinterest is trying to make money from you by showing you more ads. Saved folders didn’t have ads, but now they’ve unfortunately changed that.

I’ve had Pinterest for over 10 years. I used to LOVE it, but now I’m getting so sick of it. Every update Pinterest comes out with just makes the app worse and worse, and less and less usable. The first thing I see when I open my own boards should NOT be “more ideas,” it should be MY PINS! There’s no setting to turn this off, and it is littered with ads and I have a feeling that’s the only reason it was added like this - to shove more ads in our faces without the option to opt out. Having the “more ideas” button at the bottom was WAY more convenient!! NO ONE asked for this or wanted this! Why do I have to take extra steps to navigate to my own pins in my own board?? AND we can’t see our own headers anymore!! Absolutely ridiculous!! Why even put in the work to make our boards the way we want them to look just for it to be messed up without consent or an option to opt out?? Every time you guys update this app and get a mass amount of negative feedback you do NOTHING about it, you just roll out another update adding more “features” no one is asking for or wants. It’s almost like you WANT people to be more and more displeased with this app, which is very strange. PLEASE get rid of the “more ideas” and ads being shoved in our faces in OUR OWN BOARDS, or at least add an option in settings to opt out. It’s completely useless and unnecessary, it was just fine the way it was when it was just the button at the bottom. You also need to work on reports and violations. Nobody should get ANY strikes or violations for pins that they didn’t even create. Pinterest used to be my #1 favorite app, but I’ve cut down using it so much in the last few years because it’s just become so ridiculous and annoying to use. Fix this and do better!! Try to LISTEN to your users!!

reviews.t: This used to be my favorite app…
reviews.x: Ages ago, when I first joined Pinterest (back when you had to request an invitation), it was creative heaven. You could save all your favorite ideas in one place WITH NOTES *insert glare here*, and not be bombarded with ads on every. single. scroll. I know you guys are a business that needs to generate revenue and you’re trying to go for a “uniform” pinning experience (whatever that means), but I think you higher ups are delusional about what your users actually USE this platform for. We aren’t mindlessly pinning ideas. We’re planning projects, experimenting with style, and tweaking recipes, among other things. Notes are an essential component of that process. Do you forbid your employees of note-taking at work, too, or is it just us users that can’t take notes? Have a heart (and a brain) and bring back notes-to-self! And for pity’s sake, can we calm down with the ads?? I’ve been quietly dealing with these issues since they started popping up a while back, but my nerves have finally snapped. This is ridiculous! Bonus tip to the app developers combing reviews as they look for ways to tap into this vein of social networking (because goodness knows the giant thumbtack could use a little competition), I have a suggestion for you: Let your users take notes. I will spend as much time as possible to move each and every one of my pins from this app to yours in a heartbeat.

Lemme start off by saying I love this app as an artist able to find exactly what I need for inspiration or ideas that may be on the app but I HATE the TOS system bots they have in place they give you violation strikes for pinning the most obscure things that don’t even break Tos guidelines it’s ridiculous it’s makes the app so annoying and frustrating to use cos I have to be VERY careful not pin anything that would trip the tos bots I could pin something as niche and innocent as sonic the hedgehog and I would STILL get a strike even when I’m not using the app I get with something egregious and then when I appeal it and gets reinstated it’ll be image that’s not even THAT bad that it has to be bots making these errors no human would sit up there and make such a claim! it’s like walking on eggshells it’s crazy! As of late I am very annoyed and unhappy with this whole “Pinterest purist” movement that’s happening on the app you can’t even pin anatomy for Pete’s sake! I’ve been trying to find alternatives and I found some but post have a “pin limit” blocked by paywall and I’m writing this review cos I don’t want my account suspended again cos I “somehow” broke the guidelines it’s not fair found recently that when you pin something YOU become the new original poster which is stupid I found the “sensitive image” on YOUR platform why am I getting hit with the gavel for that??

I’ve been using Pinterest since I can remember, I was literally 11 or 12 when I would spend hours scrolling and saving pins I was inspired by !!! But things have changed. I still love to be on Pinterest for a majority of my online time but it’s so infuriating to try to screenshot something on my home page or explore page and…there’s more ads on my screen than inspo. I mean it’s ridiculous, I screenrecorded me scrolling just to look back at it and the amount of ads is disappointing. It makes me not want to use the app anymore and delete it from my phone, turning to only using it on my laptop with an adblocker. I never write reviews but Pinterest is my favorite app that I feel I can’t let go. PLEASEEE REDUCE ADS ON THE HOMESCREEN !!!! update 10/05: i get chunks of ads that take up my entire screen. some of the ads are repeats right next to each other. i wish i could attach screenshots, its so ridiculous. today i noticed that the pictures are grainy until enlarged, which defeats the whole purpose of a mood board. i loved this app so much but why is it getting worse and worse? hardly user friendly anymore.

I've been using Pinterest for over a decade now as a wonderful place to generate inspiration for all my creative projects, to find new sewing patterns, get fashion inspiration, and so much more. I have loved and deeply appreciated this app, but unfortunately the latest update is the final straw and I will be deleting it off of my phone. The presence of ads in the explore feed has become overwhelming, same with the presence of AI. This feels antithetical to what Pinterest is at its core: a place to share creative ideas with other creative people. Not AI slop images and ads for everything under the sun (just saw one trying to sell me tubes of industrial grease??). But the cherry on top of all of this is the way viewing your boards has been changed. Why on earth. Would you make it so when you tap on a board. To view the pins you've saved there. Instead you are just shown a different explore feed of pins you have not saved???!? At the very least just make the saved pins the default, and give the option to view the "more ideas" page. A tailored explore feed for each board is not a bad idea, but that is NOT what you expect to see when you open the board of pins you've saved, and having to go through extra work to access that is a huge PITA. It's very clear that you guys no longer care about the user experience and Pinterest has become a place for testing out terrible new UI and for selling ad space to get $$. It has finally gotten to a point where it's become frustrating to use, and for my own sanity I have to delete it off of my phone, and can only tolerate it on my desktop with an adblocker installed. Nice job guys, you ruined a good thing.

reviews.t: The amount of AI is soul-crushing
reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest for many years and it’s been a great tool for references as I am an artist. I downloaded a few pins matching the term “bread in basket” for a drawing I was doing. On first glance I didn’t see anything wrong but as I was studying the references I realized that every single picture I had scrolled to find and downloaded had AI artifacts (meaning they were AI generated). It got to the point where I had to find pins linking to a website where someone was selling a woven basket just so I could be sure it was a real picture. This isn’t the first time I’ve come across AI on Pinterest, but at this point it feels like you really have to dig to find a single pin that’s not an ad and actually real. Even though I’ve seen a few pins marked as made with AI in the bottom corner, hundreds of thousands still go unchecked. I know a lot of artists feel the same frustration and disappointment that I do with the AI slop that pinterest is allowing on their platform. Not to mention the disastrous effects AI has on the environment. I wish that Pinterest would work to stop promoting this harmful tool.

absolutely fantastic from getting inspiration or references for various things, but the ads are just WAY too much. I am not joking when I say I get more "sponsored" ads than I do regular recommendations. freshly opened app.. I counted 14 or more ads compared to 4 actual recommendations. and reporting them as spam, inappropriate, or simply unwanted, does nothing. it's very unenjoyable when you're scrolling through more ads than stuff you're actually interested in.

Please note that the five-star rating is just so that some people will see this review. I think my genuine rating would be three stars. Pinterest is a great idea for a platform. The issue is that it wasn’t able to be executed well. The algorithm is terrible, and great artists and creators have averages of zero likes on their posts all because the algorithm is horrid at suggesting posts. It’s a risky chance to even begin posting on this app - and it’s very hit or miss. That’s why me and many of my friends have completely given up trying - and in the years I’ve attempted to use this platform, I haven’t seen any changes whatsoever. Additionally, their new “AI moderated” label is completely useless. It’s very obvious that the system labeling posts as “moderated by ai” is AI itself, because of all of the posts I’ve seen with this label, not a single one has been truly AI or AI moderated (according to the creators of these posts themselves). On top of their broken labeling system, Pinterest has decided not to allow ANY sort of appeal. If your post is labeled as AI - that’s it. All in all, Pinterest has done nothing to improve their app and in my opinion it’s only gotten worse. It’s clear that they ignore reviews to keep their company going strong. So my message to Pinterest; It’s completely fine to be sensitive to constructive criticism, but when it goes so far as to harm your own community, it’s an issue. I hope that for once you could consider taking some responsibility and improving your platform.

Pinterest is awful now. There are far more ads than actual pins. Their censoring is ridiculous and they ban pins and send violations for no reason and without showing the issue. I used to love it but it's not worth it anymore. I can't wait until there is a new option, not going to use it anymore. They also got rid of the notes feature which was the most helpful one.

reviews.t: Someone has created a fake page using my info! Please help!!
reviews.x: I just recently purchased a new phone and I was an avid user of Pinterest. So it was a no brainer to download the app onto my new phone. So I could have it available to me when I do begin pinning again. Well. I received a notification that a pin had been reported. So I went on the app to investigate. However, As I am viewing I notice that it was not my Pinterest page at all. My real page has several boards showcasing houses, art, decor, cars, history etc… it also has my user name, a short paragraph stating why I love Pinterest, my first name initial with a period behind it and my abbreviated last name. I also have 1.6k followers and I am following 381 people. I also have a photo up. This page has my first initial without a period behind it and my abbreviated last name, no followers, not following anyone, no photo, wrong birthdate, no boards, no short paragraph. As I investigated further I noticed that it is has recent activity in the notifications area. This is very disturbing to me because I do not like the fact that someone is utilizing any of my information. My real page is still on my Pinterest app on my old phone. I do not understand why when I downloaded the app onto my new phone that this fake page came up. Could you please assist me with solving this problem. It would greatly be appreciated…please help! I love the app and the only reason I gave it one star is because of this situation. It truly deserves better….

1. There are way too many adds, and most (at least the ones that im getting) are adult comics, not exactly the most appropriate content 2. I get notifications of pins that I DO NOT OWN getting deleted and it has costed me once one of my boards, im big into art, anime and all that stuff, and I don’t understand why I huyo be punished for content I do not own. 3. There are time when im replaying with other commenters and I cant bc apparently “they have blocked me” when I’ve never talked to that person before, idk if it’s something to do with the other person but im just confused. 4. The amount of updates, its nice of yall to update the app, and idk how it really works, but the amount of changes feel so absurdly unnecessary imo, with how the boards looked before and after, how to manage ur accounts information, etc. 5. Personal one, I’ve been having issues with the “age” regarding my account, it seems me as underage when the age that’s on the (my) account isn’t my actual birthday, and that has limited my interactions, even tho I understand why, I’ve been having a difficult time changing it, I’ve went multiple times to the Pinterest support page or whatever it’s called, and I need more clear instructions.

I've been using Pinterest for ~10 years, and have saved thousands of pins in that time. In the last few months, though, it has become completely unusable to me. Scrolling the home feed, around 40% of what shows up is advertisements and sponsored content. That is a fully unacceptable amount to me, as it makes using the app far more frustrating than inspiring. Additionally, the video ads auto-play regardless of your settings. I don't get many non-sponsored videos in my feed, but for those that do come up, i have settings applied such that i have to tap the pin for it to start playing - and this is how i like it. You don't get that option with advertisements. In order to grab your attention, they will automatically play video content. If that wasn't enough, there is an unbearable amount of AI content here. I do a lot of knitting and crocheting, and the amount of AI pattern scams I've found on Pinterest is appalling. I report and hide the pins, and then just see them again the next day. It is a pointless and sisyphean effort. I don't want to stop using Pinterest, because I have so much saved there that i want to reference and see, but at this point, the app is completely unhelpful. I've deleted Pinterest and am finding alternatives for all the niches that i used it for. I'd love to try it again if something changes, but I'm not holding out hope.

Nothing makes me feel like myself quite like Pinterest. From a million different feeds for every part of my personality, to an amazing UI, to the kindest comments I’ve seen on any social media app, Pinterest is the only social media that actually feels welcoming. Every board feels like a working inspiration and part of my life, every quote I see on my feed feels like something that could change my life. Pinterest can be anything you want it to be, from a kinder Instagram to a relaxed creative outlet for meticulous boards and collages, to a less addictive TikTok, to even a sort of reflective journal, each board unlocking a new part of your personality and aesthetic. Constant small updates make the experience a little happier every day, and even some of the pins make me smile just by seeing them even in my photo album, showing that the slightly addictive aspect, unlike other social medias, isnt used to replace or even as a main hook to lead to the quality of content. Thank you Pinterest, you make me happier every day.

Hello. I had been using Pinterest for quite a long time --- It's good for searching any accesible things for inspirations! But there are some problems 1. My pinterest keep having error where they show images at first, then it went "Sorry, there's no result for this image". 2. Whenever I go to other people's account, the image would appear in "create" then it disappered. 3. I have so many boards, but. . . when I open my account, it said "find new ideas". please fix this.

reviews.t: From a mostly mobile app user
reviews.x: Hiding our pins so we have to manually see them and showing us suggested pins instead? That’s like opening the silverware drawer but to get the silverware you have to remove the layer of napkins EACH TIME stacked on top of the silverware. Sound stup1d? Of course, because it is. 😖 I hope you guys are able to get your 8 hours of sleep so you can regain your brain power. If ideas are perhaps exchanged at a table or an online meeting, I would even say sticking to gossiping about each other would be more productive than coming out with an update 🥰 or so it seems with the updates coming out for the past 5 years. Let’s eli5. Honey, your first idea was so good! I’m so proud of you! Let’s keep it simple okay? Sometimes when we want to make something even better, we add TOO MUCH that IS NOT NEEDED. Like a cake. Cakes are yummy right? Now what happens if you add pistachio, banana, cotton candy, vanilla, raspberry, lemon, coconut, and carrot flavor go it? Yeah we don’t need a cake like that :) Anyway, the board image tabs on top of the app are an eyesore, starting with the colors of the for you tab, it’s giving me when I need a color randomizer, mmm! nothing stirs my creativity and productivity like an icon resembling Chiclets gum!, pure opinion ofc. Things I like: the ability to archive boards, the options given when you click on the three dots of a pin, and the refresh of the home page. This is my favorite app after all. I just go ?????????? a lot.

reviews.t: If you remove a pin, how am I supposed to know exactly what the violation was?
reviews.x: Some of the pins I've managed to guess which they are but most I can't and I'm just left wondering and then the problem is a comic depiction of a folklore monster. No violence, no gore, no sexual content, just a monster. Classical art is a violation for some reason. Some of them were art references for hugging. A woman showing off an outfit that covered everything and wasn't skintight or sexual at all. And I know that some of them were reported simply because they were gay or other queer representation there based on the boards they were from. Your violation reports are a roulette wheel. But I can't really tell because you won't let us see which pin it is. Also your ads are ridiculous, literally make like, a separate section just for ads that we can accidentally click every once in a while but I would actually like to look at things and not ads. Also some of your ads violate your policies, which feels a bit hypocritical, but, you know, you do you.

I’ve been on Pinterest for a ridiculous amount of years- since you had to be INVITED by someone already on Pinterest-remember those good ole days? Yes, well me too. It’s next to impossible to get ahold of a PERSON now, however their AI goes to town banning pins, informing me I’m breaking community guidelines usually for something I find humorous. Please note, I don’t create my own pins, thanks for punishing me for repinning the content already ON here and then doubling down by threatening to delete an account I’ve had for well over 10 years. Furthermore you don’t even let me know which pins you find so offensive, the email just states “Don’t do this again..or else” and leaves me with no idea how I offended. Which again, I don’t create my own pins- I repin cause I’m lazy like that. I have carefully curated boards over the span of a decade, and on top of this AI bullying, I can no longer manage my own feed. I can’t select a pin and let them know, hey yeah the camper lifestyle is not my jam thanks, so I have countless pins I just scroll past along with the 90% ads now absolutely SATURATING my feed. So, yes I still utilize this app, it’s okayish heavy on the ish cause I do love the idea Pinterest was originally built on, but it would be amazing if a person or persons read this and said, you know maybe we could take a step back and make this app FUN again. Just a thought from a longtime user.

I’ve loved this app since I started using it. I’ve connected with many fan bases and found many new interests based off suggestions of the pins I’ve saved. There’s a lot of relatable content that isn’t just the picture perfect facade you’d see on most social media platforms. There’s also tons of helpful advice from people if you’re looking for specific content or just want advice from someone to be your older sibling that you otherwise wouldn’t know beforehand. There’s only one thing I’ve ever found frustrating with the app. I’ve found that after you leave the app, even if it’s still in your open tabs, when you come back to it the pins will refresh. I personally find this annoying because there may have been something I wanted to explore or save but hadn’t had the time to check it out, and then I’m not able to look into it afterwards. Something like having the feature to just refresh the page yourself instead of every time you click back into the app may be more beneficial to users.

Pinterest has always been a must have tool for me, either by using it on desktop or on my phone. It’s an amazing place to get ideas for food, DIY projects, art, crafts, and so so much more. I use it for inspiration for pretty much everything. I also love that there is a business account version where I can grow my following, post my content, and watch the interactions with my posts. Ultimately what I love about Pinterest the most is it becomes the space you create. However I do feel that there are a few things that can be updated and taken out. There are way too many ads now, practically my whole feed is purchasing options and advertisements. While I do like the option of when looking at certain pins that it gives you a link to visit their website, the shopping feed is not what Pinterest is. Neither are the constant ads that replace pins. Another thing that I think would increase interaction with pins is when you visit the app, the pins don’t automatically refresh. I can’t count the amount of times I have opened the app and seen a pin I’d like to save but can’t get to because the feed refreshes automatically. The next thing I’d like to add is i constantly get emails about “violating community guidelines” for pins I’ve saved. Recipes, craft inspiration, character designs, and quotes. It’s more so off-putting since it isn’t any of the pins I’ve created, yet saving seemingly harmless pins is in violation.

I'm sick of getting notifications what seems like once a month for things that typically aren't even a problem or otherwise are a problem but aren't my responsibility. To elaborate, the violations are: NOBODY is allowed to save a pin of their favorite anything if it happens to be copyrighted and someone comes to Pinterest claiming it. Suddenly, you lost sight of what your app was made for. FANS!! People who love pinning things that they adore. You cannot seriously expect all of us to check every. Single. Picture we look at across several websites to make sure it's not stolen or worse, criminal, before saving it to a board. That's the responsibility of the person UPLOADING it, not the person pinning it, but sadly, you have a urgent bug on your app you refuse to fix that shows whoever pins something as the same person who uploaded it. PLEASE get it fixed. I'm tired of getting constant violations notices that should be going to the uploaders instead for burdening EVERYONE with them. I mean, come on, a rose bush wallpaper is adult content now? You might use an AI for this and it's just not working. The quality of the reports are terrible and the rate at which they get recalled isn't worth it. Pinterest contains 80% ads, 9% AI, and 1% what I'm looking for these days, it feels like. I miss the old Pinterest. I've already been looking into alternatives because of how far this app has fallen. Basic research on the Internet paired with a physical journal has mostly taken its place now for me.

I get why ads exist but when you’re scrolling for ideas and every time your eyes fall on an ad… Congratulations you have figured it out, optimized for ad viewing. And I have not seen a single pin I searched for even though they are there buried. My eyes used to skip over ads and I would still enjoy pinterest but now you skip over where the ad is and your eyes fall on another ad and you look next to it looking for an idea pin but yet theres another ad. You scroll in frustration and the first thing you see is another ad and once again your eyes shift away quickly because you’re not looking for insurance providers or clothing and all you see are more ads. The ads are the star of the show. User experience is terrible. Like I said they figured out how users skip ads and placed them strategically so you have to look at them. Even when ads are relevant to the ideas you are looking at, but then you click on it and it takes you out to open a web page, interrupting your experience. Not to mention the AI art everywhere. I miss the very old pinterest. App deleted but will be checking in a few months to see if its better.

reviews.t: Great app (I recommend listening to this review)
reviews.x: I love Pinterest a lot and here is why… at first i downloaded Pinterest bc it got a lot of hype. Now I use it regularly I love it. There are a lot of ideas on Pinterest. I love cooking so I search up recipes all the time and it gives me so much to choose from like you can search up protein sugar cookie recipe and there will be more then 100 different recipes to choose from, and it gives you the recipe wich is heplful sometimes I will search something up on a diff website and it will give me a picture but not the recipe. PINTREST also gives me different styles that I might want to try or outfits. For school or on the weekends I’ll go on pintrest and say Preppy and Cute outfits and it will give me so many opinions. Pintrest has expanded my palette and I have tried new recipe and outfits that I normally wouldn’t try or wear. Pintrest also just has funny memes and stuff I scroll on pintrest when I’m bored and my parents always hear me laugh out loud. Going with styles they have cute new in style hair styles and one of my favorite hairstyles actually came from Pinterest, and anytime I go to the hair salon I get a inspo pick that I want to get. And don’t worry about the hairstyle not looking good on you and ur hair type at the top when u search up hairstyles it pops up different hair types including: Curly, Wavy, Straight and more. Also has more including wanting to find a cool and relaxing vacation spot or looking at wedding venue ideas and more. Pinterest is one of my favorite apps and has caused me to do new stuff including cooking, finding new styles, new places ,new hair and funny videos finding my humor I 100% recommend downloading pintrest

reviews.t: Great, but I must address something. (sorry if the review is long btw)
reviews.x: Okay, so don’t get me wrong, it is an amazing app. It’s (mostly) incredibly kid-friendly, and, well, there are other great things about it that I could put in this review, but that would make it too long. You may be wondering: “Well, if it’s such a great app, why didn’t you put in five stars?” I didn’t put in five stars because of the AI. All the AI pins are just absolutely cluttering up Pinterest, and it’s making it impossible to find real stories that happened, real images that people photographed, real things, real drawings that people put their time and effort into making. In the words of this one person who also addressed this problem (I forgot her name): “So see, if I search up garden, and I scroll around, all of it is AI; there’s this AI cat here, and then there’s this ‘garden’ here that is absolutely AI;…” and this is becoming a bit of a long review, but please. Somehow remove the AI pins, or at least put in a filter button in the settings that people can turn on to filter out AI pins somehow. Or like really, any type of pins they /absolutely/ do not want on their feed. Pinterest was used for finding inspiration - real things that real people did that inspired other people, that were put so much time and effort into, not just something ‘inspiring’ generated with the tap of a button. People get inspired from real, true things. Not AI.

Pinterest was my go to for inspiration, building mood boards just everything. Now it's basically a feed of nothing but ads and AI. You don't even require that people say it's AI, so you're literally allowing fraud. Shoppable AI pins are FRAUD! I just can't use this anymore, human content first. Hope you learn to do better.

I wanted to make an account you have to be at least 13 years or older. Tell me why no age work they wanted you dead well not really because you couldn’t be dead so they didn’t want you to be even existing just join the account or make your account so after like 20 minutes of doing thisno matter how hard you try it just wouldn’t work both my emails didn’t work. They wouldn’t take the age it was given so yeah you guys keep being so dramatic about how old they have to be when really you can’t even be at age clearly in y’all’s app I’ve never seen an app that wouldn’t even let you put an agent and I just kept saying it’s invalid like you tell me I can’t be born in 2000 like you’re telling me for example I don’t know. I was born in 2001 OK yeah by now I’ll be sure over 13 and you have to be over 13 to meet their guidelines OK so then why tell me it wasn’t even working saying I was too young you’re killing people that they’re too young when they’re sure about like 21 so yeah, either you guys learn how to fix from your mistakes or you’re just gonna keep getting bad reviews like I have to go through Safari just to do this all for what?

don’t normally write reviews, and i’ve been a dedicated, avid user of pinterest for years now, but the app is near unusable since the last update. there are at least two visible sponsored posts at any moment as i scroll along my homepage page. with iphone ui, that’s at least half the content on the screen at any one moment. none of the content that is being advertised is in any way related to what i am intending to search for. i’ve managed to steer clear of the frankly unmanageable amount of generative AI images infecting the site within the last year, but clearly pinterest execs are still intent on driving out their remaining user base through other means, like oversaturating them with irrelevant, repetitive, and un-closable sponsored advertisements. i will never purchase anything advertised to me in this way, in fact i will actively avoid any brand that i take notice of being this aggressively pushed towards me. either let users dismiss the sponsored posts when they are presented, or if this is a change that is intended to be pushed out to all users, expect for your active site users to continue leaving for other platforms.

Long review so buckle up! I’ve been using pinterest since launch and stuck with it through out many, many changes. Good, bad, confusing - pinterest tended to remain the same enough to allow for the way it was used to continue to feel the same. These changes lately however (ever since the implementation of the wonky violation notice system that punishes everyone rather than solely a pin’s creator), the ads which feel like they ratio pins 1:1, the lack of filtering ai, the ‘tiktok-ification’, the poorly filtered or strangely censored search functions. On top of unintuitive ui (app not being proper resolution, can no longer easily swipe to previous pin/page, menu bar disappears, etc) the site/app seems to have even reset user data and I’m being flooded with all the beige mom lifestyle pins I successfully filtered out years ago. I find myself spending less and less time here because pinterest stumbles over itself more than ever. It’s heartbreaking but such is the nature of time and change. I loved pinterest but my times been spent downloading my pins for a future move. Honestly just twiddling my thumbs until refern gets an app or cosmos gets more meme-y.

Thousands of users are having their accounts banned and deactivated for no reason, losing years of work. Every time they reach out to help, they get no response, an automated response, or get told they can’t have their account back. Meanwhile, Pinterest continues to post on social media that they’re “committed” to making Pinterest a safe and enjoyable place, while they can’t even be committed to listening to feedback and actually doing something about issues users experience. Pinterest continues to refuse to acknowledge this properly or do anything about it, and for one key reason: they are using an AI moderator, this moderator is clearly not functional and harms the users, but Pinterest doesn’t have to pay AI like they would have to pay real employees. So, despite the fact that thousands are outraged Pinterest continues to ignore this problem in favour of saving money. This site is nothing but an ad gallery and AI slop and is constantly dysfunctional. Conveniently, a lot of negative reviews about this problem get hidden some how and of course they instead only show positive reviews across the web to further avoid accountability, some of these responses are even created by the team themselves to help boost ratings. Don’t bother downloading this app, you’ll lose everything anyways even if you never post a single thing and they will literally never do anything about it.

reviews.t: used to be great, now its not so great
reviews.x: I’ve used pinterest for a while, and it’s one of my favorite apps. However, I think the search algorithm is absolutely broken and ruins user experience. Every time I search for something, all of the results are ads. I try to avoid this by going to my “more ideas” tab in my boards, but I get more ads. This is so frustrating and it feels like I’m in a virtual mall. There used to be an option for you to filter out “products,” but of course that was removed. You can’t even select “not interested” on ads anymore. This is pathetic. I am becoming more and more annoyed with the app as it becomes harder to find unique, aesthetically beautiful, and authentic inspiration. What gave Pinterest it’s magnetic appeal is now being rooted out by brands that all look the same. It’s like turning an art museum into a shutterstock gallery. Honestly worse than that. PLEASE CHANGE THIS. I feel like this will eventually bring about the end of Pinterest and I would absolutely hate to see this happen.

reviews.t: I love it however recently there’s been issues.
reviews.x: Pinterest has been my to go to for years but recently has been having many issues especially with the app. My app just freezes all the time, I’ll save a pin, it freezes, and I can’t do anything, I won’t be able to see my search or profile button at the bottom, it makes me simply see the image, I can’t even scroll. And often times I lose the pin I was on upon closing and reopening. If you are considering Pinterest I also want to bring up their new AI they have in place, it has been banning innocent accounts (I watch it give me violations constantly for nothing that violates their rules), has so many ads now, and quite frankly has made the app unbearable. I recommend looking at it in the Pinterest Reddit group, it is very useful in telling you all that is going on with both the website and app. I hope Pinterest fixes itself, it is so unusable I myself am considering leaving if it can’t be fixed. If you feel alone with all these issues don’t be, there is thousands upset and some who have already left because of what’s going on.

reviews.t: It’s becoming more and more unusable each update.
reviews.x: These updates actually drive me insane because saying “we want Pinterest to be at its best each week” doesn’t really mean anything when you are just making it worse and worse. I never minded it much, the way the ads were everywhere, the way the titles of pins were unreadable because I couldn’t expand them, and the way the boards got more and more unstable each time I used the many features. But now it’s almost unusable. Videos are hard to play, either the audio doesn’t work or the video is stuck on one frame. Pictures barely ever load anymore. And now, my biggest complaint, you can’t scroll horizontally anymore? The thing I loved about Pinterest was the easy access to new ideas and the ability to scroll through things that were all in the same category, but now you can’t. If you drag your finger along the screen right or left it stays on the one pin. It actually drives me insane because that was something that allowed me to stay loving Pinterest for so long. Now it’s just inconvenient, unnecessary, annoying, and hard to use. I don’t see any appeal from this feature.

I loved pinterest, it was really helpful for looking for references for art, outfits, whatever, but the recent surge in AI has made it IMPOSSIBLE to navigate. Somehow I keep getting SO MANY AI pins when I specifically hide every single one. Not to mention, the AI moderation approach that they’ve taken is terrible. I personally haven’t been banned for no reason, but so many people that I know have, and the appeal process, from what I’ve heard, is a nightmare, most times not even garnering a response from the tech support people. Similarly, SO MANY pins are randomly deactivated despite numerous ads being far more against the guidelines. I remember I had a pin of a ball-jointed-doll saved (nothing inappropriate about the photo, mind you), that got deactivated for “adult content”. In the same breath, Pinterest will gladly show suggestive ads for mobile games or whatever. AI is ruining this app, and I can assure you that there are better ones out there for inspiration that’s actually human made. The AI content (both pins and moderation wise) has created an incredibly dystopian environment on an app that I used to love, stripping it of the creativity that it claims to inspire. AI is not required for this app to function, we know that for a fact. Hire human employees, discourage AI content. Do better.

I really used to love this app. I've had it and used it for a long time. And I get that ads pay to keep this app going and stay free. But it uses to be like every ten or so images I'd get an add. I was ok with that. Now?! It's like every other one is a damn add! Or getting like 3 or 4 bunched together. The bam two more after scrolling a tiny bit. I used to scroll this app for fun. Now I'm only on it to look for specific things.

Has fostered such a great community on the site that it's genuinely probably the best of social media, compared to social sites like Twitter, Pinterest feels like heaven because you don't have to deal with as much hate speech or bots (kind of). That being said, the ads are OUT OF CONTROL. Roughly 50% of the "pins" you will see will be ADS. At times, it is hard to immediately tell the difference between an actual pin and an ad. At this point, it's essential to use an adblocker of some kind when possible to avoid all the sponsored posts and ads. Hilariously, I used one on desktop and all of a sudden, there were HUGE chunks on empty space that took up most of the screen. Really showed just how many ads this site normally uses. I understand you need to advertise for profit, but the sheer number on a single page make it unnecessarily difficult to use or navigate. Even a small reduction in the number would be helpful. AI is also becoming an issue they refuse to acknowledge. Considering the age of your primary user base, you might want to step up, like NOW. If the rampant AI isn't dealt with now, you're going to become the new Facebook.

reviews.t: This app has gone down hill
reviews.x: Usually I’m not someone to write reviews but this is a necessary moment. I’ve been using Pinterest for 10 years using it on my mom’s phone as a child to look at fan art of my favorite characters. Within these years I’ve seen the good updates and the bad updates but we’re currently in the ugly. Ever since Pinterest has added this ai moderation pins and accounts have been unjustly removed with no proper explanation. The other day I woke up to find out my account was suspended and I only found out because I tried logging in on my computer and receiving a pop up saying my account was as deactivated then followed by an email saying someone tried to log into my deactivated account. I never deactivated my account. I’ve sent in 3 appeals, a Twitter message, and messages on Instagram with no help. Pintrest is killing their app. They’re even deleting comments and straight up disabling them on their social media accounts. They claim they’re going to fix their app but this has been going on for a year and that’s only up to my knowledge. Please Pintrest stop being cheap and hire actual people to do the moderation. This ai is getting out of hand. It’s removing everything that was either human made art or anything that isn’t ai at all but ai art hasn’t been removed yet. This is completely unfair for artists who use your app for references and inspiration. Unban all these unjustified bans and give us our accounts back, this AI is killing your app and you’re ignoring it. You want to wonder why your stocks are dropping when you’re the cause of it. Also please stop ignoring my appeals and unban my account: MorningStariie
