it used to be a great app, like 7 years ago. now, you scroll through 100 pins and only six of them are not Ads or AI or Sponsored and if you happen to click on that sponsored pin while you’re scrolling, it throws you out of the app and into whatever is being promoted. the formatting for the individual pins is really cluttered and you can’t see all of the pin- it gets cut off at the top where the camera bar is and multiple buttons cover what feels like half of the pin photo anyways. also when you swipe through a bunch of individual pins, you would expect that when you get out of swiping through individual pins, that you’d leave off at where you finished swiping. nope! you’re back at where you started and you have to scroll down to where you have new content. I also keep getting adult content and self harm violation notices for stuff that isn’t even remotely close to those topics. I tried a few months ago to voice my opinion to pinterest themselves but they did NOT care at all and gave me an answer that essentially said “too bad so sad.” i’ve been considering taking my pinterest activities to another app that’s similar but better. ugh, it used to be a fun and super useful app… i’m sad to see it in the ruined state that it is. hopefully the pinterest execs see our grievances with their app and realize that they can fix it.

I really used to love Pinterest and use it everyday, but recently it started getting so annoying I hate it now! Because of their so-called “community guidelines” and “policy”. because they started removing and giving me reports about pins that are so normal and didn’t go against their community guidelines! Like, one time I saved a pin that was about a girl licking some kind of candy, and that had no sexual hints, and they removed it and said that it’s adult contact, like, what the heck is adults contacting that?? And also one time I saved a tutorial for painting socks and shoes that didn’t have any sexual or obvious body parts and they removed it and said it’s adult content too. And also one time I saved a a tutorial for painting a tummy, that had no obvious private body and also removed it as usual and said that it’s adult content. And they threatened to ban my account for saving lots of self harm content, when I literally didn’t! Because the only pins that they claimed to be “self harm content” were pins of healthy diets and work outs that had nothing harmful in them! And even in their community guidelines, they said that they can accept some nudity in paintings and science, and that’s literally what I saved! Because the only pins that I saved that they claimed had “nudity”, were paintings! And they weren’t even nudity because they were painting for tummies or thighs that had NO private or sexual body parts! So almost all the reports that I got are false. I wish they see this review, fix their mistakes, and stop giving me false reports.

I absolutely loved Pinterest. I’ve had an account and been extremely active for the last 6 years. If I literally my whole world, and I have over 280 boards and I’ve saved over 50,000 pins. I have my whole life on there; plans for my future, hair ideas, everything. I used it extensively for inspiration for both my art and other aspects of my life such as hair dying and piercings. It was truly an amazing app and I loved it with my whole heart. But just two days ago my account got banned- or suspended. I can’t tell. But either way, I am no longer able to access any of my boards, my home feed, anything about my account. And all of my boards and my whole Pinterest presence is now gone. It is heartbreaking. I really really really urgently need this so be fixed because I am not losing six years of my life to this mistake. And don’t get me wrong, I wasn’t banned for violating any community guild lines or anything- I was always an appropriate account and never did or said anything that could lead me to this point. This must have been a glitch or fault of the Pinterest moderators because this is happening to too many people recently. I need my account back.

I have been using Pinterest for around seven years now, and only in the past six months have i had violations on pins, that are not even mine, show up. I have had 12 violations that, when reviewed, do not violate guidelines at all. I have a board dedicated to pictures of eyes, three pins from that board has gotten flagged as self harm. A picture of an eye was flagged under the self harm genre. Also, treating pins that I have only saved and not created myself the same as if I did create them is unfair. I love Pinterest dearly, but their use of AI and corner cutting systems to make their platform more marketable is incredibly disappointing. Along with their use of AI, Pinterest’s response to people losing their decade old accounts to bans has simply been “appeal it🤷‍♀️” as if the appeal doesn’t go through the exact same program that banned them in the first place. The lack of care is deeply saddening, and it seems I and many other people will have to find another app to use until it feels safe enough to use Pinterest without fear of losing everything you’ve saved. Please listen to the people and don’t go down in infamy like all the other social media websites.

reviews.t: Used to Love, Now Overrun with Ads and AI
reviews.x: Used to be my go to when looking for new ideas, tutorials or just relaxing. But over the past year or so, every time I open the app it ends up being an endless scroll through ads and AI generated „tutorials“ and „recipes“ that are misleading at best and non-functional or harmful at worst. An ad here or there is fine, I understand the app has to monetize something, but if I‘m seeing 3-4 ads on my screen at anytime while on the app and I‘m lucky to see even two pins of content that aren’t AI slop, then that’s too much. There’s also no way to report AI generated content specifically that the current options only partially cover, and again the AI generated content I have an issue with in regards to Pinterest is tutorials, recipes and DIY generally that’s been generated and doesn’t do what it claims or shows AI generated results that aren’t realistic or accurate. At best there’s the misleading section to report to but this doesn’t allow users to provide more context for why and inevitably the AI generated slop is restored. This combination of overly aggressive advertising to the point pins don’t even show up and decent content being crowded out by fake and misleading (and unintelligent) AI slop is making the app unusable.

Too much AI! AI slop is flooding mine and others feeds, regardless of the subject matter. AI moderation is leading to pointless bans of innocent people. Also there are way too many ads. There are so many ads, it's so distracting, many are even inappropriate NSFW ads. Fix this! Pinterest used to be such a good platform for art and inspiration! The experience is completely ruined now.

reviews.t: Account of almost a decade deactivated
reviews.x: My account of almost ten years that had almost 3k followers and thousands upon thousands of pins saved to very meticulous curated boards was deactivated because of pins that I saved that were “against the policy guidelines.” Not pins that I uploaded to Pinterest, but pins that I just saved. Then they don’t even show you what the pins were that were supposedly against the guidelines. It took them months to get back to me after trying to appeal my account a million times. Only for them to send an automatic two sentence message (probably AI generated, much like everything about this app now) saying my account is permanently suspended, of course not responding to my many concerns that I included in my appeals as to why the heck they would suspend my account. And maybe I’m being dramatic but that account had very important boards that not only did I use every day for inspo but planned on using for the future, like my wedding for example. Additionally, I would clean out videos from my TikTok account, Insta account, camera roll, etc, and put them on Pinterest to save space. And I cannot just get those years upon years of pins back. Save yourself any heartbreak and just do not get Pinterest if you have not already, otherwise a decade of followers, pins, memories, and inspiration might be forever lost in the void all because AI apparently runs this app and is in charge of getting rid of content. Plus, all you see on the feed now is advertisements, some that I do not understand how they follow Pinterest’s very strict policy guidelines.

reviews.t: Stop the AI Slop and Ads!
reviews.x: Pinterest has become one of THE WORST apps/sites to find inspiration. For every pin, there are at least 3 ads. Once, I loaded up the app and it glitched and showed me nothing BUT ads. The search page is getting overrun by needless AI slop. You look up room decor? Boom. Dozens of AI images that don't make any sense and are terrible to look at for actual physical projects. You look up cute pictures of birds to draw? Sorry, none of that for you. You get AI slop of fake birds. I'm tired of seeing an app that its SOLE PURPOSE is to give you inspiration for ART AND DIY PROJECTS become absolutely flooded with false images of things that you can't make, you can't build, and you can't draw because IT ISN'T SENSIBLE AND NEVER EXISTED. The AI thing is even worse with the constant false reports and copyright strikes everyone's getting on their accounts and PINS THAT THEY DIDN'T EVEN MAKE. Why should WE be banned for pins we only SAVED? How are we supposed to know what is and isn't right to save when it comes to copyright strikes? Take action against the ones who originally uploaded the pins, not the ones who save them. Pinterest Team, PLEASE stop this nonsense or your app is going to be unused and rot to the ground. If you care about your app, which I highly doubt at this point you do, then actually get a team to moderate the reports coming in. Stop making AI do ALL of the work because it's simply not working! And PLEASE give us an option to hide all AI images and make it REQUIRED to make people disclose whether or not an image is made with AI! Don't have an automatic system that does it for you because a majority of the AI pins are NOT labeled!

I love Pinterest to death and have been using it for years because it is incredibly fun to put together boards that tell stories, help me visualize, be creative, and enjoy content from others that pulls together ideas. In the last two years it has become so irritating if there was competition would immediately jump to it. The app is unusable without ad block, no matter how many times I click “not interested” 90% of the ads I receive are links to some crazy diet accompanied by visual imagery about what parts of the body could be skinnier. The kind of sleazy, bizarre ads you find on webpages and sites. In addition I’ve been receiving warnings on my account threatening to ban me because pins I’ve reposted have been flagged for nudity, or violence, or other crazy stuff. A naked arm is nudity, a picture of a sword is extreme violence, it’s completely ridiculous. A site that is often used by writers and creatives should not be overly censored in this way otherwise there’s no point in using it. It is irritating in the first place that people who didn’t create a pin, just saved it, get threatened with action. I have loved using Pinterest, but now everything good about it is spiraling down the drain and it’s not getting better soon because nobody in charge of the app cares about user experience.

I used to LOVE pinterest. I’ve had an account for like 5 years and consistently upgrade and add to it, always making a new board or adding pins to my current boards. it was perfect. then like two weeks ago, i tried to log in and it said my account was suspended for “unusual activity” and id have to contact them to reactivate it. well i did that, and for a couple days there was no response so i tried again. then about a week ago, i got an email (again, from an AI bot) saying that they couldn’t do anything and it was suspended for “violating community guidelines” even though I myself don’t post any pins nor do I comment anything. I simply just add pins to my boards. They didn’t even give me any sort of warning or evidence that I violated the guidelines. After looking it up, I saw numerous other people experienced this same thing - because of AI. it’s ridiculous. it’s faulty and needs to give me my account back. I need it for school because I had boards for my AP art classes, and even then, I just want it back because I had so many pins on there and worked so hard. I shouldn’t have to be doing this. I even tried to DM Pinterest on Instagram but their message just said they’ll “pass along the information”. I want this account back. I’m so mad. Hope you guys still have yours!!

I love this app, it’s such a comfort to sort images for inspirations for food, fashion, and home decor. But aside from that, I am an artist, so I save lots of art as inspiration. Pinterest doesn’t seem to be able to tell the difference between art that contains nudity, vs sexual content. Ever open an art history book? So while I keep getting violation notices for art posted by other people (which is also bizarre, why am I the one receiving a violation notice when it’s not my post?), I have to scroll through a feed that is 50% Ads/AI generated slop. But I guess Pinterest doesn’t care about the huge amount of AI “art” swarming it’s content, when it uses it to incorrectly flag posts as inappropriate. What I would like to see from Pinterest, is violations towards the creator of the post, not to everyone who interacts with it, and more regulations on AI content. And while I get that Ads help Pinterest make money, trust me I don’t need to be scrolling for 10 minutes and have 30% of my feed be Ads, and another 20% be AI posts. That’s not what I downloaded Pinterest to see.

I hope a human from the pinterest team can read this. What I’m about to say is my genuine reaction to learning about the new Pinterest update and how theyre using AI to moderate peoples accounts. Stop being lazy. Stop taking the “easy” way out and using Ai to do your dirty work, it will only lead to this apps downfall. I have sent 3 emails now requesting my banned Pinterest account to be reinstated, and I have had no help in return. If you care about the users or even just your app, you will act on this and realize that ai is falsely banning multiple people for “violating community guidelines” who have done nothing of the sort. Do something now. Fix this issue or we will all have no choice but to boycott your app and eventually leave all the developers to dry out in the dirt while we all move on to the next app. Very disappointed to say this because I genuinely loved Pinterest. I got most of my inspo and creativity from people posting cool art, photos, outfits, etc. And now all of my YEARS of saved progress and perfect algorithms are GONE. To anyone who uses Pinterest who’s read this far down, Stop using this app. Ai will find any reason to have your account banned. I have warned you.

They got rid of the options to write notes and the amount of ads is INSANE! Notes were super important, especially for recipes. Literally every other post is just an ad. This app is becoming unusable with the amount of obnoxious ads. Doesn't even matter if you try to hide the ad because there just will be another one right after.

I mainly use Pinterest to save recipes. Suddenly more and more of the recipes I have saved are being blocked "because of spam or inappropriate content". These are recipes I have made more than once. I have not had any issues with spam or seen anything inappropriate. This is very frustrating because I feel like Pinterest is just blocking things without reviewing.

Update: This app is pretty much devoid of fun now. It’s full of ads, weirdos, and nonstop censorship notifications. The most innocent pins are being taken down because someone somewhere considered them “adult.” One big problem is that the art they are censoring is not at all inappropriate, and once it’s flagged it’s gone for good. Unless you’re using software to backup your pinterest boards, you’re losing access to some really unique and fun art (even on private boards) because someone was offended when they saw an artistically illustrated adult body or a witty photo of fruit. Pinterest is removing art and narrowing the definition of art to be more aligned with very conservative values that are devoid of fun, anatomically correct adults, and imagination. It’s probably time to stop pinning and start using a better system to collect inspiration. Maybe Milanote? Old review: I keep getting notifications about pins that I liked or saved years ago. These notifications say that my pins have been reported and are under investigation for inappropriate content. These pins are all illustrations or photos that feature the human body, but no inappropriate / adult activities or images. Meanwhile, many of the ads I get are for clothing brands that show topless or scantily clad women in nothing but a pair of skimpy underwear.

I used to love this app, it was my first and favorite social media ever. I had my account for over 10 years, a long period over which I saved thousands and thousands of pins. A week or two ago, I opened the app to discover that my account had been deactivated for “going against community guidelines”. Not once in my ten years of using Pinterest have I ever pinned or promoted any sort of harmful or inappropriate content. I mostly pinned art, clothing, and tattoos. The fact that my account, which I have only ever acted appropriately and positively on, was taken down for randomly and unreasonably flagged pins that OTHER people posted is literally insane. I have a friend whose Sims 4 Custom Content pins keep getting flagged for SELF HARM? Don’t download this app, don’t use Pinterest. I am both devastated and disgusted that they would be as lazy and greedy as to replace their real, human moderators with AI, especially an AI system that doesn’t even work correctly and has taken down hundreds, even thousands of harmless and cherished accounts. Hope that the decision to so sloppily handle the moderation on this platform is worth losing such a large number of loyal users! The damage has been done and many people will never return to this app, even if some accounts are reinstated.

there are some good ideas and text posts on there but the ADS!!!! there is about the same amount of ads as there is content! I just counted and it's 50-50 on ads to content and it's always bigger ads than the content is. if I didn't already have so much saved (because the ads are fairly new) I'd delete it, and I'd definitely not download it now 😒 some of the ads are full page, but none of the content is

I have been using this website for a decade. It used to be a great place for artistic inspiration, reference images, recipes, discovering online artists, tutorials, brainstorming, asset curation, you name it. But I have seen a very steep decline in the quality lately. From the flood of low effort AI content, unmonitored (inappropriate) ads, recycled algorithmic recommendations, it has been harder and harder to use the website at all. Still, what Pinterest held over its more recent competitors was a decade+ of quality, user-based curation. However, with their most recent decision, they’ve abandoned that as well. The recent mass-banning of tens of thousands of active, loyal users, with no acknowledgment on Pinterest’s part, is the last in a long line of steadily worsening decisions by the company. The decision to wipe out years of user’s work, with no warning or chance for appeal, is both heartbreaking and baffling. Without the established community, there is no point to continue using this site. Many users have just seen their years of work ripped out from underneath them, and the lucky remaining few are left with a steadily emptying digital landscape. To any potential new users, I would highly suggest turning your efforts towards a platform less user-hostile than this.

I have recently discovered that many accounts on Pinterest have been getting banned for seemingly no reason, and one of the reasons people suspect are at fault is the use of AI to determine who gets banned. People who have been so loyal to this app and have been posting and saving pins for years are getting banned for no reason, and pins that have nothing to do with self harm or injury have been getting removed for self harm or injury. I get at least three emails a week telling me that a pin I saved is getting removed, and it’s usually never, ever related to the topic, or any other topic that would get it banned. I am now stressed that I will lose my account, I’ve had this account for about five years and I have so many pins saved at so much inspiration in my boards, and I do not want that all to go waste. Stop using AI to replace human jobs, especially when it creates a massive error that affects so many loyal users. Employee people, offer jobs to those already struggling to find a freaking fast food chain to work at, and stop creating so much trouble for your users. We do NOT want AI, we want REAL PEOPLE being employed to do the work only a REAL PERSON can do correctly!!!!

reviews.t: AI and Ads have ruined this app
reviews.x: The app is nearly unusuable now. On an average scroll, 2/3 of my screen is ads. I’ve been a Pinterest user for over 10 years and im trying to find an alternative, but it’s so hard because I’m holding everyone to the standard of what Pinterest once was. The AI ads are particularly egregious, because they’re ads for things that do not even exist and when you report them, 99% of the time the reports are ignored. So it’s all misleading and spam. There’s no option when you hide posts or report ads to say that the reason you’re hiding/reporting it is because it’s AI garbage. That might help the algorithm and the average user find this more tolerable. I cook, I sew, I’m an artist who uses Pinterest to collect references, I like fashion, and gardening, embroidery, welding, and woodworking…Pinterest used to be the first app I opened in the morning and the last thing I looked at at night. But now it’s an endless barrage of garbage. I’m updating this review almost a year later because, well, I didn’t think it could get any worse, but it has. The app users are literally begging Pinterest to do better on places like Instagram. Accounts are getting deleted left and right. Food content is being banned because of shoddy AI. Literally any pin you make now risks your account.

Pinterest used to be such a cool app where I would search for inspiration and make collections of things that I like, but now it has turned into some market place with ads making my feed look tacky and the HORRIBLE a.i generated pictures on my feed. Bring back authenticity, there was no need to make changes on an app that was perfectly fine.

I used to love this app, I have a ton of different boards and cumulatively thousands of pins made up of so much good content but this app has turned into advertisements and ai slop. Whenever I scroll I’m bombarded with ads, its to the point where half of your screen is taken up by them and it even tries to click you into clicking on them by making them things you’ve searched up or are interested in. Lately the app has also become overrun with AI generated images, which isn’t the devs fault but it makes scrolling, especially for art, a disheartening and frustrating thing to do. Additionally, the moderation on this app is horrible and you will get warnings for even just SAVING a pin you haven’t created, even when there’s nothing remotely wrong with the pin whatsoever. It says that the moderation team is a combination of real people and automated machines but I honestly don’t believe that because I’d appealed a pin that was literally a drawing of SHOES multiple times because it got taken down for inappropriate content and not been accepted when I’ve found way worse things on this app that are borderline NSFW. The app is also just overall just finicky and buggy, I constantly have to restart it due to it freezing, buttons often don’t work or do anything, and when reorganizing boards things sometimes don’t load properly and you lose all of your pins. More recently, people have started getting banned for no reason because of the horrible AI moderation. Pinterest, please fix your app. It’s a great concept and so many people could make use of it if it was better. But this AI garbage is ruining it, and a platform used majorly by artists is definitely not going to stand for that. Do better.

Pinterest has lost its quality and charm rapidly. I have been using Pinterest for over a decade. Once considered a space for artists of any kind to collect ideas, find inspiration, and share art; has now become a ad filled, AI infested cesspool. Regardless of the implications of an artistic space actively using and promoting AI (I.e personalized AI ads), they don’t even allow for an option to toggle off AI posts or encourage posters to label their artificial content as such. The concept of artists being able to actively search for art created by individuals with that persons entire heart and soul is not so far fetched, in fact, just four years ago this was the reality. On top of that you can expect to see at least one ad per five pins scrolled, more often than not every other pin. I am so disheartened that the Pinterest team is so unwilling to listen to their users or look at the impacts these changes have made. But this is unfortunately no surprise as they have let a portion of their employees go, allowing AI instead to review posts and accounts, and essentially act as customer service. Many long term users accounts are being terminated with no rhyme or reason, and not a single human being you can contact to appeal. (See r/pinterest on Reddit for reference)

reviews.t: I forgot something in my last review
reviews.x: More often than not, when I scroll down a from a post now to find similar items, I don’t, instead I find posts similar to another completely different board that I have, or just something I would never save all together. I thought the idea of scrolling down was to find similar pins as it used to be, I guess that’s wrong now?? And one more thing! Why does Pinterest keep deactivating pins! Almost everyday for the last year Iv had Pinterest send an email stating they have deactivated one of my pins for violent or inappropriate behavior. I always submit an appeal and you know why? Most of what I save is art and or photography. I don’t save any nudes or violent acts, so I kept wondering why my pins were getting deactivated so I started trying to use the “one time link” which btw doesn’t show you pin if your on an app on your phone. Either way I would get some idea of what pin was being deactivated and look out for it once it was released again. When I found out MOST OF THE TIME IT WAS A WOMAN SHOWING A FREAKING SHOULDER?! Or a LEG. This is getting out of control! I get that Pinterest wants to keep young children away from inappropriate things, but a woman showing skin is not inappropriate ( I’m a woman btw). I also save items for book fandoms and Iv had so so many of those pins get deactivated, but like why? Bc a guy has his shirt off? Bc a woman is in a bathing suit??? I’m not saving anything involving sex over here? Here we are yet again with a stupid new update, why won’t Pinterest just let things be🫠 this tipping thing with the pins makes me feel woozy. There’s a reason that was not a thing before

I absolutely love Pinterest - it’s my go-to place for creativity, inspiration, and discovering new ideas. Whether I’m looking for outfit inspo, DIY projects, or even just aesthetic mood boards, Pinterest never fails to deliver a mix of informative, fun, and incredibly creative pins. It’s like a digital vision board that constantly sparks my imagination. However, the growing number of ads is starting to take away from that experience. Sometimes it feels like half of my home feed is filled with ads, which makes it harder to enjoy the actual content I’m there for. I wish there was an option to completely turn off ads or at least manage how many I see, rather than just hiding or reporting them one by one. It gets frustrating when I have to constantly do this, only for more to pop up in other sections. Pinterest is still one of my favorite apps, but I hope they consider giving users more control over the ad experience - it would make an already great platform even better.

reviews.t: It’s awesome but there’s one problem…
reviews.x: I love Pinterest, it’s an awesome app and it’s amazing if you’re just looking for something to do, or whatever you’re doing on it, but the reason I only am giving it four stars is because I’m frustrated with one of the new updates. I’m not sure if this is the case for everyone, but on both of my accounts, you can’t see the title or description of any pins. The place where those things used to be is taken up by shopping recommendations that usually aren’t even related because there’s nothing to buy in the picture. I post art on both of my accounts (I’m not by any means popular, which is why I’m concerned with the following;), so if there’s no title, description, or anything showing on this seemingly random picture of a digital art piece, it looks like I’ve just screenshotted it and slapped it onto my profile, especially when I don’t have much posted. Wondering if this is a permanent thing? If so, I believe it makes being a creator (at the very least a small one) on this platform a whole lot harder. In addition, I’ve seen people advertise their businesses on Pinterest, as part of the app’s purpose is for small businesses, but the recommended content under it - which is visible at the same time as the pin itself - which is NOT from or related to the business in any way, diverts attention from the point of the post. I personally don’t advertise or seek money from posting on Pinterest, but these things really tick me off, and I don’t think I can change them.

This app is absolutely horrible now. There are SO MANY ads. Including AI ads that are very obviously scams. My feed is literally just a bunch of ads and AI slop. It's horrible as well that they amount of ads makes it so unusable. I can't scroll through Pinterest anymore without it lagging my device horribly. I thought it was because my phone was old, but even on my newly bought phone I couldn't scroll without severe lag and crashes. I tried desktop as well, same way. Fix your stinkin app.

reviews.t: Great app but can be really unfair
reviews.x: I love Pinterest, and it is one of the best places to find all sorts of inspiration or useful information for projects or fun. However, there is one thing that makes me very frustrated about this app, and that is the violation notices. I have received countless violations for “adult content” when in reality, it is a funny meme or a workout routine. With the notices, comes all of the annoying restrictions for around a month and you can’t do anything about it, even if the pin is reinstated. On top of that, we can barely see the pin that apparently violates the community guidelines, so we can get a proper appeal statement. Another thing is the fact that Pinterest is filled to the brim with AI now, including in the ads. I cannot begin to count the amount of scam advertisements that don’t get reported, mainly the “hyper realistic robot puppies, penguins, bunnies, etc” that are just clips taken from influencers with real dogs and an AI generated worker making them. A filter for these kinds of content would be nice. But other than that, this app is really fun and has some great creators, as well as creativity overall.

reviews.t: new update made negative quality of life updates
reviews.x: i’ve used pinterest religiously for years now, and don’t often use other social medias in any form. i use pinterest solely for inspiration, creativity boards, and anything in between. there was a recent update that had added a black arrow to back out of the pin at the top left. this has removed the option to slide out of the screen back to the previous one. i absolutely HATE this feature. it is incredibly inconvenient, and one of my favorite features of phones now is the ability to move between the page you’re on & a previous page by sliding right at the left edge of the screen. this arrow has now removed that & made a slight QOL adjustment that is just adding an unnecessary step into my day-to-day use of the app. the back arrow is also HUGE? and it blocks a lot of the top left of the pin. i just think this is inconvenient, and if you add that back arrow in, keep the slide feature where we can still exit out of the pin either way.

reviews.t: Not good like it used to be
reviews.x: I only rated this five stars so that everyone can see this. I’ve had Pinterest since 2020. I know that’s not a very long time, but Pinterest has changed drastically. I’ll make this short. I don’t know when this problem started, but apparently it’s been going on for a year. Pinterest has this thing: when someone deletes a pin or their account, they often assign ownership to the last person who saved it. Which is the most unhinged decision they’ve made. I’ve been getting countless copyright strike violations; my comment literally got deleted, and I got a violation strike for literally defending a suicide victim who was bullied. Pinterest isn’t really worth using anymore, at least to me. Eventually, a lot of accounts may be deleted if this keeps happening to unsuspecting people who aren’t responsible for the pins they’re getting violated for. If you still want to use it, I suggest that you look at a picture without saving it and move on.

Way Too Many Ads now. This used to be my favorite app to scroll in the late night and early morning when I can't sleep and needed low stimulation content. There used to be great ads for cute items I was genuinely interested in that I would even purchase from now and again. Now, though, there are more nonsense ads advertising things I'd never buy, which take up 8/10 of the rectangles of content on the page. It now also stops your video or music when you open the app, which I hate so much.

Used to love scrolling through Pinterest getting ideas for cooking and baking, amongst other things. Unfortunately, it's almost unusable now. Almost every post that comes up is AI or an ad. Plus, blocking the AI accounts does nothing, the same account and fake images show up on my feed an hour later. Not sure of the point in blocking.

reviews.t: They do the most useless updates
reviews.x: So every update they do they say it’s fixing bugs and improving, but that’s never what it is. They only either change the layout, make the app darker or lighter, or just make a whole new bug for some people. I updated the app the other day and i now can’t reply to people in comment sections or tag anyone (it doesn’t pull anyone’s name up) or edit my comment because it doesn’t have the send button. They never listen to people’s suggestions that would really be useful, such as having a recent hashtags, subsections for subsections, or when you block someone they hide your pins from them. People say these things all the time in reviews but they never add these features. I genuinely think that because people give it a 4-5 rating when they send suggestions or bad opinions pinterest doesn’t look at them because they think they say good stuff. I’ve also never seen pinterest reply to anyone’s reviews. I put this at one star so they can review it. Edit: they did another useless update, claiming it was “bug fixes” bug didn’t fix any bugs. They changed the layout and fonts ONCE AGAIN. Did they fix the reply button not being here so we can’t reply to ppl or edit our posts? No. Did they add subsections for subsections? No. Did they listen to the suggestions ppl give? No.

It's a good picture app, but each time you download a picture, a pop-up to "share with friends or sent in message" will appear, and if you're not careful you end up accidentally senting a picture to those the you follow or they follow you. This is supper annoying for both parties and 99% it's an accident but can still make the other party mad.

Pinterest is nothing but ads now. I wish I was joking, but every other pin is an ad. Many other pins are actually links to Amazon products or some other online store. The app is virtually unusable at this point and time. Probably always will be. Now I just use it on my desktop where I run adblock or on Brave, which also has integrated adblock. 2025 Update: AI generated content (including ads) is running rampant on the site.

I love the Pinterest app a lot, so I’ve been a user for many years. However, I have a few constructive criticisms which should ideally help improve the app and make the overall experience more fun for everyone! Firstly, many users regularly have comments on their posts disabled, or said posts get taken down despite them not breaking any rules. Secondly, I have recently lost the ability to reply to or edit comments. Thirdly, I’d regularly get told things like “something went wrong on our end”, “Pin not found”, etc. Why is that? Fourthly, Pinterest regularly hides comments. For example, if a comment got 5 responses, only three would be visible. Fifthly, posts are oftentimes filled with hateful or otherwise harmful comments, yet these comments don’t get taken down. Again, why is that? Sixthly, comments regularly get cut off, even if they don’t meet the character limit. For example, if I wrote “I like this post!”, that could become “this post!” Finally, people also might get their accounts banned even if they did nothing wrong! That being said, there are a few things I love about the app. For example, I love how people have built a community on there, and I love how creative and unique everyone is on there. Thank you so much to the good folks on Pinterest for all you do; keep at it!

I love this app, I use it daily. but there are a few bugs that just never get fixed even with the updates this app gets. when people reply to my comments or comment on my pins I rarely get notified even in app for it and I have to manually check. it stopped showing me how many likes and comments are on pins. sometimes on the pins I post it turns off the comments for literally no reason, it’ll be a perfectly normal post. if someone comments on my post, sometimes when I reply it’ll get rid of the og comment and will only show it if I go to my comment history and go to my reply, even then it doesn’t show my reply, only the comment itself. I am not the only user with these issues, there are more people even making posts in app complaining about it. If this was not an issue, then I would give 5 stars. (update) I love this app I rlly do, but you guys claim to have bug fixes every week and people are still experiencing the SAME bugs and now I can’t even reply to any comments at all. when I go to regularly comment, it’s all good. but when I go to reply, the button to send isn’t there, and it’s not just me that’s experiencing this. stop messing with the design and do something productive!!!!

I love this app, I literally use it every single day for hours. However, this app has become incessantly overrun with advertisements and it’s just absolutely unusable. When I search for something, I am only given advertisements rather than the user generated pins I’m looking for. The advertisements are hardly ever related to what I’m searching for either. It’s entirely broken. On my phone, I can’t reorganize my boards because the board editing menu is covered by the main menu buttons that lead to your feed and the search etc. can’t even click on my own profile and view who I’m following and who my followers are. I used to be able to see it, but then the profiles would glitch and disappear on the screen. How is this acceptable? Your app has an incredible concept and yet it doesn’t even work? Notifications are even worse honestly. I never get notifications regarding my pins, comments, or anything I create, yet I am bombarded with random notifications telling me that random people i have ZERO relation to interacted with a pin that I somehow interacted with 4 years ago. It’s either that or I’m getting constant notifications and emails that I’ve violated the community guidelines with one of my pins, and yet I NEVER ACTUALLY POSTED THE PIN IN QUESTION. WHY is it MY problem if I DIDN’T POST IT? There seriously needs to be some changes before other apps take over this concept and do it a million times better. Capitalist garbage

Pinterest could be great! I love the inspiration I get from posts for outfits, makeup, hair, etc. HOWEVER, under mobile data videos, refuse to load. I have checked the app for updates, I've reinstalled it, I've cleared cache, and I've adjusted the settings, but nothing seems to work. Video advertisements play flawlessly though, of course. This has been ongoing for over a year.

As a fellow content creator, I haven’t dropped this app only because of the people I’ve met. The pins I upload keep being hidden from others for no reason at all; no inappropriate content nor curse words. Not once, not twice, not three times, not four times, not five times… I’ve tried endlessly times already and it’s just pointless, plus, the pins with the comments turned off are the ones being hidden. I’ll mention that I’m not the one turning off the pins. My comments are also being hidden from others as I can’t see my own replies from my alt account, and this is something I hadn’t noticed until I checked, and its incredibly annoying. Many other people struggle with this and I’m not the only one, so i’d like to know if you all could fix this as I REALLY don’t want to stop using this app. Block button doesn’t work, even after blocking someone, their pins are still appearing in my fyp and its incredibly annoying! I would like it to be fixed as I don’t want anything to do with people I’ve blocked, thank you!

reviews.t: TLDR: I would like the ability to block AI generated content from my feed/searches.
reviews.x: I love Pinterest and I have been using it since I was a kid, but I am thoroughly frustrated about the amount of AI. Like many others, I do not support AI and do not want it in my feed and boards. I thought that blocking the (many) posters of AI would help but I was proved wrong. Blocking them does not block their posts from my feed/searches. I am afraid to start hiding them because that may block non-AI posts related to the topic of the image from my feed/searches. Still, I should not have to hide the majority of pins in my search for art inspiration. In case this is misinterpreted: my goal is not to ban AI images from Pinterest all together. My goal is to have the options to see it or not. I understand that this would require AI images to be identified and would likely take some work to add to the platform, but I believe it is worth it to keep your loyal users from leaving the platform. There are many websites that people use to identify AI generated content, so I know the technology is available. I really hope Pinterest can find a way to allow people that do not want to see AI to be happy again with their feed.

The amount of ads is just too much! I can barely see pins because the ads almost outnumber them. There is at least one ad in view on the screen at all times. For every 3-4 pins, there are 2-4 ads. You don't think that's a bit excessive?! It looks like a wall of ads rather than pins. This is just ridiculous! Also, it's harder to move pins and sections around using the organize feature now. Sometimes they don't move at all, or they move too fast and instantly to the top or bottom.

reviews.t: ruined by random violations and nonstop ads
reviews.x: Almost all the time now i'm receiving violations for pins that are nothing close to breaking guidelines. there's only one report that im actually allowed to see that makes some sense, which was a book about eating disorders, but it's a real book from a real author that i had simply saved the pin to my book reading board for my mental health project, and i got a violation when i didn't even post it. if anything is violated here it seems like free speech, if this book is found at public libraries why is it not okay on pinterest??? now majority of the time they don't even show you the pin they got you in trouble, they just send you the violation with the image blocked so i don't even know what i did wrong for me to stop getting flagged by the system. The Al moderation is so incorrect, go back to humans verifying please, doesn’t matter it took longer at least it was accurate and not reporting pins or deactivating people's whole accounts for no reason. and the sudden influx of ads is just awful too, no exaggeration every other post is an ad and makes the app so unusable since i keep pressing these pics thinking they’re pins but i just get sent to another website to buy something. just go back to tumblr y'all this is so sad i’ve been using pinterest for over a decade, how the mighty have fallen…

I love Pinterest obviously one of the most greatest apps out there for its simple functions. But there are two problems that ruin my good experience on the app, it’s the ads, and also the ai. The ads are one of the most biggest problem there, i have done it many times looking and blocking each ad and there has been times where multiple ads fill up my whole screen, there 90% perfect is just ads and none of what i actually want to see. Ads among the pins has always been a thing but it’s grown to the proportion where sometimes I can’t enjoy just scrolling through the photos I like. It’s frankly so frustrating. And if can really ruin my vibe of going into Pinterest when I just see ads - after ads. Ai is a problem especially ai art. I can’t control what goes on there - but sometimes I actually want to see real art, instead of ai. There can be many ways on it, such as filtering for ai pictures and non ai pictures for art. Which can help a consumers experience if they want to find specific types of art. And it can also be quite annoying. Though besides from that - I think the new formatting it a bit odd. But it’s fine, and maybe improve on the algorithm for picture. But I enjoy it overall.

reviews.t: New comment update (coming from iPad user)
reviews.x: I HATE HATE HATE the new comment update. Instead of the comments being easily to access, you have to click a TINNYYY button to view all comments. They also got rid of the thing that says “this creator has turned off comments/the comments are turned off for this pin.” And everytime you do open comments, it opens the keyboard for YOU to make a comment. I RARELY MAKE COMMENTS! SOMETIMES I JUST WANT TO SEE OTHER PEOPLE’S OPINIONS! And this update makes it WORSE because on ipad, the keyboard is glitched so that the word and with all of the attachment options is disconnected visually from the keyboard, so when you type you can’t even SEE anything you’re typing. This has been a problem for two years. And now, with this update, YOU CAN’T GET RID OF THE KEYBOARD AT ALLLLLLL. A PORTION OF THE SCREEN WILL BE TAKEN UP BY THE WORD BAR. Overall, this comment update is disappointing because it breaks the formatting of the page, and it’s very poor in design. It’s bad for accessibility reasons because there’s no way to increase size, like my grandma uses Pinterest and I believe that now she is unable to read comments whether it’s on other pins or her own. Do not disregard comments on this app. They’re the most substantial form of communication. Please just bring back the old comments, those were fine. Also, also, reduce the Ai slop, and I’ll be very happy. Thank you for your time.

I’ve been using Pinterest since I was literally 10, I am now 22 and the app has changed so much. The ads weren’t always here, if you guys did a pro version with upgraded features and no ads….that would be so much better. Us pin warriors are tired of accidentally clicking ads and losing our place! OG Pinterest was way less populated, now it’s overly monetized. Right now other platforms are losing users for this same reason, you all can capitalize on this! No one wants to use TikTok, but there’s no solid alternative, and “X” is totally overrun with politics and social issues. Pinterest is like our safe space right now. Yall did a good job with the stricter community guidelines, and you don’t market specifically to minors. Thats good because as a kid I saw some crazy things on this app, I also noticed I stopped seeing those things by using the “hide” feature. If you created parental controls that would change the game in a way TikTok absolutely failed. Anyways, thanks for keeping Pinterest alive. Rip polyvore.

As an artist, Pinterest has been one of my most used apps since I got it nearly a decade ago. Where it’s algorithm used to show me pins worthy of saving across my whole home page, now there’s going to be one worthy pin buried in advertisements and I can’t even tell whether many of these pins are ads or product pushing or if they’re normal pins. I would often listen to music and scroll through my home page but now my music gets stopped every few seconds to play a video ads audio instead. The feature where it lets you post multiple photos as one pin is useless to the way Pinterest is typically used. If I only like one of the photos in this dump, well too bad, the first photo in the dump is going to be what you see on your board and you’re going to have to look through all of the other photos to get to the one you want. The AI is pretty disappointing every time you look up hair inspo or room inspo for example and you click this really spot on photo only to inspect it closer and realize it’s AI and probably not even possible to recreate…the whole point of Pinterest. My final point, it’s been months since my app on my iPhone has worked correctly even after updating it. Scrolling in your boards is so sensitive it’ll just swipe you to your main page in a second if I’m not overly cautious about it. While in boards, the options to edit used to float just above the bar for home, new pins, search and messages, and now it floats behind that bar with about a fourth of it being visible above it so it’s impossible to access basically and I have no way to edit any boards or my page. This was the case on my old phone and the new 16 I just got a month ago. After an update last night with supposed bug fixes, I hoped for a solution but alas…nope.

reviews.t: After over 10 years I am done
reviews.x: This app has become a glitchy, bloated, greedy, censoring mess and I’m done. I’m starting the process of moving my pins and deleting my account. I hope people realize that many of the issues I’ll mention are due to Pinterest catering their app to CHILDREN and advertisers and not adult users. The site is just about 50% ads at this point, especially in searches and in related pins. Classical art is being taken down for Violation Notice. I’m getting pins taken down on a regular basis now even if, god forbid, it shows a quarter of a boob in a nonsexual context. I made a comment on a pin that was mildly critical and it was taken down for “Harassment”. The appeal was rejected. This was not a bigoted or inappropriate comment, but apparently you’re not allowed to express your opinion on this app anymore and that’s a dealbreaker for me. Moving pins is slow and results in glitches half of the time. Sometimes I move them in bulk to a section and the pins end up getting copied but the original stay as well. I was sharing a board with another account who told me they were deleting their profile soon. I pinned what I could to another board thinking it would save them. But once they deleted their account, my pins were gone too even though I did not move them, I pinned them like they were new. That was pretty disappointing and it’s frankly a really incompetent mistake to happen in an app that’s had so much development poured into it. Pinterest has become a headache that’s more trouble than it’s worth. Every couple of months they seem to add new experimental features but that doesn’t make up for more ads and more BUGS as well. People are leaving the app, including me. It’s not worth it anymore.

reviews.t: Unable to view full images/ click download button - your subscribers are dropping like flies
reviews.x: I’m not one to leave reviews or really be bothered by the bugs and glitches in this app, my one expectation is for Pinterest to be able to operate at its most basic level - clicking on pins, viewing pins, saving pins, and sometimes downloading them. After this most recent update from DAYS ago, we are now unable to view full images as the top gets cut off and because of this we cannot select the 3 dots to down load anything. This is a basic level glitch that should have been fixed days ago. I spent hours trying to reset my phone, my zoom settings, logging in and out come to find out this is an error on your end. By not fixing this immediately you’re bringing down the value of Pinterest as a whole which is terribly sad. What’s the point of keeping an account if I can’t simply view the images? You’re losing people and revenue due to careless mistakes. Listen to your subscribers and you’ll find we’re not asking for much besides an accessible app.

I've been using pintrest for 10+ years, and I used to love it. It was a great way to discover new artists, and I was impressed by how good the algorithm was at finding things I'd like. However, the excess of AI art is ruining the app and making it borderline unusable. I don't want to see any AI content, but my feed remains full of it no matter how many times I click "not interested." Please do something about this.

Love(d) this app. Haven't been on in a few years, but holy cow, did it change ... What happened!? It's almost 100% ads and shop links now. Nearly unusable. I used to find some unique blogs/articles/ideas not found in most of the big search engines and was hoping it was still a good place for unique takes, but now I see it's no longer Pintrest, it's Pintrash.

I would give this a 5 if it weren’t for some very frustrating aspects, that’s how great the idea of Pinterest is though it still gets 4 stars. 1. The amount of ads- it’s gotten so bad. It’s a 4:1 ratio for ads to pins specifically when you are searching something. I won’t even search now because it’s just clouded with ads. 2. Glitches- there are so many little glitches that interfere with using the app. If I click a pin, click out, and click again, the pin won’t appear the second time. The space is just blank. Glitches when I paste into the description box as well. It won’t let me scroll down to what’s beyond the previewed text. 3. I can’t see what others see on my feed/my own profile- when I tag products on my own posts I can’t see what I’ve tagged after posting. It’s just not there. I used to be able to see what I tagged under the “shop the look” or whatever it is. Now there’s just nothing, and sometimes I can’t see other peoples either. If they have tagged products it just won’t show me. Same thing with likes and comments, everytime I click on a pin it shows no likes or comments for it. I just don’t understand why my account looks the way it does now to where im limited to looking at my own content and the way it should be. It gets very frustrating because the app is so amazing sometimes but others drives me crazy. They all seem like fixable things especially with how long this app has been around.

reviews.t: Scams, Ads, AI, and Horrible Moderation
reviews.x: Do not click on any advertisements on this app. Nearly every single one is a blatant scam or low-quality junk. It’s extremely unbecoming of such a large “refined” application with so many users to allow scammers to advertise freely but I’m sure that’s the intention. They make a lot of money harboring these people. I’ve reported several of these ads and told them exactly why and how they are scamming people and it still gets approved even when there are comments on the ad itself talking about the money that was taken from them! These scam ads are abundant and they make sure that there is no point where an ad isn’t on your screen constantly (try to scroll without having one in frame, it’s very hard). Meanwhile my personal pins get removed on a daily basis for completely unfounded and baffling reasons. Sometimes appeals work but they can take MONTHS and you have no recourse if the person who reviews the appeal was wrong (or more likely a robot of sorts) Lastly, everything is AI generated now. This can be slightly dodged if you know what to look for and I don’t see it in my feed as much now, but it is still rampant. Some platforms now at least require you to confirm whether or not there is generative AI used, and Pinterest should too. It would take little money or time to implement a feature allowing people to choose AI to stay out of their feed. The platform used to better but that was a long time ago. I highly recommend using any Pinterest alternatives, it’s worth more of your time than this. I’d be surprised if this app is around in a few years if this keeps up.

This app is great for all the reasons it’s says it is, but the system in place for guidelines involving pins baffles me. Example: you have a few pins saved but you get an email saying you violated guidelines for saving a pin that went against TOS. You think “Oh no what did I save?” “How can I fix this if this is a mistake somehow?” So you try to look at aforementioned pin BUT, the pin isn’t viewable because it violates TOS. In this scenario you can’t look at the pin to tell if you actually did something wrong or not so any appeals would false evidence so you can’t do anything to fix said problem! A few months go bye and this keeps happing until your account gets suspended or worse. You can’t do anything to change the situation since you have to evidence to take action when you don’t believe you have done anything wrong? I’m currently in this situation and am worried for my account. I don’t believe I have done anything wrong but if I can’t look at the pins I’m being held accountable for then I can’t do anything. If there is a way around this or I am mistaken please let me know.

reviews.t: Spend more time fixing this app.
reviews.x: Look, Pinterest is my life. I absolutely love saving pins and organizing my boards. I also tend to change my profile picture and header a lot but lately every single time I try to change it, it doesn’t change automatically. It’ll say “Changes saved” but i would still have the same profile picture and header. I have to change both at least two times and close the app to make it change. And then even sometimes that doesn’t work. I feel like these “polishes” every week are not working. Every single times, it’s something new with this app. I either can’t change my profile pic or header, can’t organize my boards the way I want to, can’t organize my sections the way i want to, it’s annoying and I think you guys need to spend more time “polishing” this app. Please fix these issues instead of releasing updates every week. I love this app and I wouldn’t want anything to happen to it. I just want these bugs fixed.

I enjoy pinterest, to be honest. It's a great app and it's perfect for when you need drawing references, workout routines, etc. However, recently it's become infested with AI prompts and pictures, misguiding people of all sorts, including beginner artists who may not be able to tell the different between AI 'art' and art that actually has a human's effort put into it, people looking for ways to lose weight or get more fit, and even something as simple as showing a hairstylist what kind of haircut you'd want. These AI drawings can be misguiding as they can cause an artist to start following them, causing all sorts of problems with the art and especially the anatomy. Those looking to exercise may find body types that are almost impossible to achieve, causing them to overwork themselves in hopes of getting that body. Then, if you're looking for a hairstyle, you may even find one made by AI that is impossible to get. All of these simple problems are still an important point in this review. Yes, pinterest is still useful at times when I'm trying to find stuff I'm interested in, or just base drawing references. But nowadays, it has been flooded with AI prompts and it's become difficult to find art actually made by a human being.

reviews.t: Vaccine is a banned word and there's no proper "report an issue center"
reviews.x: Was on a pin about a person saying they're hallucinating because they couldnt believe that the scientist who made the Morderna *vaccine* was a furry. Notice how I emphasized vaccine? Because the policy guidelines that pinterest has doesnt allow "anti-vaccination advice", so what does it do? It outright bans the word vaccine from being mentioned in comment sections, even if it is being used in a neutral or even pro-vaccine context. Oh, not to mention the fact that the "help center" only has such a narrow range of options, and DOESNT allow for you to just outright write a report on issues with the app says a lot about this... company. Either I'm blind and Pinterest just buries the option to write your own report, or the company is just that bad at offering customer service. I say this because I'm more dumbfounded by the lack of a proper, easily accessible "report center" where you can ACTUALLY write what is the exact issue, instead of having to go through the 5 step "what's your issue?" process without the guarantee that it even works. PLEASE quit outright banning words that don't even deserve to be banned (of course, slurs of any kind should be fully banned without hesitation, but is vaccine a slur? Not unless your brain is smoother than a marble), and also just add a simple "Write your report" section thats easily visible in settings, preferably right above the "Help Center" redirect button, you can even use your heavily flawed auto-checker that you use on comments to filter the reports since y'all are apparently afraid of simple, normal words.

reviews.t: Overall one of my fave apps, but could use some improvements
reviews.x: I love Pinterest and have been an avid user for years now. That being said, it has been quite glitchy lately and will often freeze when I go to add a pin to a board and won’t unfreeze until you delete the tab and reenter the app. This is rlly annoying but the only real technical issue I’ve experienced. It is also extremely annoying with how many ads there are now. Not only does it ruin the aesthetic of my feed, but I can hardly scroll without clicking on something and it taking me to a whole other site. Other than that, I do think that there should be a way to “shuffle” the order of your pins instead of just hand organizing them and if there was a way to put sections inside of sections (but maybe I’m just on it too much and an organization freak lol). It would also be neat if you could reply to the pins and messages that ppl send you because it’s kind of frustrating that that’s a feature on all other social media platforms except this one. Overall though, I love this app dearly, just think it could use some tweaks and wayyy less ads.

reviews.t: Can not scroll without clicking an ad!
reviews.x: I’ve always loved this app, but recently it’s become almost unusable due to the overwhelming number of ads. I understand ads are necessary to keep it free, but the experience has taken a frustrating turn. Accidental clicks on ads pull me out of Pinterest constantly, and because the system assumes I’m interested, I get served even more ads. It’s so frustrating that I often just close the app entirely. Another major issue is the inability to simply zoom in and view a photo. Instead, clicking on an image either takes me to an ad or highlights the photo to suggest similar products. There should be additional steps - like a double click or a “see product” button - before users are redirected off the app. As a marketer, I’d be frustrated spending money on ads only to have my budget wasted on accidental clicks. Retargeting those false “interests” compounds the problem. Add in the increasing number of fake AI-generated images promoting unrealistic ideas and scam products, and Pinterest is becoming more frustrating than inspiring. It really needs better UX consideration to keep users engaged.

I've been using Pinterest for 15 years now, and recently started up a Pinterest account for my business. I started slowly, but as my business, so has my needs on Pinterest. Yesterday I reached a Pin block for making too many pins. It was 30 pins. That's it. I've done more than that in the past and never had this block. I think OK well I wait for the pin block to go away, I'm going to re-organize my boards so they are a little more streamlined and look nice. One board had 1000 pins in, I think I got 300 of them moved to different boards before I hit a "bulk actions ban". So you're telling me on a site intended to create and share your pins . I am punished for creating and organizing my pin boards. So tell me what am I supposed to be using the site for? Not to mention Pinterest not sticking to their own rules. I cannot tell you how often I've gotten a pin removed because somebody falsely reported it. Yet I see so much graphic content of children on this site that Pinterest refuses to remove. Like full frontal nudity of actual children. I don't mean they look like they could be an adult and are like 16/17. I mean some of these children don't look a day over eight years old. It's disgusting. I've reported it many times and Pinterest does not take it down saying it does not violate terms and services. But oh no! God forbid I organize my boards right ?

Please improve the comment capabilities. On several occasions I’ve tried to leave a comment on a pin but gave up. If you’re typing in the comment box and accidentally touch anything else or attempt to scroll up or down, it closes the comment box which deletes everything you type and you have to start over. This causes me to lose motivation to interact on the app and I just stop scrolling and close the app. It is extremely frustrating after taking the time to type a well thought out comment. I shouldn’t have to open my notes app to type up a comment and paste it in the Pinterest comment box to make sure it’s not going to get deleted especially because a lot of times, opening and closing the Pinterest app will auto refresh the feed so you lose your place anyway. On iPhone Messenger you can exit the app and your unsent message is still there when you reopen. I’m not even asking for this extensive of a feature. Just asking that if I want to scroll up or down while still commenting on the same pin I’m viewing or I accidentally tap the screen off the comment box while typing, that it wouldn’t collapse the comment section and delete everything I just wrote even though I never left the pin. This would be a nice feature on this app.

reviews.t: Long time user, close to giving up
reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest religiously for so long, and I’ve loved it! It’s been my favorite app, I have a ridiculous amount of boards and pins. It’s irreplaceable to me, which is why I’m so sad about what it’s turned into. It’s a sea of ads. It’s stressful to scroll through, one wrong tap and you’re out of the app. It used to be a happy place, full of things I like and am interested in, but now at least 3/4 of what I’m shown is ads. It’s gotten worse and worse. I just took a screen recording of swiping on my feed and getting 6 ads back to back. And that’s not even considering that almost all of these ads have multiple pages, so you try to swipe and you’re still on the same ad. Pinterest, you’re killing your app, that so many people have loved for so long. I understand every company needs to make money, but Pinterest is becoming unusable due to the volume of ads, and it’s lost the peace and beauty it’s known for. It’s not too late to change. Giving up Pinterest will break my heart. It feels like distancing yourself from a close friend because they’ve changed in the wrong direction, and you miss who they were, but that person doesn’t exist anymore.

reviews.t: So many ads, I miss the old Pinterest
reviews.x: This app is getting harder and harder to use :( With so many ads, the search function barely works and it is very difficult to find unique or novel images. My feed tends to be interesting and has lots of new content, but it seems to really push trends and ads. When searching for a specific type of image, the feed is so overtaken by ads, and the images seem repetitive or just unrelated to the search. My main use for the app is to look for and organize inspiration images on specific topics (using the search function), not scrolling in a random but personalized feed (the home feed), so the app less functional now for me than it was in the past. I should add, I don’t mind some ads on a free platform - the problem is the platform is basically unusable because instead of distinguishing ads, they are trying to integrate them into the normal content (every image has links for related products for sale, near half of the other images are just ads and send you to another website to buy a product if you accidentally try to pin it), transforming any one “pin” into a (or multiple) product ad. TLDR; the home feed is pretty much a mega billboard of ads yet is still kind of ok and interesting, but the search function (which had always been my favorite part of Pinterest) is near useless. The app seems to be pushing trends, sales, and ads, more than any other type of image.

reviews.t: I love Pinterest but they make you appeal for saving a pin that wasn’t posted by you.
reviews.x: Half the pins I saved on the app were posted by ArtStation, and they have some posts that I saved which was soon reported as “Adult Content” and I had to make the appeal. Except Pinterest is lacking memory because all the pins I’ve saved were from multiple different accounts. How is it that I’m the one who is at fault and needs to appeal for this mistake? Is this not a platform to organize ideas and find inspiration from all these images? Can i not save a pin that has partial adult content? Can I not use these images I’ve saved and come back to and use them as references for sketching, story creation, anything? It is their job to get rid of anything that resembles adult content such as nudity, self-harm, anything that resides in bad imagery and cause bad reputation for themselves but half the time I’ve seen so much of adult content lately, Pinterest has been slacking off. I came to this app for references, story ideas, tips for any of those two hobbies I just wanted. If not then this app is full of disappointments.

No, it most certainly is not. You won’t be able to zoom in on pictures at least on Apple devices of any kind you won’t be able to select an image in a different file or tab you’ll be forced to go down that rabbit hole and there is no easy way to get back to why you were there in the first place. If you delete the app, it will force you, at some point, to come back on even if don’t for a while, eventually you will be forced because every time you use the browser site the question to try the app are relentless. You may evade this for a time to try it out on the app and sometimes they claim a certain function is only available on the app because of some functionality issue with the website. There’s literally no single advantage to the app other than you aren’t harassed to use it. There’s no tab function. There’s no view function you can’t zoom in on pictures. It will force you to look at a certain corner of a photo or something and then it brings you things like “oh it looks like you have a balloon in the corner, here’s 100,000 pictures different balloons and really you’re looking at the picture of IT. That’s what you’re trying to anyway The AI just doesn’t make any sense. I don’t necessarily care about the Clown from It, except for one time when I was trying to buy the right balloons that were eco friendly to put in a storm drain in the parking lot but it was too frustrating to use Pinterest

I’ve been using Pinterest for years, ever since I was a tween, and it’s really the only viable app for inspiration and organizing ideas. I go here for all my drawing, crafting, cooking, and design ideas. Lately though, I can’t stand the control the algorithm has on my feed. I feel like every time I try to look up a new idea, it feeds me the same stuff I’ve already seen. This app has me in a constant loop, looking at the same pins over and over again, and it’s very annoying. As for the ai and ads, they’re completely out of control. I have multiple friends who refuse to use Pinterest, because it’s become so flooded with ads and bad ai art. For every one, original pin you see, there’s about four ads. Lastly, there’s a horrible new update: when you save something in the app, your screen automatically scrolls down to suggested and promoted products as a not-so-subtle invitation to buy stuff you don’t want or need. It’s more annoying than can be described, that all apps and websites these days are just here as marketing opportunities for other people.

All the other 1 and 2 star reviews say it all. The ads and AI images have completely reuined the experience. Update: I posted this review 11/18/24, and I just un-installed the app. It became unusable. Genuinely hate it now and wish it could be given zero stars. I don't bother with the website anymore, either. Same problems there.

pinterest is a great social media "alternative" for me. i can look at images that inspire me and are deeply curated to my interests and aesthetics. i like it particularly because i'm not tempted to watch something while scrolling comments, and its so curated to ME that im not seeing/watching content that dims my mood and creates anxiety, but rather content that boosts my mood and inspires my creativity. however, the uproar in ads on this app have gotten out of control. i gave myself 7 SECONDS to count the ads while scrolling slowly as i usually would and i counted 20 ads!! TWENTY!!! ive found myself clicking ads that i thought were pins constantly. i know this is intentional, and pintetests needs to make profit too, but its become so outrageous that it's driving me away as a user– and i know im not the only one. there has to be some other alternative to this that is less obnoxious. pinterest used to be such a lovely "get away" app, but is quickly turning into a marketing scheme. it's starting to turn into more ads than pins. please pinterest, listen to your users and find a solution.

reviews.t: DESERVES A ZERO. BUT LIKE THEIR "SAVED TO THE BOARD I JUST CHOSE" THAT'S NOT OPTIONAL
reviews.x: If I want to save a pin I must choose the board I want the pin saved to. Upon saving the pin I am notified by an inane pop up alerting me that I have "Saved to - board!" & I am left w/a sense of Déjà vu. Didn't I just choose the board? In order to return to the home page to choose more pins the obstacle course begins: will I inadvertently tap on the redundant notification taking me to the board I just chose for that pin? Will I gleefully scroll at pins identical to ones I just picked thinking this person has great taste? Will it take me longer than I care to admit until the realization hits me- I'm looking at all my saved pins from that board? You know the board I just chose? Will I ever remember to tap/swipe/blink fast/hope/pray I remember to tap ANYWHERE BUT THE INANE NOTIFICATION THAT TAKES YOU TO THE BOARD YOU JUST PICKED SPECIFICALLY FOR THAT PIN? Please for the love of every single time I've cussed Pinterest about this redundant notification MAKE IT STOP. And yes all my notifications are off in the app, the phone & my watch. Saving 100 pins & downloading 100 images creates so many pop-ups I leave the app & search Google. No one wants this. I cringe opening your app as I know I'm entering a minefield of pop ups. Do better please.

I want to start with the fact they deleted my review I recently left calling them out for their terrible practices and invasive choices. I went to update it with this when I found it gone! Interesting!! Anyways, Pinterest removes photos with false reports that is just art or something that has nothing to do with the report. They are quick to review reports that have to do with self-harm and eating disorders but pick and choose which ones to take action on. They ALLOW the fetish content being reported. I’ve reported multiple fetish photos containing minors and they have been waiting in appeal for months. Yes, appeal, because the first time they “found nothing wrong” with it. The content is of young ladies putting panties on their heads. It’s very specific and obvious. I’m absolutely appalled with the company and will make sure everyone knows they are choosing to throw their authentic users in the back burner and allow advertising, ai, and fetish content take over the entire platform. It’s pathetic considering their entire website relies on users and other peoples content just to stay afloat. I’m sure this comment will be deleted soon enough too. God forbid they can handle real criticism

reviews.t: Full of ai, ads and bugs
reviews.x: Pinterest used to be great 2-3 years ago but for the 4 years I've had it, it's changed a lot. There's tons of ai photos labeled as real pictures/drawings. There are no regulations against the use or posting of ai. When searching up something popular you'll get more ads then actual inspiration photos. It's slowly become more and more designed to sell you things, with ads looking like they're Pinterest posts so you'll click on it accidentally and hopefully buy something. Even the real posts that aren't labeled as ads will still lead you to a shopping website when you click on it. Not to mention the bugs. There's an ongoing bug where Pinterest won't play the audio of certain videos even though your volume is up. You can't zoom into photos because it'll either take you to a website or show you where to buy the items shown in the picture. (Again, trying to sell you things.) It's corporate greed at its finest guys. They say they fix bugs every week but I highly doubt that's true. The only thing that's keeping it from completely unusable is its user base. There's tons of people who use Pinterest that don't post ads. Overall, I'd say it's not worth it to have Pinterest anymore if these problems keep getting worse.

I absolutely love Pinterest. Honestly everything you could ever have when it comes to wallpaper or ect. Pinterest is my go to because it lets you choose before hand what your style is so I don’t have to scroll through for 10 minutes to find a wallpaper my style. The only problem I have with Pinterest is I was searching and I searched… “Christmas IPAD wallpaper” and I only got a couple iPad wallpapers. All the other ones were iPhone and the problem with that is when I go to put a iPhone wallpaper on my iPad, it doesn't fit. That’s why there’s different shapes for iPhone, computer, iPad, ect wallpapers. Then, I searched up “HORIZONTAL Christmas IPAD wallpaper” and 3 or 4 ipad ones popped up. All the rest were iPhone wallpapers. So I’m sitting here scrolling for 10 minutes trying to find iPad wallpaper. I know this isn’t fully Pinterest’s fault it’s just when I search up and specific thing like “IPAD” wallpaper or “IPHONE” wallpaper, I want JUST iPad wallpaper or JUST iPhone wallpaper.
