Like I said, this isn’t fully Pinterest’s fault. Overall, Pinterest is a great app. My only problem with it is just naming the specifics.

reviews.t: Stop advertising to me, I have no money
reviews.x: I have really loved this app as a research source for my creative endeavors for years, but in late stage capitalism it’s become borderline unusable. I attempted to search for regency era gowns recently, and I was only ever shown products to purchase. I was unable to find any other creators showing what they made, no historical content, nothing that would constitute research. I looked at the filters and found that it was set to only show products. It took me three attempts at resetting the filters before it actually worked, and even then the algorithm showed me only products. I scrolled through products for awhile before eventually giving up. I currently can’t afford to pay all of my bills and it’s frustrating that I can’t even find inspiration for my own sewing projects outside of dresses that cost 100s of dollars. I understand that the app has to support itself somehow, but the consequence of this kind of consumerist attitude is eventually going to be me deleting the app. I haven’t done it yet because i still need to pull the stuff I’ve saved onto some kind of physical copy, but it seems inevitable. If I was looking for products to purchase, there are tons of other and better platforms to that end. Guess I’ll just have to go to the library like I probably should have in the first place.

reviews.t: This app is completely unusable and filled with AI or ads now.
reviews.x: I’m sad to say I’ve decided to stop using Pinterest after years and years of using it as my main source for finding images. When I look something up, about 85% of the pictures are just ads to go to an outside website and buy a product which doesn’t allow me to pin these pictures as ideas and gets very frustrating. I’d usually ignore it but today was my breaking point as every time I’d try to pin nail ideas it would just end up sending me to other websites to buy press on nails. This app is known for looking up and saving pictures and ideas, it is not known for being a shopping app and it is ridiculous that it is getting treated as such since this has led me to deciding to trying another app like We Heart It. On top of all of this, for many things you look up one of the first images will pop up and be AI which is very frustrating as well. I’m looking for real images, not AI slop that is very noticeably AI generated. This app quality has gone down disgustingly much and I’m disheartened because one of my favorite pastimes was listening to music and scrolling on pinterest, but not anymore.

Hello! This application is overall AMAZING. I really do enjoy the content, images, ideas, tips, references and features it has to offer. It’s really pleasant overall. Saving to your boards and vise versa, liking, sharing, commenting and posting. Even text messaging to friends and content creators. Real nice. Inspiration for cooking ideas, outfits, hairstyles, makeup and art/drawing. What I do am concerned about is the lack of security. Not in that way of course, just the simple thing of getting notifications that inform some of those pictures/content saved have not met their guidelines and overall safety security. It really does frustrate me to no end when I get these. I try to reply but I simply get delayed and told that at this moment I cannot commit this action- and to wait again and try. I really hope they better their system and overall safety security scanning- I do NOT want my account, and those who might’ve been in the same situation as me get their accounts threaded to be deactivated. I hope this is taken into consideration. This application is amazing, but this strong con is really bugging me.

reviews.t: great for inspiration but AI and ads are out of control
reviews.x: The app itself works just fine. I enjoy using it for inspiration and to help me visualize things for future plans or projects, so in that way it continues to mostly serve its original purpose. However, it seems every time I’m on there I get served more and more AI generated images. The amount of ads was frustrating enough for a while, but now I will get pages of imagery that isn’t actually showing real places or even real people. If I’m using Pinterest to get ideas for a realistically achievable patio space, or a new hair style or hair color, I don’t want to see computer-generated images of women who all have the same face or a landscaping job that doesn’t actually exist. Pinterest has a lot of value as a tool to help communicate goals and visual wants to professionals working with clients. How is it fair to professional designers if their clients keep bringing them images of things that never existed in reality in the first place? How is it fair to those same artists and designers if the work that is getting pinned and shared is not theirs, but is instead generated by a machine ? It’s frustrating at a basic level and very eerie and disturbing at another. I would love to see Pinterest advocate for the artists, designers, and content creators who use this space by cracking down on AI-generated posts. At least then the amount of ads might be more tolerable.

I love this app, it’s amazing, definitely the most useful app I own as an artist and writer. There are so many inspirational ideas and tips I’ve found and I have been using it for years to improve on both. You can create private boards if you don’t want the public to see them, you can collaborate, you can make your own pins and comment on them. And there are SO MANY!! Loads and loads of ideas and inspiration. And if you’re not looking for that, there’s content of anything else as well. There’s truly nothing you can’t find on here. I would give it a five star rating if it weren’t for a huge problem I haven’t been able to fix for an entire year. The app won’t work on my phone, at all! It works perfectly fine on my tablet and computer so I know it’s not just my account bugging out. I’ve searched everywhere for a solution and have tried every advice I have gotten but so far nothing has worked. Whenever I open the app from my phone every pin is an empty grey box. I wouldn’t mind this if it weren’t for the fact I like using it on my phone more than my other devices. The screen is smaller and fits the picture perfectly, I can write notes on pins that I cannot do for some reason on my tablet, or view my favourite ones, and it is overall easier to use. If there is a way to fix this problem that could work I would gladly take it, it’s really an amazing app, I’m just so tired of not being able to use it on my phone.

reviews.t: i have never been this whimsical
reviews.x: this app, beautiful in every way. I’ve never felt more sillier in my entire life. I want to thank this absolutely amazing, silly, delicious app for fueling my unhealthy addiction with looking at rivers cuomo pictures & silly cat images at 3:47 in the morning. Never has an app made me feel this autistic. My phone is always weezed out with the absolutely exhilarating photos of my favorite virgin band, weezer, that are constantly put out. I giggle, kick my feet, twirl my hair, and fricking cream whenever I get access to unlimited photos of my beautiful weezletts. Truly, wholeheartedly, thank you, for helping me create the shrine of my husband, with over 900+ photos dedicated just to him. Sure, my phone is on its last speckle of booty hair, but that won’t stop me from tweaking the moment I see the absolutely tear jogging smile of scott shriner because damnit has an old man never been finer. I ode my soul to this whimsical app. For not them, I wouldn’t have the photos of my (besides matt and mikey) 4 husbands that are in a pink triangle of love, with, their fan that they don’t know exists. I’ll go eat my candy with the pork and beans, see y’all later. Stay weezed out 🔥

I’ve used Pinterest for well over 10 years, and am so sad to have to delete the app today. I’ve resisted updating my app because I’ve seen how many adds are clogging my friends home screens (to the point they aren’t using the app OR web Pinterest anymore) and thought I’d be safe continuing to use a far outdated version. However this weekend, upon opening the app, I’ve found my homepage UI was refreshed anyway. I tried to continue to use it but have been so put off by the overwhelming amount of adds that the experience is no longer enjoyable. Like I get this is how you make money but are your product managers this lazy they can’t think of a more innovative way than ruining the experience of a uniquely visual experience driven platform, much more than any other social media platform? And so tastelessly? I’m honestly so sad because I’ve loved Pinterest for so long, but it is no longer an enjoyable app to use. An occasional add made sense when they were spread throughout the experience, but the large square adds are just ridiculous especially when most of the other squares are adds too. Do you have 0 usage analytics to use when making these decisions, is no one listening to users at all? Does no one on your product teams have any care for or knowledge of what makes (or made) Pinterest special? Like is this a top down issue, bc I know this is consistent with reviews for a while. Like yall should be embarrassed, Pinterest team. I’ve literally never written an app review before but I’m truly sad to have to let this one go

reviews.t: Violations Reports, Ads, & more are ruining the app
reviews.x: I’ve been a loyal Pinterest user for over a decade & it has recently become virtually unusable for me. For one thing the home feed is just one giant ad. It seems to follow a ratio of every 3 pins come with 5 ads surrounding them. I don’t even use the home page anymore because I never find anything I like- only people trying to sell you something. But maybe I could deal with the ads if the new violation rules weren’t so frustrating. They’ve come up with new guidelines (probably to cover themselves in case someone wants to sue them for having inappropriate content on a website where kids could see it) & they are ridiculous & block out so much harmless stuff that makes no sense. Gone are the days where Pinterest could be a fun safe haven. Now it’s a ridiculously regulated & run app. Every single day I'm getting violation reports on pins that are not sexual, or graphic at all. All the edits I’ve uploaded are muted & there’s no way to saved them with the sound so I can store them elsewhere. There’s a 50/50 chance that an innocuous pin I save (not even updated myself but just saved) will be flagged out of nowhere & get my entire account that has amassed 16k followers deleted. And the app in general is just so so so GLITCHY!!! I’ll be organizing a board & out of nowhere the entire board itself will be deleted & there is no way to get any of it back. Another problem I encounter is sections being hidden for some reason so you can’t save anything to them anymore. & if you try & move too many pins at once they’ll all end up spontaneously deleting. I never write reviews but I’ve finally been pushed to my limit because I am so sick of losing so many great pins over nothing. The app is a chore & we are all sick of it. Go back to old pinterest!!!

I’ve been a user of Pinterest since you had to have an invite request to do so. So I’ve seen it change drastically over the years. Most of the time it’s been for the better. But within the last year, the creation of AI images and content has downgraded the experience. Adding an AI filter would be amazing but honestly I’m not sure how practical. The ads on the other hand are 100% within the realm of possibility to fix. As of late, upwards of 40-50% of my feed are ads. Immediately opening the app a large ad is there followed by 3-5 pin sized video ads and sponsored or shop products infiltrate my curated content. I remember when sponsored ads started appearing, it was fine one every couple dozen pins which seems plenty sufficient when we’re all scrolling screens at a time these days. But now I can barely find a non sponsored pin in the scroll through ideas and relatable content. It’s becoming so ridiculous that I don’t even enjoy opening the app anymore. It’s distracting, full of irrelevant content and ads and many times a pin I want to see more about is just a link to a product for purchase. This isn’t what Pinterest is used for. The Reddit screams for demanding change and yet it always seems to fall on deaf ears. Ad revenue is understandable, sponsored puns to do so are understandable, trickle of the overwhelming amount of AI garbage is also understandable just because everyone and their brother can create it and post it now BUT the user experience is tanking FAST and this review is the only shot I have at hoping for change, save for abandoning the platform.

I used to love Pinterest. It has been the only social media that I have consistently kept since I was young. But back then, it was a place to share art and pictures and writing, etc. Now it’s just a platform that pushes ads down your throat. Pinterest never used to have so many ads. I know times change but the amount of ads is simply insane. On my phone screen I can’t go more than 2 pins without seeing an ad. It drives me crazy. I would genuinely pay to have the ads removed if I could. I use Pinterest for so many things. But now that it feels like the app is 60% ads, the interface is so much less appealing for use. One of the whole points (or a reason a lot of people in my age range use this app) of the app is creating and curating aesthetics. The amount of ads present is starting to diminish the ability to do and see that. I loved this app and have been using it for a long time, it’s disappointing to see where it’s headed. Not to mention the strict and senseless regulations for what pins are acceptable. Why are people who did not post the pins receiving emails that they violated terms and their account will be suspended? With an app that has had so much time to develop, you’d think that they’d be able to tell who uploaded a pin and who just, you know, pinned it which is the whole purpose of the app. And one of the worst things, Pinterest is ignoring all of its users feedback. This has been an issues for well over a year and nothing has been changed, fixed, or addressed. Pinterest, please, listen to your users. Otherwise this app will continue down the path that is turning it into an unusable mess.

I have been using Pinterest for a while and have never been able to use the app without there being some sort of bug taking place in the app. For ex., the filter in your saved pins that you can try to use while trying to even use the filter to search always has a connection error. But that’s not why I’m writing this review. I always use the Home Feed Tuner section in the Settings to browse which pins I have looked at. Usually I’m able to click on the pin with no problem since the pins, which you’ve looked at that appear in the home feed tuner are able to be looked at only when they have a -checkmark- in a box next to the compact pin next o all the others which have the same. RECENTLY, it has not been working as something to look at for a history tool because I cannot look at my pins I have clicked on because the box with has the checkmarks automatically placed in them have all my pins hidden, so I CAN’T LOOK AT THE PINS FREELY WITHOUT RE-CHECKING THE BOXES MANUALLY, MAKING IT KICK ME OUT OF THE HOME FEED TUNER SECTION AND UPDATING MY FEED WHEN ALL I WANTED TO WAS TO LOOK AT THE PIN. I used the HFT as something I could see a pin I clicked on before the Pinterest refresh could get to it. Now, when I try to see any pin I have to check in the box myself, making it tune my feed so that I see less pins like the one I checked in just so I could see it closer. Hopefully I could get some help on this topic so it could go back to being browsing history for me.

While I really like Pinterest (I spend more time on it then social media) there have just been too many ads. It’s just a constant barrage of products I don’t use, things that make me uncomfortable, or movies/shows they are trying to promote (it’s worse in fall cause I can’t handle horror and keep getting jump scared by Halloween movies, I can’t even fully get them off my screen by scrolling cause there’s always another one below it perfectly spaced so that both will be visible no matter what I do). And using the feature on Pinterest to stop showing me specific ads does absolutely nothing. I get that ad revenue is probably how Pinterest is gaining a lot of money and is probably necessary to keep the app free. But if ads start taking up more space on my screen then the actual thing I searched up then that’s really a problem. It never has anything to do with what I searched up either. It didn’t use to be this bad and I have no idea why the company changed it but it’s just becoming more and more annoying. What’s worse is that I know writing a review about it is going to do absolutely nothing, it’s only going to get worse and nothing anyone says will stop that because *profit*. It’s getting to the point I would pay to get rid of the ads cause I really am just that sick of it (a one time payment not a monthly, I’m not paying a monthly subscription for something that dumb) I really hope Pinterest starts reducing ad frequency or at least doesn’t make it worse. If it starts getting worse then it already is then I really don’t think I can keep using this app.

Half of my home feed is just filled with ads now rather than actual content. There’s also a huge influx of AI “art” that isn’t even specified to be AI, which takes away reach from actual human artists. My biggest problem however, is the awful censorship that’s going on with the site. After getting multiple pins I saved wrongfully deactivated in the span of one month, I am fed up. Pinterest will take down a pin that could be just an art anatomy reference or someone showing even a little bit of shoulder or cleavage and label it as “adult content,” for example. Though sometimes the image is blurred so heavily that its hard to tell what exactly violated their guidelines. It’s frustrating, especially since they are targeting the people who merely save the images rather than the people who post them. And then even when they reinstate it, it still poses a risk to their account, because it counts as a violation. I really do want a change in the way enforcing community guidelines works. By what I understand, they use AI to determine if the pin goes against them or not. It’s just that a human has to report the pin beforehand. It’s over-moderation at its finest. Yet somehow, they still let their site be flooded with suspicious ads and AI. We should get more real people to determine whether the content is harmful or illegal, because the moderation they have in place is not working. I’ve even heard of entire boards taken down and accounts suspended without because of this broken regulation. In short, Pinterest is focusing on the wrong things. As a result, it’s not the inspiring, peaceful place it once was.

reviews.t: This app is unusable and ruined.
reviews.x: I used to be a super avid Pinterest user - probably my most used app, taking up most of my screen time. I loved having a peaceful, relaxing app to create aesthetic boards and organize pins. That is gone. Out the window. This app has become the opposite of relaxing and is completely unusable. The amount of ads are absolutely INSANE. More ads than actual pins? Do you hate your user base? I really don’t understand. And the few normal-looking pins that DO show up are always unrelated, low-quality and littered with random captions that you cannot delete, completely ruining any sense of aesthetic this app had left. A photo of a girl with a ponytail? Finally, something to save to my hairstyles inspo board - oh. Of course, the caption reads “18+ Jikook Sexy Mafia Fanfic 🔞😈” … Alright. Never mind. My home feed is a visual nightmare. If that weren’t enough, the bugs and crashes make the app almost literally painful to use. The search and filter function is unusable at the moment, you literally cannot filter anything without a giant error message or the app just crashing. I am angry, spiteful even, at whoever developed this app into the ground. Whoever made Pinterest the monstrosity that it is now, I hope the ad revenue is worth losing your entire user base. Actually, I don’t. I hope you suffer for a long time. You are the worst.

I’ve used this app for many years and not really had any complaints, but recently I’ve noticed more and more of my boards are “disappearing”. I didn’t understand why either and was worried it was a bug in the system. So I went searching to see if anyone one else was having the same problem and yes, many have. What I don’t understand is if a pin violates the guidelines of the app why not remove the pin that violates the guidelines from the one who posted on the app and not deactivating the entire board of re-pins? What gets to me is I’M the one being punished from someone else not following the “guidelines” when posting on Pinterest, all I did was repost the pin onto my board. I didn’t even upload it on the app! I can’t even re-create the old board, because It tells me that that board already exists - which is completely stupid! Not only do I not get my board back, but I can’t even recreate it! I find that unfair and I don’t see why I have to go through the website just to have this fixed that should not be a problem! (Which I have found doesn’t usually work all the time, most have given up trying to get them repealed because support isn’t much help. ) I’m honestly just frustrated and thinking of just deleting my account. I have many pins on here that I’ve had again for years and love using for either art or cooking, but knowing that my boards could become deactivated any moment it “violates guidelines“ doesn’t make it any easier to want to stay… Even with the “guidelines” it feels ridiculously strict and not to mention horribly broken, I’ve seen things that aren’t remotely inappropriate are flagged as inappropriate. I don’t know what happened to this app, but I’m very disappointed in the direction it’s going.

So Pinterest, I am really not like writing a review on that. I’m really just like saying talking about the privacy policy because I’m 17 and I put my age as 10 because I didn’t want really adult inappropriate content because I’m 17 year-old so I was just really upset because I have a private account since your policy 16 under is a private account but I really wanna account and if I don’t all my progress and content so I’m pretty upset and I just basically sign out of that app and signed back in. It recognizes my account and it puts me back in my account and I don’t have my agent which I wanna put my agent so I just would really want an update on the app because, I am just having some trouble because I’m 17 year old and I think everyone’s really responsible by the age of 11 so I think you should change that privacy policy to 11 because I mean by six by 17th they’re gonna be on Instagram and things like that I’m on TikTok and things but sinceI’m private account so I think you just really change the private account setting up because by the age 11, they’re really responsible and I think they can handle what they put up on their account and post so yeah that’s my dilemma but yeah so please considering updating this app because it would really help a lot and everyone would probably need this too please consider this idea and if you don’t i’ll just have to live with a private account for six years although I would be like in my 20s by then so yeah please consider my idea

I’ve had the app for years and always used it for just about everything I wanted to make changes aesthetically or for ideas. I’ve been unable to load anything from the boards and when I ask for help it’s useless. I’ve followed all the steps for IOS, it’s all up to date, I’ve deleted the app, restarted the phone, loaded it again, used other browsers, different WiFi, cleared my cache from everything, reset my phone, did absolutely everything the “help” had to offer and it still doesn’t work. They insist it has something to do with any or all of the items I just mentioned but it hasn’t changed that Pinterest is no longer useful. The boards aren’t loading so I can’t see any of the images. I’ve done it all. Every other app works on my phone except Pinterest. They need to do a major update or something to fix the bug. I’m tried searching a solution to the problem and it seems hundreds of other people are experiencing the same issue, how is that on us and not on Pinterest? I wish they can just fix the issue. One day it was working in the morning and than it just looked like a blank board at the end of the day. How do you explain that?

pinterest is great in theory, but it has so many glitches and bugs that are just never fixed and it makes it hard to use. i also hate how i get emails and notifications whenever a pin that i didn’t even make gets taken down. this on its own is stupid, but it’s even stupider that i get in trouble for a pin that, i repeat, I DIDN’T EVEN MAKE. my account has gotten suspended for this once before a few months ago and i had to email pinterest to get it back, which fortunately only took about a week. the thing is i never post anything on this app, i literally only save things and it’s kind of unacceptable that this has happened for something that wasn’t really my fault. it’s often for “adult content”, but nothing i can recognize from the blurred picture (i normally can’t even recognize the pin so how am i supposed to know the problem) is adult. it’s always just memes. i can deal with the glitches, but this is just something else entirely. additionally, i couldn’t even see the blurred pictures until recently because i didn’t get pinterest notifications, only emails that had links to the pins. unfortunately, these links literally never worked so i had absolutely no idea what was going on. please fix this, other users shouldn’t be getting punished for things someone else did.

reviews.t: Devolving into every other socials app
reviews.x: Pinterest is such a gem of an app and has been for over a decade but as of late you can tell that they’re headed towards turning into just an other content recycling app like everything else. I love Pinterest because their algorithms GOT me and I’d see or be suggested stuff that I wouldn’t ever find anywhere else, whereas instagram would just show me the same thing a million times over. But now it feels like I’m just getting my instagram feed on Pinterest. My home feed will quickly turn into an amalgamation of the last few things I pinned or searches and not actual topics or boards that I follow anymore. Not to mention the ADS my god no app shows me more ads concurrently than Pinterest does and I HATE it. This morning I was scrolling and I had 5 different ads in a ROW it completely ruins the user experience and makes me just close out of the app instead cause why in gods name would I want to scroll through a feed where the ad to content ratio is 1:1 or sometimes even 2:1. It’s greedy. Not to mention the AI art is such a plague! I just want to see what’s already been done in the real world and instead you search “zen interiors” and all that comes up is 30 different AI generated images by the same dude. Like at least give us the option to filter them out it’s ridiculous. This app really did used to be one of the great creative resources of the internet and there still is so much that’s good about it but if every platform tries to turn into instagram or tik tok then eventually only one app is going to come out on top and I can promise you it’s not going to be Pinterest if they keep this up.

reviews.t: READ THIS PLEASE !!AI is not art !!
reviews.x: Dear Pinterest, This is the first time I’ve been compelled to write a review for an app. I’ve used Pinterest for years, ever since I first got into art and writing. Not once did I have any complaints about this app until now. I mainly use Pinterest to get a diverse spread of inspiration but now this app is starting to lose its use for me. I search up anything related to art ITS ALL AI!!! I try to filter the search to have real art and it’s no use. Now it’s become that I can’t even tell anymore! How can I use a reference if something that is non-consistent ? I can’t get get inspired if everything looks the same. It’s soulless and basically stealing since it comes from multiple artists. Now I know there’s freedom on Pinterest’s users to post whatever they like so I’m not saying to stop ai from being posted. Im asking that when someone searches up art everything SHOULD NOT BE AI. It mocks artists and it pains them to know that a computer generated art is all they can find instead of their art from real artists. Pinterest, please add a feature that can block ai from searches or at the very least put a warning when something is ai.

reviews.t: Not What it Used To Be
reviews.x: When Pinterest started out, it was a fun way to save images you liked and to connect with others with similar interests. Over that past couple of years it’s really changed, and in some ways not for the better. I didn’t really mind when ads started to appear, but now they are so numerous, they almost equal the number of images on display. Too much! Also, I have constant problems loading certain pictures (I do a lot of animals and prehistoric life) with museum skeletons, antlers, ice age hunters - stuff with sharp angles - that post with an image search icon, which allows you to hunt for similar images. They load with the icon, but overnight, despite a descriptive title and caption, the icon disappears and I’m left with a frozen picture. (Yet I’ll find the same image posted elsewhere with a functional icon). When I flip through images, the app often freezes. Tech support is awful - one guy responded “We don’t have time to deal with individual cases.” Bottom line, I get the impression that Pinterest is now all about making money and either doesn’t care about user support, or tech just doesn’t understand what’s user friendly. Disappointing and no longer enjoyable.

It’s a great app like you can look up pictures and anything also there’s another good app called lemonade so you should also try that one out by Pinterest. You can look at anything anything you want best thing you can even look at you search it up and be there and you could save your pictures and I think it’s just an amazing app personally I was going to choose my phone. I choose Pinterest and Pinterest, you look up nails it’ll show you also it’ll have you look at things that like it’ll have you some that are things that you like and it’ll put on your Pinterest pictures so you should really check it out if anyone’s reading this please do it. I’m reading it five star because also, there’s no errors or anything to it like there’s no ads. It’s a good good thing. There’s also videos on this Pinterest app. You really do it like if you play Roblox or if you play Minecraft or if you like looking at nails or you like buying shoes, stuff ideas soit’s so amazing. There’s no ads too so it’s so good Pinterest.

reviews.t: User Experience Has Plummeted Over The Last Year
reviews.x: I keep getting pins that don’t break TOS taken down. I hate that I can just lose my account over a photo someone else shared that I saved. I’m getting photos taken down of things that aren’t even remotely inappropriate. A number of words are now censored. You can’t even search things with words like boy, girl, dad, anime, Lolita, ect, because they refuse to actually deal with predators and instead just censor everyone’s experience. That’s far from the only problem with this site. It’s now filled with AI garbage. I can’t find decent reference photos anymore because the search results are bogged down by unlabeled and irrelevant AI generated images. There’s no point in using this site if I can’t even do half of what I could just a year ago on here. You’d think a website that relies so heavily on users submitting photos and the user experience would try to combat the AI and censorship issues. I used to use Pinterest to save memes, Sims mods, art references, ect. But it’s pointless if half of the stuff I save gets removed despite meeting TOS just a year or two ago. I honestly hope these falling social media sites get competitors that will actually address these issues because most of them are almost unusable now.

OKAY first things first i adore this app. i’ve loved it for as long as i’ve known it. however….. some more recent features (or glitches you could say) have made it difficult to use the app & love as much as it deserves. okay now for the nitty gritty things that are not to my liking (AT ALL). when i’m posting pins & my MUSIC STOPS PLAYING. please please please don’t make my music stop i’m begging. pinterest + music = god tier. if you take away the music from that mix everything just falls flat. i’ve used this app for years & have never had that problem so i’m very much sad about this new development. it’s made me cut back in posting/using the app tremendously. now another thing that has made me lose interest in the app (i have loved in the past dearly) is when i post certain pictures (not sure if there’s a correlation in the pictures for it to do this or not) & it will flip it upside down???? or alter the picture by zooming in or something. super funky & took me a while to figure out nothing i did would fix the picture in the app so i had to screenshot the picture the original way & use the screenshot to post. unfortunate loophole i had to use. please please fix these things for your loyal & loving fan, L. please hear my pleading pinterest.

reviews.t: Great platform with some room for improvement
reviews.x: I love Pinterest - It is by far the best visual search platform and I love that I can find ideas for just about anything while sharing some of my own. It does however have some bugs that need fixing. The biggest is the inability to update my profile information, particularly my website. No matter how many times I update my website and save it, the old url is still there. That’s not great as a business account. I had the same thing happen with my email and profile photo although after a few tries those finally did update. Another minor thing that I’ve noticed for a while…if I zoom into an image, the image freezes. There’s no way to X out or go back so I have to force close the app and lose my place. It would also be nice to “go back” to an earlier version of my discovery page. Sometimes I’ll go to the page, see something I’m interested in, but then the page refreshes before I get the chance to click on it. I also wish there was a way to bulk update the website linked on a post without having to do each post one at a time. These are some suggestions and ways I think the app could be better.

I used to love this app. I’ve had it for years, and as both an author and screenwriter it has helped me with the development of what I am writing thanks to its visual appeal, aiding me in creating boards that fit the theme and inspire me with those same images as well as with other literary quotes. But in the past few months it is near impossible to search up anything that comes to mind and fits the aesthetic of what I am looking for. I cannot even look up references by physical descriptors such as “middle aged man” or “young red haired woman” or what not, as it is immediately flagged. Not only this, but according to the email reports I keep receiving, a total of 26 pins that I have saved to my previously existing boards have been flagged and taken down. Looking up on other social media platforms I’ve seen that apparently many holistic related searches (essential oils mainly) are also being censored and instead met with advertisements for vaccinations? Now I for one am pro-vax and also pro-holistic medicine, but to erase one and pander towards the other is just unfair. Speaking of advertisements, I’ve also received several ads of clothing recently that somehow have my very uncommon legal last name on them as the design, which I find very unsettling and invasive because I do not use my legal last name on this social media, nor do I use it on any social media whatsoever including my email address! This is borderline unjust, creepy, and all around tyrannical! Give us back the old Pinterest with our deserved freedom of expression and viewing. Especially if it’s AI that is going through to flag what it deems “inappropriate” because so far it is sorely wrong. Sincerely, A very unhappy user…

reviews.t: pinterest is GREAT, but theres a few things i dislike about it!
reviews.x: first of all, i wanna say that pinterest is the absolute BEST way to get inspiration!! it doesn’t matter what type, pinterest has everything. theres something for everyone! as an artist, i love specifically saving pins for my drawing board :) i also love how accepting and respectful the community is. i really think that i feel safe on pinterest! one thing that annoys me a little bit though, is how when people reply to your comments/like your comments most of the time it doesn’t give you a notification. another thing is that pinterest gives somewhat useless notifications. like the “soandso commented on a pin you saved!” i feel like that one is pretty useless, and ive heard many other pinterest users think that as well. the last problem i have with pinterest is when you want to search up something, a lot of the time it says “no pins found” which annoys me because i would just be searching up something simple. Despite a few issues, pinterest IS a great app. and i will definitely still be using it! it really has boosted my art journey + inspired me to start other hobbies :) Thanks for reading. (i hope the creators see this)

I love Pinterest - as a SAHW, I greatly appreciate having a place to learn & organize new recipes, cleaning hacks, and crafting ideas so easily. However, using this app drives me absolutely NUTS sometimes because the touch sensitivity is out of control! It seems that if I simply hover my finger over an ad, the webpage is opening. If I barely touch a pin to continue scrolling, suddenly, the website to the pin will open, or a “visual search” has somehow been initiated. It makes it borderline impossible to just slowly scroll through my feed & add new pins to my board. It’s not like I don’t open pins & ads on my own - my feed is VERY personalized, and that’s why I love Pinterest so much! I’ve even made purchases from Pinterest ads before. But please, let ME make the decision on what posts I open & when! No other app I’ve used, social media or otherwise, is this sensitive to taps/input. The iOS Pinterest app would be 100% flawless if this small (yet surprisingly infuriating) issue was addressed.

reviews.t: Beware Pinterest is like high school and will ban you but not the ones who make the post
reviews.x: Many times you save a post that most would be considered art, or even if it’s two people hugging under a blanket not showing any nudity somebody may report it and Pinterest will stand by it as adult content when there is truly nothing adult about it. They will target you and not the posts actual creators of the post! Some of their paid sponsors ads show more skin and actual adult context than what you may post yet they will target you for saving such posts! It’s pointless making folders here and saving pins-other than recipies! Abandon ship this app is dead there is nothing you can do here! There are plenty of romance novelists which post all types of posts yet Pinterest allows them, but if one shares their post you will be the one reported and banned, not the author because they pay to post their content possibly?! Which makes this an absolutely unusable app. Please report everyone who has any innocent looking romantic posts which say something sweet yet show people hugging or kissing and watch that person get reported and banned it’s ridiculous! Yet the posts are allowed to continue because such authors are not targeted only the Pinterest users are targeted! As a result this app is garbage very little you can do here… there are apps that allow you to save personal lists, websites, pictures, etc. to make lists for like birthdays and weddings which are private or just shared with a few friends alone and those apps are better because you can save anything and not get targeted by karens that work there or who may target you out of bios or jealousy! This app has become utter garbage! Even this review they keep censoring I’m assuming in order to keep their rating higher! This company is the worst!

reviews.t: i have a bone to pick rn
reviews.x: I love Pinterest, and i have been using it since 2018 so far. Pinterest has always been my muse for outfit creating. For example, if i dont know what to wear with a specific article of clothing, i will just look up on pinterest, “Black skirt casual outfits” and normally i will gets lots of pins of cute outfits. but recently ive noticed that every single time i look up something like that, all i get is products. now dont get me wrong, the product pins can be quite useful ive found, but for heavens sake i just want to find outfits i dont want to buy something! and when i mean thats all i get, i mean its literally just pages upon pages of products whether its like shein or urban outfiters. it would help a lot of there was a way to filter those pins out. thats all i came here to say since idk how to send direct feedback, but if youre reading this and have the same problem, it would be helpful if you wrote or sent something similar to try and get pinterest's attention on this. after all, pinterest’s entire premise is to be able to find ideas for things you already have in your possession, not to gets thousand's of links to either expensive or morally wrong ways, (shein/temu) to get certain items.

reviews.t: Pinterest is a good app weighed down by unwanted updates and excessive advertising
reviews.x: It’s nice for collecting ideas, but since I first got on Pinterest 8 years ago, it seems that they care wayyy too much about making changes to the front end that no one wants (most recently those godawful dashed lines???) Their user interface changes in little ways so often and ends up disorienting users, and they often end up just removing them with the next update anyway. Also, the amount of ads, Shop Similar and Shop the Look is getting obnoxious. I’m not able to focus on the pins anymore because of these glaring advertisements. There are just too many, there are usually just as many ads as pins or close to it when you first scroll for a bit under a pin. It’s gotten to the point where I get overwhelmed by them and just close or delete the app for a long while until I have something particular I want to use it for. If they want to advertise so aggressively, I wish they would just make a paid option to get rid of ads if they need the money that bad. Or maybe reel back on their developers since no one wants this many front end changes anyway.

reviews.t: Deleted account of 2 years and oh 5+ years
reviews.x: I still haven’t heard back your system is so unfair. Why should Iiiii get punished for other people’s posts and your bad app detection functions. Like if you don’t want certain things posted on your platform BAN THE ONES WHO POST IT. Like literally with this new SECOND account I had to make, I look up things like “anime expressions “ and a bunch of lewd pictures of anime characters. And in the little recommended tabs you can see sexual things whenever I’m looking up something innocent for art. I get recommended “cute matching pfp “ and it’s manga 6 scenes. But yea ban me twice. Like my bf said it’s like deleting a brain file because I already had to start over from my other account that I had since prolly 12 years old. It had every possible interest I have and even some I developed thx to this app. I had art, fashion, makeup, hobbies, dates with my bf and friends!, Travel and new things I wanted to try. EVERYTHING GONE. and I can’t remember any of it. Deleted file in my head it’s terrible. I had boards with tabs for art ideas I wanted to make and now I don’t remember them. Each one had multiple hours of research for the perfect references. I lost all motivation. Hundreds of hours and motivation wasted because you guys can’t fix your app. I used to get on this app when I would feel down or wanted creativity ideas. I I really did love this app and I still do just less cuz of this. And the WORST PART IS its my second or third time writing a message like this and I either get no response or I’ve gotten basically “ We don’t know what you’re talking about” Love it.

Pinterest has become my absolute favorite app, a boundless well of inspiration and creativity that I simply cannot live without. Every time I open the app, I am greeted with a visually stunning array of ideas and projects that ignite my imagination and fuel my passions. The diversity of content is staggering; whether I'm searching for home decor tips, new recipes, fashion trends, or travel destinations, Pinterest consistently delivers fresh, relevant, and beautifully presented pins that cater to my every interest. The user interface is incredibly intuitive and user-friendly, making it a joy to navigate through the endless boards and pins. What sets Pinterest apart is its smart algorithm that personalizes my feed with uncanny accuracy, ensuring I discover new content that aligns perfectly with my tastes and preferences. This personalized touch keeps me coming back for more, eager to explore and save new ideas. Moreover, Pinterest is more than just a visual feast; it's a platform for learning and growth. Countless tutorials, how-to guides, and informative articles have helped me acquire new skills and complete projects I never thought possible. The sense of community on Pinterest is another highlight, as it allows me to connect with like-minded individuals who share my passions and interests. Interacting with other users through comments, follows, and shared boards fosters a supportive and collaborative environment that enhances my overall experience. In my opinion, there is nothing wrong with Pinterest; it’s a flawless app that continuously evolves to meet the needs of its users, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a wellspring of creativity and inspiration. recommend definitely💕🛼💐

reviews.t: LOVE Pinterest, it’s just SO broken
reviews.x: As stated in the title, I LOVE this app. It just breaks constantly while operating as normal. -I have to refresh it multiple times for an hour of usage because it gets stuck and I can’t move anything anymore. Moving pins from one board to another will only move half the pins, boards get randomly shuffled out of order, can’t save the same pin to two different sections of a board or else the second one doesn’t save unless you save it twice, and generally a lot of error messages for normal operations. -The flagging system also needs an overhaul. I’m an artist and I save a lot of pose references. They’re usually “nude” figures but not explicity and constantly get removed for nudity/sexual content when there isn’t any. They can be appealed and reinstated and while most are, I get radio silence from a lot of appeals with no yes or no answer. Some appeals don’t even go through. Some pins don’t get the option of appeal and the one-time links never open properly. -Overall, wonderful app and I would give five stars if it didn’t have so many software issues. They have weekly updates to “polish” with buf fixes and performance improvements, but they need way more than polishing to fix these problems.

I’ve had Pinterest for many years and I absolutely love to use it for room, outfit, and hair inspo, as well as finding cute wallpapers for my phone. My life looks so much prettier now thanks to Pinterest and I highly recommend it to anybody and everybody! HOWEVER the app has become seriously oversaturated with ads. If I’m just scrolling through my home feed or searching for something specific, it has reached a 2:1 or even 3:1 ratio of ads to actual photos and ideas. It’s ruining my experience in the app and making it harder than it’s ever been to discover new ideas. Overall, this app is my go-to for inspiration in every aspect of my life, from my outfits to my hobbies. I personally believe that this app is healthier to be on than any other because it’s not as addictive and like I said, it inspires you to make your life more beautiful. However, I will be on this app less and less the more saturated it becomes with ads, which just makes it like any other app experience at this point.

Had pinterest for over a decade and it’s still my #1 source for inspiration & aesthetics on creative projects. Lately there will be an ad on the screen at all times no matter if I’m on the home page, in a search, etc. There is always at least one ad on the screen which means I’m always ignoring some % of my screen and it takes longer to find what I want/need. A lot of other reviews have commented abt that and I agree it’s gotten out of hand. Additionally, half the time when I go to click on pins it’s not a true pin, but some sort of shopping opportunity added by a retailer with no comments and no related pins. When I search for fashion aesthetics etc it just automatically takes me to a shopping area. I don’t want to shop on pinterest and I’d like to be able to turn that feature off. Update: As though that wasn't bad enough, lately my feed has been flooded with AI images in every category. No matter what I search for, someone has uploaded dozens of fake nonsense that does not help with anything because it does not represent reality! No way to report, block, or filter this out.

reviews.t: Love this app but I have a few problems
reviews.x: I’ve had Pinterest for over two years and I love it! Recently I discovered collages which I’ve been obsessed with making but there’s a problem. When I put text in my collage and delete the black border around it after I’ve published my collage and then click on it the black border shows up again. And it’s not like I can get rid of it because once you publish a collage you can’t edit it whatsoever (which I also don’t like) and so now all my text has a weird black border around it covering all the photos of my collage. And also I made a collage and published it, and then the app just decided to not save it. It’s not in my collages section, it’s not in created or work in progress. It’s not even in art where I saved it to. The only place I could find it was in recently saved so I had to quickly favorite it so it didn’t get lost. But it’s only with that one collage, I’ve made others and they all save. Another things is that there are a lot of ads, once I was scrolling and there was only one actual post while the others were all just ads. Sometimes I like it when relevant ads pop up, but I don’t like that many. Ok last problem, sometimes I’ll scroll through my old boards to delete some things I don’t like anymore and then when I click edit the screen just freezes. It’s so annoying because I have to close out of the entire app and then scroll all the way back to where i was before it froze. And then sometimes it freezes with the same pin two or three times in a row! All I want to do is delete a pin!

I’ve used Pinterest for probably close to 10 years now and for a long time it was my absolute favorite place to be. The people here were nice, the site always listened to critiques and suggestions and changed the app accordingly, and that was one of my favorite parts about it, that it was always improving for the people who are on it every day. But these days I barely use Pinterest at all, it’s sad to watch the downfall. Every other picture is an ad, every pin has these stupid dots, lines, and shadows put over them that make it extremely difficult to even see the picture in the first place, all these dots and lines are doing is trying to sell you stuff and apply AI to an image that doesn’t need it, the whole place has been filled with AI, tapping on an image takes you to a shop instead of the site the picture is actually from, and they’ve taken away features that made it fun and easy to use. Overall it’s very clear that the people who run Pinterest are no longer designing this app for people, they’re designing it for corporations and brands. Maybe it’s just me, but I don’t use Pinterest to shop, I look at this app for inspiration and ideas, for art and poetry and cute pictures of animals, and it has been a very long time since I’ve felt inspired or uplifted by Pinterest at all.

reviews.t: Used to be a great app
reviews.x: I like this app a lot when it is functioning properly. My wife and I use the same account and it essentially functions as our online cookbook. I use the latest version of iOS and where I once had pictures of recipes there are now just blank spaces. This is particularly irritating for my recipes that are just pins of recipes that are pictures or screenshots that I used. There is no way for me to see those recipes. For the others I can still usually go to a website but the problem with that is I have trained my brain to identify many of those recipes by the picture that I chose to identify the pin. I have cleared the cache on the app, deleted the app and reinstalled it, and nothing works. I have even accessed the app through safari and chrome and the same problem persists when using my phone. This issue is only on my device. My wife has no issues and every computer that we have can also access it with no issue. I have contacted Pinterest tech support but they are not responsive. If anyone else had the issue and fixed it please LMK what you did.

So I love this app and I have a MAJOR crush on Jenna Ortega and I love to edit and so I make edits in Jenna Ortega but sometimes when I’m trying to find videos or pictures of her for the edit I find very exposing photos of her like a AI picture of her almost if she was likes to make adult content and I am not into that type of stuff and all I want is just pictures of her but not pictures like that and I’m sure there is some children on this app and so it should be kid friendly but I don’t remember if there was a kid safety button thing but if there isn’t one please put one but if there is one thank you but even I would not like photos like that but there is also movies that she acts in for example “Miller’s Girl” that is a VERY sexual movie but the whole reason I know about that wanted to watch it, it was because she is my favorite actress and the movie was ok but I don’t think it’s ok to photos of her on this app but overall this app is great. P.S Thank you for taking your time and reading this message

Ok so umm i thought that Pinterest was an app where you find new sources of inspiration, so why are you showing me photos that I’ve already seen over and over again based of my search history or boards. It’s getting frustrating and let me not even delve into how this whole app is a modern day waste land with half of the pins being advertisements. Whenever I search something I see nothing new or different it will literally just show me similar pins inspired by things I’ve saved in the past or recently. So like did half the images on this app dissolve or something? Why do I have to scroll hours just to find a good image. This is not instagram it’s Pinterest! Also when I try to search anything in similar images it will automatically crop a product on the picture instead of the whole thing. Which is minor but it just goes to show you where their value lies. Other than this I don’t really mind the app. I’ll continue to use it because I actually really enjoy this app. To anyone who wants to download this just remember this app actually was once good and not greedy for money and engagement.

reviews.t: It exits the board too easily!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.x: Edit: Too! Many! Ads! It’s by far the majority of things I see when scrolling. Rendering the app almost unusable which is so sad. Hi. I have used and loved Pinterest for a decade and have almost never had a problem with it. But with the most recent big update (where they added the Watch tab, etc) the app is so frustrating it makes it almost unusable for me. The home page algorithm is too easily swayed; after one niche pin I see so many for that topic, and I just don’t have time to go ‘turn off topic’ every time. Therefore, I spend most time on Pinterest now perusing my own boards to get inspiration. Here is where my real problems begin. If I am not absolutely careful when scrolling up within my own board, the smallest movement of my thumb will make me be swiped out of the board. !!!!!! It is so so frustrating to only ever get a few scrolls in before this happens. Also, when I am on a pin, and I want to scroll down to see related pins, it instead locks me in looking at the things for purchase or search within the pin, and it takes multiple tries to successfully scroll down. Please I’m begging you, make the swiping mechanism less sensitive. A final thought- I come to Pinterest to escape the regular things social medias offer (short form video, influencer hype, the like). It feels totally cheap for Pinterest to follow suit in some of these ways. Sincerely, a woman who likes everything else about Pinterest still and gives it 5 stars in my heart, but one star on this review so someone might see it.

This app is awesome! It’s a great app to find inspiration for lots of things like crafts, art, and more. I love going on the app to find profile photos for my social media accounts, and it never disappoints I always end up finding one. Just I wish we could save videos. (I know someone made a review about this already), but it would be so nice to have the ability to save videos or gifs. In the app, if you find a photo or pin you like, you can just press and hold and it’ll give you the option to save it to your camera roll, can we please do that with videos/gifs? 🙏🏻 Iv’e heard if you want to download a gif from Pinterest you have to download a whole other app??(I don’t remember what it’s called) I want to save gifs/videos but not so bad to download completely different app? Because of this if I want a gif I need to go to Google/Safari. Which it’s not that bad, it’ll work too but usually (especially for me) I never find good ones on Google. Pinterest always has the coolest and best gifs but I never find those ones that are on Google. I just ask, please fix this if possible. It would make it so much easier to find good gifs.

I’ve had my Pinterest account for nearly 10 years and I haven’t used it recently until 2017, so I saved many pins over the course of the years up until now consistently. Most of the pins I saved are for aesthetic reasons for character boards and just stuff that made me laugh, I have been getting emails about pins being removed but I don’t see a problem since I’ve saved nearly 8k pins and don’t really remember nor care if they got removed or not. It wasn’t a problem up until Pinterest deactivated my account for “violating too many policies”. Then after my account for back up again they told me to look through my whole account for any pins that doesn’t violate their rule, like I’m not gonna scroll 8k pins just to find something that pinterest doesn’t like. Half of the pins they removed were mainly art inspirations, I have a board that’s filled with pose references of irl people but apparently they removed the few MLM poses that was on there. It’s unbelievable cause they labeled it as “sexual content” and it would be a pin about two dudes hugging. Get real, Pinterest. You’re gonna lose the community that uses Pinterest in the first place and make it unfriendly for new users :/, I bid thee adieu brah

Today I tried to join Pinterest for fun and because my friend had it. My friend and I are both 12 years of age. I wasn’t even thinking that most social media apps require you to be 13 or older, so when I went on the App Store I was happy to see it said 12+. I am a strict rule follower and do not want to lie to anyone or anything, so that was a happy sight. I downloaded the app and used my actual birthdate, as, as previously stated, I do not want to lie and it seemed fine as the App Store said my age was allowed. When I actually put in my birthday, it said something along the lines of “you are too young to join the app”. I later tried to see if it was just something in the app, so I went to the website for Pinterest and a similar thing happened. This is fine, I don’t actually care that much, but I would just recommend choosing one minimum age. Thank you for reading this! P. S. I rated this three stars not because I have only seen the pins my friend has sent me. That doesn’t actually matter. I just rated it three stars because that is basically the middle! Thank you again for reading!

I’ve been a Pinterest user since 2011 so I’ve seen all of the changes of the app for over a decade. Usually the updates Pinterest made in the past has been for the better and I believe that is why they have been able to keep up with the ever changing social media landscape. However, in the past few years they have gone too far. The thing that bothers me the most is that I never get update about the people I follow anymore. I never seen them in my home feed or my notifications, so I don’t know what they are pinning so it makes following people moot because the homepage has become for suggested pins and pinfluencers. And I don’t my the pushing of influencers and suggested pins I just wish we would also be able to see the people we follow. Getting rid of the follow tab was a bad move. Second, when I search for something it doesn’t show me pins based on what I search but rather it shows pins from topics that I’ve already looked at. As a result, I’m less inclined to use pinterest, because it just doesn’t function anymore. It’s sad because it used to be my favorite social media app with the other’s not even coming close. And not only for me but my friends as well. It was a way for us to bond and share ideas to each other. But now I don’t even know if any of us use it as much. I would love an new update where they correct these things but I don’t see that happening so until then I’m just not going to use the app as much as I did.

reviews.t: Great app most of the time, having an issue
reviews.x: My issue is more of a concern. I use pinterest to save pictures of drawing inspiration, clothes, celebrities and just pictures that i find pretty or artsy. I use it for absolutely nothing bad whatsoever. But ive been recently receiving emails and messages saying that some pins I’ve saved before are getting deleted because they dont follow the guidelines. Like i said, i have never pinned anything that could possibly make me receive this message. Getting it one time would be okay, but I’ve been getting a violation notice on my pinterest inbox almost everyday. I read the PDF and it said that if they keep finding pins ive saved to delete, they will deactivate my account. Why im scared : keep receiving messages, meaning they keep finding things to delete. They will take my account away from me if they keep finding things to delete. Pinterest, i beg you, if theres any way to fix this, PLEASE fix it. I have over 20,000 pins in my account and if i lose it i do not know what i am going to do

Ive used pinterest for years, never had a problem with it, absolutely love it. But just a week or so ago my phone had updated the app and now every time i click on a pin whatever is the focal point of the image gets outlined by this little dashed line for a couple seconds and goes away. I know that sounds like not to big an issue but it seriously obstructs the whole feel of pinterest😅 After a while of clicking through pins it gets extremely irritating seeing it outline something on literally every single pin i click on. I do not need every object in an image outlined. I dont need the focal point of a painting outlined. This doesnt imrove the user experience in any way. This feature could already be accessed before with the little scissor and search icons in the bottom right of the pin, at least then it was in our control and we could choose whether or not we want it to pop up. Ive searched up on multiple sites, looked to see if anyone else had this problem and apparently its been going on couple months now. It wouldn't be too bad if there was a way to turn it off but so far no one has found a lasting solution. Please fix this pinterest! I have loved this app for a long time now but i find myself using it less and less with this new update.

reviews.t: Bugs galore! This app needs pest control.
reviews.x: I have been a Pinterest user for many years now. There are many things I enjoy about the app. I think that the idea of having a digital platform where users can not only create posts but also save posts they see on their feed and even create collections of posts that all have one thing in common is a genius concept. There are so many things to love about Pinterest, however the app is riddled with bugs. Not long ago I created a board on Pinterest titled memes and began adding pins to it, however I noticed that this board unlike any of my other pinterest boards did not have a more ideas button at the top of it right next to organize button. Furthermore, when I created a new board titled meme, and moved all of my pins from that board to the new one, and then deleted the only board, hoping that if I created a new board to replace the old one, that perhaps the new board would have the new ideas button, I ran into another problem. After moving all my pins from the old board to the new one and then deleting the old one, I then attempted to change the name of that board from meme to memes, but when I tried to do this it wouldn’t let me change the name of the board, insisting that I still had another board that was already named memes in spite of the fact that I did not. If all that wasn’t enough, the new board also did not have the new ideas button. I have no idea why every time I try to create a meme board on Pinterest, none of the meme boards I try to create have ever had the more ideas option. I’ve never had any issues like this with any of my other boards so I’m still kind of baffled as to why this is happening. I sincerely hope Pinterest fixes this bug soon.

The new policies and using ai to monitor the platform is causing so many people to either lose their accounts from faulty reports or consider leaving Pinterest entirely. The new CEO wants it to be a shopping site which isn’t even the reason why Pinterest grew so popular in the first place, and now there’s an insane amount of scammy ads which just makes it difficult to use. You don’t have to be experienced in marketing to understand that frustrating and ignoring the needs of your audience is actually gonna cause you to lose money as a company, because people will just end up deactivating their accounts if they haven’t been auto-banned already. Just from taking a few minutes to read through the r/pinterest subreddit I found so many people who are struggling with the exact same things I am. And I mean HUNDREDS of people talking about how completely normal, safe, appropriate pins they’ve saved have been removed because, guess what, ai can’t correctly or accurately tell the difference between normal/sfw and explicit/harmful content. Not that the CEO cares though since he’s been deleting people’s comments with complaints on Twitter. If things don’t change for the better, chances are Pinterest will lose a lot of users and therefore lose revenue from getting too greedy, which I’d hate to see because I used to love the platform. Stop relying on tech bros and ai systems and start actually caring about the people who support you as a company.

reviews.t: I’m having problems but love the app!
reviews.x: First I just wanna say I really love this app, I use it all the time and it’s a great way for me to find now ways to be inspired! I have found lots of cooking recipes, hacks, and just plain videos that make me laugh! With all that said, after using it for almost a year now I do have a couple notes. The app seems to constantly glitch for me. Sometimes, only on this app, the screen just freezes. I try clicking the back arrow or fiddling around with the buttons but it won’t work. Which means I have to go out of the app, and close the screen. After a couple minutes I go back into the app and it’s completely normal. This frustrates me because if I search up clips and am scrolling through them and found a sequence I like I lose it. (Because it sends you videos that it thinks you’ll like everytime.) Another issue I am having with it is sometimes the app will just dim parts of the screen and leave one part highlighted like I double tapped it or something. I try clicking off or pressing a new button, but it is yet again frozen. The last issue I am having which started a week ago, is another screen freezing issue. I am in my boards trying to clean them out and delete pins to refresh them. But while I select and hold a pin to edit it and delete it, it freezes. It only happens while I’m in my edit pin page and I have to close out the app and go back in and scroll all the way back down. It happened 7 times in a row pin after pin. These issues are frustrating and I am starting to get more annoyed with this app. Besides these glitches I really enjoy this app, I find myself trying new things and actually being productive with it. It has inspired me to do so many things! Thanks for reading!

I, like many users here, have been enjoying Pinterest for years - as long as it’s been around. I absolutely love sitting in bed at night watching tv and pinning until I fall asleep! I’ve noticed many of the issues people have mentioned with the updates, and while they are annoying problems I’ve taken them with stride. One change I have noticed and am absolutely SICK of, however, are the overwhelming number of ads that are now being pushed on the app. Pinterest has always felt different from other social media platforms in that way but now it’s just as bad as Instagram. There’s no reason why every other pin should come with three paid ads for products that I could care less about. At this point (I don’t want to) but I would pay for them to go away. I don’t mind a few here and there the way it used to be because I understand brands are paying to have these ads shown to your users, however the increased volume of ads it’s completely ruining the user experience and cheapening the app. PLEASE STOP.

My experience with Pinterest has been a mix of pleasant and unpleasant encounters. While I enjoy the platform's niche-focused content and the absence of social pressure, there are areas where I feel it could improve. One major frustration is the large number of ads that cover the screen and often lead me to accidental clicks. It would improve my experience if Pinterest could reduce how often these ads show up on the screen and make them less intrusive, like other apps. Another part of Pinterest I'd like to see improved is the diversity of content shown on my boards. While I enjoy creating boards based on my interests, I often find myself seeing the same types of images over and over. It would be refreshing to have more varied content that not only has with the specific themes of each board, but with possible new interests as well. One feature that I find very unnecessary is the addition of TikTok-style videos, or more like TikTok copycat type of videos. Pinterest is not TikTok, and I believe the platform should focus on what it does best, which is providing curated content based on users' niche interests. These videos feel out of place and make the overall experience less enjoyable. Additionally, I've experienced problems with posts deleting for no reason, which is frustrating. It would be helpful if Pinterest could provide clearer guidelines on why certain posts are removed to avoid confusion for users like me. However, I still rate Pinterest highly, giving it 4 out of 5 stars. It remains my favorite app because of what it offers and the freedom it gives other users and me to explore my interests without the pressure of socializing. Pinterest has been percious in helping me discover new aesthetics and photos that I wouldn't easily find elsewhere.

reviews.t: why won’t my notifications load + comment section
reviews.x: don’t get me wrong, this app is great! it gives me new ideas, new aesthetics, inspirations, and loads of cute k-pop content! my problem is that even though my notifications pops up, whenever I open the app and go to my notifications, it sometimes doesn’t show them so I have no access to a reply or a comment of mine that some liked. it started doing this more recently, and it’s getting annoying because getting to see interactions on my comments makes me happy, but when I can’t even see which comment or reply it is, that’s hella annoying. the next thing I wanted to comment on was the new update for the comment section… as much as I like how developed this app is getting, the fact that I have to go in and then out and then back in a pin just to see the comment section is crazy irritating. like what does telling us the amount of comments but not even showing them do? if you see this Pinterest, then PLEASE remove the update to the comment section at LEAST. thank you. 🙏

If I scroll up through one of my boards, sometimes it exits out since it’s programmed to do so if you swipe at a slight diagonal angle. This means I have to go back and scroll through hundreds of pins again while making sure to scroll in a perfectly vertical motion, which is very very frustrating. Once you’re on a pin, scrolling sideways is almost impossible without accidentally hitting the “shop similar” or image search feature that causes a pop-up. This app also freezes on me at the randomest times, but more so when I’m just trying to zoom in on a picture. The comments have recently stopped appearing. It still says how many comments there are but I have no option to view them. Also, the amount of pins on my home feed that are just ads is insane. I know you guys have to make money off of a free app but geezus, I think you can afford to tone it down a little. I have tried updating my software system and the app to fix some of these issues but nothing has improved. I still really like Pinterest, but these problems need to be addressed. My rating is based on user experience and not the actual site.

App used to work great, literally for years. This past year it’s gone so far downhill it’s ridiculous. So many ads, and they all have multiple photos that you can scroll through, meaning rather than scrolling past it you scroll to the next image. It then puts that in your “history” feed to base the next pins it shows you off of, because you scrolled to it when you were scrolling through pins. Comments are broken, as many people have been saying - click to see 5 comments, then “tap to add first comment”. Finally, my “updates” tab where you see notifications in the updates screen (super not confusing to have an updated tab in an updates tab, for sure) is supremely broken, won’t load anything, and when it does load it’s to tell me to go to the home page and find some pins to save. I tried filing a bug report in the app, but there is no place to say the updates tab isn’t working, just messages, so I filed it under that, complete with a video of trying to reload it, and got the response “we know messages aren’t working and are working to fix it. Thanks!” And the immediate closing of my ticket and a “please rate your service” email (that also got as low a score as possible, for the record). If you don’t know what’s in your own app, then don’t mess with the features of the app and break other stuff. I’m really getting sick of it.

reviews.t: Love everything except the amount of ads
reviews.x: I love Pinterest so much! It is such a wonderful app that evokes creativity and it is such a positive social media platform. There are many cool features and I love how each person’s feed is now even more reactive to what you click on and view, leading to better recommendations for what should be viewed next. The one problem I have is there is a bucket load of ads! They seemed to have popped up out of nowhere one day and it is almost unbearable. Sometimes I will get so frustrated with the ads that I will stop using the app in that moment. My home feed is probably 40% recommended pins and 60% ads. If you want to swipe to look through pins, you will come across these ads that have a carousel of images within the ad so you have to swipe nearly six times before you can go back to looking at pins. It is really annoying how Pinterest used to be a nice, aesthetic, simple app but now you are bombarded with ads the moment you open the app. It was honestly really disappointing how there is an excessive amount of ads popping up when I just want to scroll through my home feed, but I keep getting ads for brands that don’t even relate to what I am remotely interested in or looking at. I love Pinterest, but I feel like they should fix this issue.

If you want an artistic app that leads to inspiration, ideas, and people sharing their ideas freely, look elsewhere. Pinterest will control what you can save, who can can sign up for an account, who can see your account, what they think your age is, if you can say anything, and whether you can even keep your account because they will ban, suspend, and change any of it on a whim without explanation or legitimate reason and will coax you into revealing your personal information if you want it back, also this personal information (if they get it) will be reviewed by a “trusted” third party as well. Pinterest views themselves as “an app that helps close the deal on people shopping”, it is now nothing more than an app used for marketing purposes and not for anything artistically oriented or inspiring. Pinterest has already closed the deal for a big name marketer to advertise on Pinterest so expect it to only get worse, I’m sure more such deals are in the works too. Also the more the user base lowers the more AI art will be utilized as it already is for censorship and support, the art is the facade and the shopping/advertising is the show now. Pinterest is a profiler for other apps, a marketer, an app thats only priority is to try to get as much info out of you and expose you to as many business sources as possible to make a sale. It’s an app that clearly represents a company and ceo that has now prioritized their investors over their users and app. Hmm… a community driven app that has sold out its users to make themselves look better on paper, let’s see where this goes.

I want to begin by saying, you have been a phenomenal app over the years. Seeing you grow, adhere to the advice of your users making you all the while better, seeing you incorporate different settings for different people has always had us saying “ someone at Pinterest is doing their job” we hope that over there you are team of people who care about your users and don’t see us as cash cows. On that note, the alarming rate of ads is concerning, now don’t get me wrong I understand it’s needed for revenue but seeing multiple back to back, even when reporting some as irrelevant is infuriating. Pinterest, please do not become like the others, you have been a place of inspiration, comfort and new beginnings. You have done what others fail and aspire to do.
