I hope you do read this and understand that as long as I need inspiration Pinterest will be on my board of advisors. Have a nice day. 💕 and please keep putting your heart and souls in this app, we see your hard work.💕💕💕💕 Best Wishes A grateful user.

I’ve been using Pinterest for a very long time, but in recent times the app has been buggy or not doing certain functions it should do when attempted, and there’s a few functions that should be included within the app to make navigating it easier. For starters, I’ve had a issue once where the ‘moving pins’ loading bar got stuck on my phone even off the app, when scrolling down my pins it would be so easy to accidentally slip off and be kicked out of the board creating the issue of having to start scrolling down again, and now moving pins have been a issue, as when the app says the pins were moved, they weren’t moved at all or not all of the ones I selected are moved. I’d hope these bugs will be taken care of soon, and maybe a feature to flip your pins, as whenever you move pins it’ll flip the oldest pins to the top, and a option to jump to the bottom of your pins would be nice instead of having to scroll. Other than that, great app and I’ll continue to use it anyway

I love Pinterest and I've been using this app for a very long time. The reason for the 4-star and not 5 is because of what the title says. For the past week, I have kept getting emails about pins violating guidelines and saying these pins display self-harm, eating disorders, and so on. This is becoming annoying because ya don't say which board, and don't give a link to see the photo, and when ya do say the board nothing in those boards displays anything you are suggesting. I feel people who are saving pins shouldn't be penalized for other people uploading photos that violate your guidelines. I shouldn't have to worry about my account being suspended when I'm not the one uploading photos. Pinterest team ya have to find a better way to write out pictures that violate your guidelines. I can't keep getting emails about pins violating guidelines and having to appeal them. Ya should have it when the person uploads a pic have an actual person assess the pic to see if it doesn't violate ya guidelines.

This is about THE APP specifically. Been using Pinterest for many years on desktop but I’m always on the go so I use the app a lot and it’s starting to get really, REALLY annoying and I don’t remember it always being like this?? First off if you’re using it on a phone, over 50% of what you scroll through is now ads which is extremely visually distasteful not to mention harder at a glance to tell some ads from actual posts on the phone screen and easier to accidentally tap ads which queues a cycle of the app thinking its succeeded at selling you something. My feed used to look so aesthetic and pretty and now it’s equivalent to a scenic landscape with random ugly billboards covering ever square inch. Second and MOST annoying, when selecting a personal board and scrolling back through to find a post, particularly one with a good number of pins on it, holding down your thumb for *slightly* too long to scroll or scrolling just *slightly* off the center of the screen will cause you to exit the whole board and have to scroll ALLL the way back through again to find a pin. And I’m not talking once or twice, I’m talking 10+ TIMES of having to reopen the board to scroll for a couple seconds only have the board exit itself off or you’ll barely touch the screen to tap an image and it just exits off the board. It doesn’t sound troublesome at first but trust me it gets on your nerves and today it finally broke me, hence my review. PINTEREST PLEASE FIX YOUR TERRIBLE APP INTERFACE, IT IS NOT PHYSICALLY INTUITIVE AT ALL!!!!! L app bro. So many updates and STILL hasn’t been fixed. How has no one on the app design team noticed this? Isn’t this annoying to anyone else?

reviews.t: Pretty amazing app, hate the app updates
reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest for around more than a year now, and I do love it for the pins and reactions but a lot of the recent updates from last year is still bothering me. I think it’s making my experiences and access to different things that I can edit on my pins almost restricted. Like for instance, comments. The comment section for some of my pins get automatically turned off and I couldn’t even have the access to turn it back on. As well as viewing or attaching links to the pins too. Making new pins and saving them has been more difficult due to strict copyright rules and regulations. I’m glad that they removed the Pinterest watch feature since I don’t like it looking similar to TikTok or Instagram but seeing too many regulations is bothering me. Lastly the main regulation that is making other people angry too is the underage minor privacy, which it privatized one of my older accounts and almost made it impossible for me to access anything so I have to deactivate it and make a new one (I’m 16+ so them not updating or removing the policy because I’m older now makes it confusing).

reviews.t: Listen…idk what’s going on but it’s gotta stop
reviews.x: I have always loved Pinterest since before I was old enough to have an account. My mom would let me scroll on hers and pin things to my own board. I have now had a Pinterest of my own for probably 5 or 6 years. I love it so so much but lately there are just some weird bugs or something that have been making it really hard to use. Sometimes I’ll be on a pin and then the screen completely freezes and it won’t let me go to the next pin. I have to completely shut out of the app which loses my place of where I was and that’s also extremely frustrating. I know it’s not my phones fault because my mom has the same issue. Another thing is what happened to the story pins? I liked how we could tap through each of the slides and go to the next one or whatever. Now it’s like five different videos in one pin that take forever to load. I love watching tik Toks on Pinterest but lately half of them have said audio not available in this region and that is so annoying. It wasn’t like that before. Why’d it change? Now I’m trying to post my own pins again and they won’t show up in the created section of my profile. I love Pinterest but it’s getting frustrating

Imagine your system being THIS bad that I literally have to try and contact you guys through here to re-activate my account that had been suspended with no good reason. I’ve tried, tried, and tried, to gain access to my account for atleast 2 days, trying to repeal “my violations of hateful activity”. WHAT😭 All I’ve had on my account was silly screencaps and memes. Why are my pins STILL up even when you suspect my posts were being hateful? Isn’t that the whole reason for suspending my account? Because of my pins?? Before banning my account, you’ve given me a warning for one of my pins being “inappropriate” but later had reinstated it. Why even bother taking it off in the first place? Not to mention giving ME a warning for pins I saved because they somehow contained things that had gone against your guys’ policies. Why am I being punished for saving them when I’m not the one who created them? If you see a post that supposedly goes against your community guidelines, take action and don’t let it linger. People will assume that the image or video is appropriate for the website, BECAUSE IT WAS POSTED AND ALLOWED. but suddenly, they get warnings because they saved it? I’m sorry, I love this app, but it’s really frustrating when you’re banning innocent accounts when there is actual gross pins that have broken every single one of your guidelines, and they’re scot free. I suggest not relying on ai if that’s what’s causing this

reviews.t: stop the annoying updates on random things please
reviews.x: For one, the size and shape of the “pin” button changes every few weeks for no reason, and also the animation for when you click on a pin in the homescreen changed a few days ago and it was better before (now it like slides from the left of the screen whereas before it popped from the homescreen instead), as well as being able to move the image around your screen which made it so you could see around the “visual search” and other buttons in the corner that block that part of the image, and now you can’t really do that??? also PLEASE stop turning off comments in created pins, I understand this might be for a safety reason or something but it is VERY annoying especially when a creator was trying to make a pin that users engage with BY COMMENTING ON IT?? and on MY pins they’re often disabled for no apparent reason and then the pins get absolutely no interaction or views. One suggestion I have that is a small thing but is frustrating is when you have sections in a board they don’t switch places by most recent, which idk I just would like it better than manually ordering them. Also I hate the feature where the names of your board are across the top of your screen constantly, never going away, I just don’t like that the names of my boards are always visible from my home page (because some of them have goofy names that are embarrassing 😭😭). y’all just change things too often… but overall I love the app and have been using for many years so❤️❤️

Pinterest is a great app!! You can find hairstyles, recipes, outfit ideas, wallpapers, TikTok’s, and the list goes on and on. Pinterest lets you save multiple pins to one board and you can name the board for whatever it is used for (eg., hairstyles, recipes, outfit ideas, etc.) and the cool thing is you can add collaborators which can add pins to the board as well. There’s also something called sections so say I were to make a board and it was called recipes, I can add sections so that I can separate breakfasts from lunches from dinners from deserts. Boards and sections make it easier to find what you’re looking through in your saved pins. Sections help you separate things while boards are where you save a specific topic of things to. The only downside to Pinterest is that it can get very addicting so make sure to limit your time on there or you will get caught up for hours and hours at a time. I still struggle with the problem, but yes, overall Pinterest is amazing!! They stay consistent with updates and never disappoint!!! OH, AND IT’S COMPLETELY FREE TOO! - 5 stars for you Pinterest, you’ve earned it!!!! Keep up with the hard work 💪🏻

Update: this app continues to get worse and worse. When trying to scroll recipes or organize my pins into sections it frequently freezes or if you scroll up to fast backs out of the folder and you have to start over again at the top. The pins are obviously not the focus anymore-marketing is. Pinterest has always been great for collecting all your inspiring and good ideas in one place but recently they changed the formatting to put content creators who pay front and center and make it harder to personalize what you see. I am also tired of all the little content videos. If I wanted to watch stuff like that I would go on tiktok. Personalized setting are a problem in general. I have looked up in their help center how to add new topics to their feed and still can’t figure out how to do it when that used to be something I adjusted all the time. Lately I have also found more variety in ideas from a google search than looking it up on Pinterest because of their current algorithm. Some of the google image results are even FROM Pinterest but didn’t show up in my Pinterest search! I still have it because I now have years worth of collected pins but I have been considering uninstalling the app more lately.

I’ve been on Pinterest for years. It has gotten worse. First the Likes are replaced with another board, then your feed is flooded with pins from people you don’t follow. This is very much on trend with a lot of social media. Now the search function is awful, only showing a few relevant pins to your search terms before devolving into the algorithmic ‘for you’ content which is just ads and things you most definitely didn’t search for. Pins are often removed due to copyright infringement or new community guidelines (which is fine, artists should get credit for their work and inappropriate content should be monitored at the discretion of the platform) with their ‘one time link’ to check what pin is removed, yet the link never works. The shopping list function is a menace. The image search only focuses on products to market to you. It is so annoying when I think about what it used to be, how excited I was in 2011. I am frustrated with what started as a hub of creative people sharing their projects and experiences becoming just another ad-ridden platform focused on what it can sell you. Is that enough of a pinteresting explanation?

I’ve had Pinterest since I was in 5th grade. (I’m almost an 8th grader now) it is such an amazing app with great qualities. I’ve found my true style/aesthetic and things that make me happy by looking at recommendations or even searching up “teen girl clothing inspiration” sometimes I like watching the funny videos that pop up on my feed but it glitches A LOT. I love making boards and saving ideas for Christmas or my birthday. You can get followers for having people with the same interests and make friends! You can also easily go to websites and be able to buy something cute or comfy you found right off. If you don’t like people seeing what your saving you can make your boards private. Or if you really don’t want people seeing your profile you can make the whole thing private and you can accept certain accounts to follow you. Another cool feature of Pinterest is you can create your own pins/videos. I have a friend who creates dance videos of herself and also days in the life of herself. She’s very cautious of who follows her because, she’s also in my grade. She pays attention to the comments she gets on her videos and makes sure no creeps follow/say something odd to her. Because that has actually happen before and we both witnessed it and reported the man. I recommend you getting this app if you want ideas for a bedroom, or maybe gift ideas for the future. Maybe even food! I’ve found some tasty desserts and dishes while using Pinterest. So overall this is one of the best apps I’ve had! (I still have it to this day but my all time favorite I have right now is Snapchat)

reviews.t: One of my fav apps but. . .
reviews.x: First off, I js wanna say that this is one of my fav apps bc itms sort of like a guide for me in different ways like for hygiene tips, fashion tips, and it exposes me to different types of styles that I don’t think would have been able to try out without this app. But Fashion pins and hair guide pins aren’t the only thing I pin. I pin some things that are seen as “ban worthy”. I find it rlly upsetting when I receive an email saying that they removed a pin that I pinned when whenever is in charge of uploading feed is allowing things like that to be uploaded. I had to create a new account bc my last one got banned for pinning something that was against the app’s guidelines. If that was something I shouldn’t have pinned, either be better about preventing things like these from being uploaded, or before someone can pin it, create some sort of pop up notification telling the person that this certain pin goes against your guidelines. Other than this, I have no issue. It would be much appreciated so that I can know for sure what I shouldn’t pin and what I can.

I really like Pinterest, but the ads are absolutely insufferable. They aggressively bombard the app with them and there isn't even an option to pay for an ad free version. What makes the ads even more annoying is that they are literally never relevant or interesting to me as a user, and many of the products they allow to be advertised on their platform are definitely misleading in their effectiveness and quality, like what essentially looks like scam products. They give you the option to allow them to collect data for "more personalized ads" but it doesn't make a difference at all in what they advertise to you. They also give you the option to hide ads and say they're not relevant, but then they'll continue to advertise the products you hide because a company paid to have it on there, making having the option to hide them completely pointless. It just feels like they are so lazy when it comes to overall usability and user experience on the app and website, and they just want to use Pinterest as a giant ad platform with some neat pictures occasionally in between. Really frustrating experience to have with what otherwise should be a good platform. Edit: I'm deleting the app, it's officially more ads than pins and it just feels pointless to use.

I have used Pinterest for YEARS. I used to love it, but recently I have changed my mind and I will probably stop using the app altogether. The app is so buggy and I think this has gotten worse because of all of the stupid features they have added in recently- the shopping feature and all of the ads and everything related to those have completely turned me away. The dumb swiping feature on pins that pulls up the image search and shopping is so freaking annoying. All I’m trying to do is exit the pin and go back to the page I was on and instead 90% of the time, I’m accidentally swiping wrong and have all these image shopping search results. So annoying. And recently, I’ll swipe down once on the home page when I open the app and suddenly the who app freezes and you have to restart. Over and over. Looking back at my own boards is super buggy now too, same thing where there’s so much lag or it doesn’t exit at all. Edit a year later: it’s gotten even worse. All Pinterest does now is shove advertisements down your throat. 50% of the pins on my feed are ads. They put them in the middle of your own board that you are referencing. Ridiculous.

So I actually enjoy this app for many many reason. It has a lot of good art inspiration, it has cute outfit ideas and cute art that reminds me of me and my boyfriend, also some nice ideas for poetry. All things I love. My issue is that not only do I get really confused sometimes with how everything is set up on the app since I have gotten so used to using the app version with no account for so long, but also the removing of the pins for violation. I understand the reason to remove pins that violate the rules because they’re more vulnerable people who use this app such as younger audiences. But I have 4 issues with this; my first issue being that when I got my first email about one of my pins being removed it showed me a link I could click on to see the remove item. The link was titled “one-time link” and said it would expire in 7 days. A day after I get this email I click on it and it doesn’t direct me to any of my pins but rather just a page of recommended pins from other people which bothered me because I couldn’t see what the thing was. Issue two is when I went to click submit an appeal so I can write about issue 1 it directed my to a blank page that said “submit” with no where to type or anything. Issue 3 is that my pins that I have are just other people’s pins that I pinned privately on my own account. Now I know the rules apply whether it’s private or public but to some extent I don’t think it should if you are at a good age to be making decisions on your own and not relying on an adult. As long as it’s private it should be fine because at that point it is just you and art you probably pinned on your account from other people who are also on Pinterest. For the 4th issue, if it’s on Pinterest in the first place, then I don’t feel like I should get in trouble for privately re-pinning it on my account.

I will preface by saying I don’t mind ads for free apps; and I do engage & click relevant ads often for neat stuff. But within the last couple weeks the newest app updates have ruined the home feed Pinterest experience. I’ve used this app for years YEARS loved it…and have never once thought “wow I may never open this app again” after an update like I did today. Every 4th pin is followed by at least 2 back to back ads/promoted by pins, I counted…closed out of the app and counted again… 3 times. It’s ruined the feel of browsing through fun new creative ideas and slaps you in the face with irrelevant content from advertisers you don’t even want to see. 2 stars because the good content is still there, you just can’t engage or enjoy it with literal blocks of ads per scroll. I’ll check back in the next few updates but if they don’t fix this to make ads more seamless again (or at least less jarringly stacked on top of each other) then it may be time to retire this app for good. Also I NEVER write reviews, this update is definitely a way to kill your business… make the app unusable for long time platform supporters. Along with inundating discussion boards with a copy/paste PR script so obviously from marketing to try & get ahead of increased ad complaints instead of actually utilizing effective UX/I design that doesn't aggravate the nerves.

This app by far is my favorite social media app, I can’t get bored on it, I could use it all day, I have saved like a total of like 25k pins for the past 3 years that I have had this app. I know it’s a little obsessive but I have a really wide range of interests and no other social media app has allowed me to explore all of them like Pinterest has. It has every single interest and I have collages for everything, I enjoy just scrolling and finding things that I like. I find so much inspiration for things like interior design, art, fashion, traveling, food, photography, marketing, and specific aesthetics, literally anything. I post pins myself and I think over the course of a couple months I have accumulated around 175k views, but I maintain around 15k-20k monthly views and decreases when I stop posting. I take a lot of pictures that I find very cute and aesthetic but I don’t feel like posting them elsewhere so posting them on Pinterest is so fun. Great job to everyone who makes this app happens, I just had to leave a review because I know how important these are.

I loved this service like everyone when it first came out, but it’s time for it to be replaced, by people who actually care about their users!! The customer service is AI, you NEVER get a real response from them, even when you go through all of the hoops to ‘contact customer service’ you get a canned response back. They police what you’re able to post, remove pins and boards without notice, and randomly apply their policy standards to pins with no rhyme or reason. I don’t have any desire to use it nowadays, but I have 15+ years of history and storyboards (I use it for writing); as someone with autism, it helped me express myself, however I only end up there every once in awhile now because of google results or something. The other day, I got a random email, that my account had been suspended due to multiple counts of graphic violence. Now when I did pin things, it was stuff like tattoos and cottagecore. I have no idea what they’re talking about but I had *just* uploaded my updated review (sans this part), and I think it was retaliatory!! Wild, and I am looking into my legal options because I will sue them to the ends of the earth if I have to - they have caused SO MUCH emotional distress to me throughout the years, reminding my pins willy-nilly and then emailing the next day saying it actually didn’t violate policy after all. The threat of being able to lose stuff you put so much work and so much of yourself into, is evil. They don’t let you back anything up or give you any security or insurance on your boards or your account. This is the epitome of a Bad Company, and it doesn’t care about anything but the profit it can make off of you (through the many ads they now have). Someone needs to make it again, but better!

reviews.t: the updates are awful and endless
reviews.x: I understand that updates to the app might be relevant if Pinterest wants to try and keep up with other apps…but the constant updates and changes to the app is so frustrating. I’ve used this app for 9 years now and it’s becoming less and less enjoyable for me. pintrest keeps blocking my personal pins from being seen by anyone but me. which takes the fun out of being able to share and create my own ideas. I think that it’s likely do to the fact that I can easily be mistaken for a teenage girl but I’ve reiterated that I’m 22 and of age on that app over and over again. I’ve shared nothing but pictures of my outfits and a few selfies. All harmless pictures with nothing vaguely suggestive about them. me nor any other women or girls should be punished because of pervs. I also personally don’t like the creating pins as “ideas” thing where I’m unable to fully personalize my pins. I don’t care about being seen as creator or people re-sharing the pics I post if they like them, my icon below all the pins I create is ugly and disturbs the harmony of my boards. We should have a choice again. I’m also afraid that my account will be deleted yet again, because Pinterest soft blocking my boards was the first thing to happen before they wrongly deleted my account last time and I had to get it appealed.

reviews.t: What happened with the new updates?
reviews.x: Pinterest has always been my favorite, because I loved that it wasn’t like other social media. But lately I personally do not like the new updates. First you cannot message anyone on the app, and now you cannot see your recently views pins unless going to home feed tuner. Even then you can’t even click on the pins. Also, I get it that they have to show ads on your home page but I’m tired of seeing a bunch of scams like SHEIN and fetch and there are wayyy too many ads. I’ve also recently starting seeing in inappropriate content and comments that I never used to see. Ive even had to report some. Especially being young that is not something I like seeing. Also PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE lower the age for keeping a profile private. I appreciate them trying to keep us safe but as someone who doesn’t have any social media, I enjoyed posting and getting more followers. It’s not a big deal but taking that away made Pinterest much less fun. Finally I really miss having the video side where you can watch “shorts”. Pinterest has to stop taking things away! Of course I still love it though I just thought I would share my opinion no hate :) .

reviews.t: Love Pinterest with all of my bones, hate update
reviews.x: Pinterest is the exact thing I need in my 20s to help me navigate what I like, the energy I hope to give off, and the vibe I’d like to curate as a 21 year old teenage girl. Following my nightly skin care routine, I end the day by rotting in bed, listening to the cranberries, and productively scrolling through Pinterest. It’s helped me limit my mindless scrolling on tiktok and it never fails to make me feel motivated. It is with great sadness that I give this glorious app 4 stars. The old Pinterest, let you hold down a pin you wanted to save, and seamlessly allowed you to slide your finger to save, share, etc. the pin; as if you were writing in cursive. However, the new update makes you hold down the pin, then pops up with a half screen of different options that makes you pick your finger up and choose an option; as if you were writing in print. I believe it is Pinterest’s goal to encourage a sense of order, smoothness, and consistency. This new update does not elevate this objective. It’s clunky, it’s unattractive, some (me lowkey) might even say it’s a disgrace. I need the number of the CEO I need the email of the aesthetic team whatever it’s called I need my old Pinterest back she was a sister to me please
reviews.a: i need the old update back

reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest since you needed an invitation and it was only available on desktop. It can be a great resource. The problem is the app has always been PAINFULLY buggy and unreliable. It’s slow and glitches CONSTANTLY. Want to zoom in on a pin? It’ll probably freeze. Want to pin something? There’s a good chance it’ll sit on the “thinking” indefinitely. They’re bugs that make the app virtually unusable because - apart from being frequent - the only recourse you have is closing out the app and restarting it and when you do that pin you were trying to interact with will be buried in your feed because NOT refreshing isn’t an option. The glitches are annoying enough, but the app has some annoying lack of basic features. For instance, I created a board that was apparently a duplicate. I had already created one with the EXACT same name even down to the emoji the only difference was that one was capitalized. That’s all. And it didn’t save the two boards by each other despite logic suggesting the two would be back to back due to alphabetical order. Instead, it’s wedged three other boards between them. Why?!? Now I’m stuck merging the two and I don’t love Pinterest’s methodology for that so it just sits there cluttering my list of boards. There are so many other issues with the app and given how politicized the app's become over the years, it’s really contributed to a lab increasingly frustrating experience in using it. If I didn’t still find some good content, I doubt I’d even think of it. As it stands, I find myself using it far less each year because even the content’s quality is in decline. In the meantime, the content I DO like is increasingly frustrating to access with constant freezing, inadvertent reloading, broken/non-existent links, AN EXCESSIVE AMOUNT OF ADS, and a clunky, tedious UI. 👎🏻

reviews.t: Love the app, one irritating issue.
reviews.x: So whenever you go to the home page on Pinterest to see the, “For you”, or the “All” section. You know how next to it there’s the names of the boards you have on your profile so when you click it it gives you same ideas and pins as the ones you have saved on the board? Well, for some reason this glitch has been going on for at least like a week and at the top instead of my board names it’s someone else’s. Now, I don’t know if this is a glitch and it’s mixing mine and someone else’s boards up or if it’s a like a recommendation or something like that but it’s irritating me because not only is it on my phone but it’s also on my tablet. So, I think there’s something wrong with my account because at first I got worried and thought somebody got into my account and did a two step thing and made it more secure. But, nothing changed so I tried deleting the app and re downloading it and it was still there so please try to fix it Pinterest or can somebody let me know how to fix it. I don’t know if it’s just me or not so if it’s happening to you also you’re not alone lol.

I am always getting pins removed from my boards and threatened with account termination. But here’s the catch- these pins aren’t mine! I just saved them to a board. And, there’s nothing wrong with these pins I save. They say that my pins have to do with “self injury” but I never save pins with these contents. Sure, there’s blood here and there to fit the aesthetic of a fighter character. But I’m never given an explanation why the pins I save are “self injury”, and I shouldn’t be the one getting in trouble for saving them- it’s on the person who posted them! Comments on my posts are disabled without reason, even though I only post nature photography and vintage photo edits. When I sent an email inquiring about it, I wasn’t given an explanation. Also, I’m over 16 and for some reason a meme board that only me and my friends can access is “temporarily unavailable” for “teen safety purposes”. WHAT? This is a MEME board! People get away with posting NSFW content and suicidal comments and they don’t get removed, but apparently saving memes on a private board for me and friends is unacceptable. I shouldn’t be getting in trouble for SAVING pins. I’m not posting them! I’m taking a break from Pinterest until this is resolved, because it’s not fair for users.

I LOVE Pinterest a lot and post a good amount on it too but recently I found that my pins weren’t getting any views and so I switched accounts to see if it was the same on my other account. When I did this I found that only my personal account was there and the others seemed deactivated though I can still switch to those accounts and save pins and comment on pins (and people still respond to my comments) whenever. At first I thought it was just a glitch but it’s been I think just over two weeks that it’s been this way and it’s really not fun (as a creator). I also have some good mutuals and over 600 followers on both of my accounts that have been “deactivated” so it’s been upsetting to let that go. Also at the beginning of this year dms have been really weird and only work on my personal accounts which is annoying since those accounts I never really use to dm. Pinterest if you see this PLEASE fix these problems because I want to enjoy Pinterest the same way as I did before Ok so actually now Pinterest changed it so that accounts are automatically private unless you are 16+ (I’m under 16) and honestly just the whole concept of private accounts is so useless to me!! On Pinterest, people usually mind their business and I have yet to see anything creepy on there. I don’t really see the need to have everyone under 16 have a private account but I do think it’s good to give the private option (though isn’t that what private boards are for?!) Also, since I made my Pinterest accounts when I had my old email, I can’t really control my accounts anymore. Yes, this sounds like a me problem but there should be a way to switch emails more easily </3

reviews.t: Used to be better, but I understand why
reviews.x: Pinterest used to be better for me in many ways, but I can understand how some quality has had to be sacrificed because of the sheer volume of content. I’ve had Pinterest pretty much since the beginning, so I’m getting close to my limit of pins I’m sure. I’ve made attempts to go back and edit, organize, and delete. I really wish I could find copies and manage my boards better through Pinterest. My app glitches pretty often and gets stuck loading, or closes. I’ve been getting more and more emails that a pin I’ve pinned has been removed for violating policy, but I don’t know what pins or why, and I don’t create my own pins at all. Recently got an email that a pin had been reinstated, but that continued misconduct would result in actions to my account… even though whatever it was didn’t break any rules. Nothing I do on Pinterest could really be considered inappropriate, or break any laws. Awhile ago I kept getting hit with “pin limits” randomly, even after one or two pins. This at least seems fixed. I really dislike this update where there are two top choices for recommended boards, and then a “profile” option. Pinterest already does a poor job recommending the correct board, and the top choice is going to be the last board pinned to, so really it’s just one recommendation now. This makes any pinning much more difficult and timely, because you basically have to select from all your boards again, instead of three recommendations.I don’t even know what the “profile” option means. I thought it was old pins from before pinterest was more organized.

reviews.t: LOVE LOVE LOVE but here’s my issues
reviews.x: Pinterest has been one of my new favorite apps I can scroll for hours find new pins that interest me and watch the videos on the platform but I would like the “Watch” feature in the app back. Normally at the top of the screen there was two sections “All” and “Watch” but due to recent updates that Section was removed and replaced with a “Live” Section until a few days ago when it made a comeback I scrolled on the app for hours at a time but when I came back tomorrow it was gone again, Maybe it was because I updated my app but the Watch feature is one of my favorites and It’s a slu of videos that interest me instead when I click a video it does turn too a sort of watch feature where I can scroll and it’s a new video but I would like the feature back altogether. Tho my suggestion is a tall one and I’m sure there was a reason you got rid of it and if it cannot make a comeback I understand but tell me why exactly was this feature taken to begin with.

reviews.t: WAY too many advertisements, EVERY PIN tries to sell you something.
reviews.x: Pinterest used to be a platform to share ideas, but has turned into a platform where literally every other pin is trying to sell me something. And, the pins that are not explicitly advertisements are programmed to show you how to BUY the items that you see in the picture. I used to love Pinterest because it felt like a free exchange of ideas that allowed people to pursue creative interests like cooking, crafts, diy projects, interiors, but it has since become a place where money can buy attention and time, forcing the ideas backed the most capital to be fed to its users. Pinterest also pioneered native advertising, that disguises advertisements as just a part of the free exchange of ideas, as if some pins weren’t explicitly boosted in order to maximize profits. I would rather pay a monthly subscription that be force-fed whatever advertisers want me to buy disguised as new and innovative ideas created by the users themselves. Pinterest is lying to its customers by making advertisements appear as though they aren’t on your feed only because someone could afford to make you see them. Be better, Pinterest.

reviews.t: Love it but a HUGE glitch
reviews.x: I have had Pinterest for about 2 years and gained many VERY close friend with it, well one day one of my friends just disappeared from my contacts, whenever I would look them up it used to just not show the text option. But now it says that my friends accounts are private and I can’t find them. Now there is now texting option whatsoever and I have to hope that whenever it gets fixed or if it even does get fixed that it will give me my close friends back. It’s been like half a year sense this happened. It still hasn’t been fixed. This happened in the beginning of the year and it is now near the end *its August as I’m writing this* and I’m losing hope. ALSO Idk if this is a glitch or not but I used to have like 183 followers and stuff but all the sudden it has been lowered down to seven with no explanation. I don’t know how long it has been like that but I only noticed today. Also I’m followed by people who don’t seem to match my interests at all and a random animal business. Idk what’s happening but if someone could explain that would be fantastic.

I’ll start this by saying if there was any other platform that did what Pinterest can do, I’d be using that instead. The setup with Pinterest having separate boards that I can add anything to is great. However, there are several glaring problems with the app, including a glitches and problems with the reporting system. One of the glitches involves opening the app after I’ve had it completely closed for hours and it will for some reason open the last pin I had open but it will not do this for my friend who also uses the app. Regaurding the reporting system, it could use a lot of work. There is no way for me to report videos that include flashing lights and there is also no way for me to elaborate on why exactly I am reporting something. Also just a side note, this app will show me the same pins relentlessly for literal years mixed in with the new ones, there is a feature to say you’ve seen a pin too many times and aren’t interested, but it’s far too many repeat pins for me to reasonably do that for all of them. Overall, it’s fine I guess but definitely needs improvement that doesn’t just come in the form of more layout changes.

I have LOVED Pinterest for long time but there has been a huge problem now that I just found out. Today I was going on Pinterest to see how my posts were doing but I have some followers that I have gotten from my posts but when I checked my followers it was zero. Like I said I had some followers and people that checked my posts but when I reset my iPad and checked if it was a glitch but it wasn’t. When I checked on my phone if it stayed like that and it did. I don’t know if it is a glitch but maybe try fixing that glitch because is staying like that for a while. Just don’t get me wrong, I even reset my phone as well but it stayed like that. I don’t know if this is a glitch or something like that but I’m quite serious about this and is really getting at the point that I don’t want to use the app anymore(I don’t know if I’m being dramatic but I stayed on Pinterest for a while but I never experience this ever) When time passed because I thought it really was a glitch but it stayed zero and I couldn’t even check all my posts to see. I hope you would read this message and if you do, please fix this glitch.

I absolutely love Pinterest but I have many problems with it. Whenever I am on there it is always glitching. also as of lately almost every piece of music on a video has been removed and it says “audio not available in you location” I understand the copy right issues, but this never happened before and I am always deleting pins because I can’t hear the audio. I hate how they took down the watch part so now I can’t scroll and watch videos and I have to click on the ones I want to watch. It’s really annoying how I have to press the comments button and stop the video just to give a reaction. One of the BIG BIG things I hate most of all, is how I cannot see my followers because Pinterest is constantly glitching. It has been like that for months and it’s getting so annoying to the point I just want to delete the app. Over all that I think the app is quite enjoyable and funny and I’m on it almost every day. I just wish these issues would be fixed and for Pinterest to STOP CONSTANTLY CHANGING THE APP AND THE UPDATES!!! keep it how it was in the beginning, the updates are quite annoying and frustrating.

reviews.t: Sounds like there are bigger problems!!😂
reviews.x: I particularly do not like when haters or should I say my fans hack into my account on here and next thing I know I have tons of categories with pins that I’ve not only NEVER seen before but are in no way shape or form my taste whatsoever!!Therefore in turn my feed tends to be intended for someone else completely and there is no purpose not to mention it ruins the whole entire reason for using your app!!! Honestly I think you need to tighten up the security features especially paying close attention to developers who seem to find a back way entrance into apps such as yours causing major setbacks in the whole reason people such as myself use your app to begin with!! This is literally my 3rd time around setting up a new account with a new email so I will be sure to keep you posted as to whether or not I can use the app for my own enjoyment and not necessarily be demeaned by another whom is continuously posting photo’s or pins should I say that indicate nothing but negative self image portrayal towards myself as well as make myself question m self image as a result there of because being demanded by another is not something that I particularly would do to someone let alone get my kicks out of it!! It is truly sad when you think about it that females will go to such extremes to make themselves have some feeling of self worth and actually feel better about themselves by demeaning other females on this app as well as many others and the internet in general that seems to be an underlying jealousy factor! So basically I’m going in this with a positive mind and hoping as the saying goes “The third time is a charm!”! Otherwise I think that your app is great as well as very insightful!! Thank You!!

Today I noticed that about half of the videos that I had saved no longer had sound, even though when I saved them they did have sound, and extremely common music in the U.S. as well. It was really starting to annoy me so I googled what to do about the situation. Someone had suggested changing the region because some music is copyrighted to pinterest in certain areas. So, I changed the region in my settings, and I just choose a random one. I guess this was a massive mistake because as soon as I closed out of the settings, not even three seconds later, I got a message saying that I was “too young” for Pinterest and that my account was being deactivated. Keep in mind the region I choose was France, so I looked up what the age requirements over there were. From the information I gathered I could only come to the conclusion that it was 16. I wish I would have at least received some sort of warning before they deactivated my account because now the only way to reactivate it is to send Pinterest a picture of either my birth certificate or government identification. First of all, I’m not applying for a government loan I’m just trying to get back into my PINTEREST ACCOUNT. And second of all you don’t even upload your very sensitive and personal information to Pinterest itself. It takes you to a 3rd party browser. So now I have to choose between potentially getting my identity stolen or getting all of my pins back. I can see how I made a mistake on my part but some sort of warning or notice would have been nice.

I have use Pinterest for years and have thoroughly enjoyed the content and the users. But oh my goodness the platform has been becoming increasingly more unusable. Half the time the comments are turned off or I can’t even see them. I see 3 notifications but have none at the same time?? Trying to scroll through your boards on your phone is so frustrating cause half the time you swipe out of it. I try to swipe out of a pin I was using and I open up three different products. The like button is about the size of a plant cell while the reaction button takes up so much space??? We did not need to find a comment helpful and it’s not very important to even see who liked it if I’m not the original commenter. Don’t even get me started on videos. I have completely given up on watching videos on Pinterest. Besides the TikTok like platform which works okish but the sound doesn’t work on those. And the new “audio not available in your country” is stupid because videos I could watch yesterday’s are suddenly blocked. Like seriously. And just videos in generally are SO GLITCHY. I have to scroll up and down to get the pause button. Or it just never goes away. My audio never works, I have to mute then unmute. Pinterest you are one of the largest social media platforms to exist. It’s insane that it’s been so long and the mobile app is getting worse and worse. You are too big of a company to be having this many problems. You might need to get it order or many people like me are going to start heading to other apps. Cmon man.

So I’ve been having issues with product’s constantly pushed in my face with every single art piece that pops up but whatever I will live until I figure out how to fix that or it get updated out. I’ve run into a major problem for me. I can’t share my account and it is basically in forced ghost mode because of the new age policy and what not. I was trying to make a colab bored with a friend and every time she tried to join it would say it didn’t exist. I tried to fix it with no luck and I then went maybe my birthday is wrong and that’s causing me problems so I go and have a look. It says a day in May of 2008. My birthday isn’t in May and sure as heck isn't 2008 I’m older than that. My birthday had been set when I made the account a year or two ago and had been correct but guess what dear old Pintrist goes and does that reset my birthday and now want me to show them legal documents to fix it. I’m not showing random people my legal information like my birth certificate just to fix the age that they reset. I’m running into constant problems and it’s really sad because I love this app but can no longer use it as easily as before. Sorry for my long rant just wanted to share my thoughts on the new policy and how it is causing me more harm than good. TLDR: Pinterest wants to see a birth certificate to fix the issue with my age they caused.

First off with my main complaint is that recently I can’t hear audio or any sound at all of many and many video pins because they say “Audio not available in your location.” I tried changing my location to see if that help but none of the locations I used - even ones that were OUTSIDE my county - worked at all in getting rid of this strange feature. So, I am hoping Pinterest will find a solution to this as soon as possible if this turns out to be a bug. Secondly, in some pins, whenever I try to click “View replies” of a comment, it won’t actually let me see them. Third complaint, is to please have everyone, whether business or none-business accounts, to post videos WITHOUT using idea pins or making a business account. And main reason we don’t want to use idea pins is because we simply dislike the format of it and you wouldn’t see an idea pin’s comments right away. Other than that, as much as I love Pinterest and that I’ve been using it since 2020, it has degraded quite a lot for me and I could say the same for many other people too.

I made my account in 2011, back when you needed to be invited via email to use Pinterest from another person with a Pinterest account. I’ve literally used it for 12 years, and at times it was the only “social” app on my phone. I’ve loved Pinterest for so long, and loved following my friends all through high school and seeing my friends’ pins and boards. That said, something has seriously changed. There are almost no pins that aren’t abject ads. It’s become all ads! In addition, the algorithmization of the app removes all social features and really isolates you. You only get suggested ad-pins based on other things you’ve pinned rather than getting to see and interact with your friends, family, and mutual followers. I remember genuinely commenting on my friends and mutuals’ pins when I was younger and having such a personal connection with seeing my friends ideas and interests! I find other peoples curated tastes really inspiring, and a strong point of the platform. Recent changes have removed all this, and I don’t go on Pinterest anymore because it’s like instagram: an empty wasteland full of ads masquerading as a place for connection.

reviews.t: Amazing app but I have an issue
reviews.x: So let me start. I absolutely love Pinterest! It allows you to do so many different things while also finding inspiration for whatever it may be. And, one of my personal favorite features about it was the “watch” tab where you could watch small shorts on things that might interest you. However, a few days ago I started having an issue where the “watch and browse” tabs were completely gone and instead it basically gave me a page where it was in a way a gigantic “browse” tab that just said “all” with all of the names of your boards that you could see things that might interest you. However, I was able to get it back by deleting the app and downloading it again. But, unfortunately this didn’t fix my problem. You see, after I redownload the app it was back and then when I was done; I closed out my app (I have an iPhone so I did that how you normally would). And then, when I went back onto the app later, it went back to me needing to delete the app to be able to have the “watch” tab back. Please help!!!!!!

I absolutely loved Pinterest. I used it daily and I had a lot of boards. Pinterest is so great for ideas and it’s where I got most of my inspiration for basically everything. However, recently I opened the app and I was logged out. I had to log back into my account and was surprised to see that my account was deactivated. This notification gives a few reasons as to why my account might have been deactivated, but none would have applied to me. I definitely never requested for my account to be deactivated. I contacted Pinterest over a week ago and I still have not heard back. So I sent another request to get my account back up and still, no response. I got an email saying that they would get back to me when they had reviewed my account, but it’s been well over a week. I feel like it should not take that long to get back to me about getting my account reactivated. I don’t create or post anything on Pinterest, I only save things. I haven’t violated any community guidelines so it’s very very disappointing that my account was deactivated for seemingly no reason and Pinterest seems to have no interest getting it back. I used Pinterest literally daily and it was one of my favorite apps. I seriously loved this app and I don’t have any interest creating a whole new account because I had put a lot of effort into my previous one. This is extremely disappointing and I hope that I hear from someone soon because it has been a very long time to just review my account.

reviews.t: Going downhill on a water slide
reviews.x: I loved (I use to love it) this app. I have so much saved in it of recipes, clothes, home ideas, all the things in one! Now it’s trash, multiple times a day I’m getting emails about the pins of somebody else I have saved are in violation of Pinterests guidelines. It doesn’t show me the pin in question no why it’s become an issue. So I fight it each time since I have no idea what it is that’s got Pinterest’s panties in a wad. Almost Everytime it says the pin is fine and can be kept. THEN WHO IS REPORTING THRM AND WHY IS PINTEREST REMOVING THEM IF THEY ARE FINE!!!!! Leave me pins alone!! I don’t see the issue if they are considered fine are more investigating. It’s to the point I’m about to delete the whole app it’s a mess and a struggle to be on on top of every third pin is a commercial that doesn’t pertain yo me and never will but yet they all keep popping up I can see over 4 on my screen at any given moment. Sure miss the old days when you could hit the bottom of Pinterest and it wasn’t littered with garbage. Too bad they don’t read these and make adjustments accordingly. IF ITS NOT BROKE DONT FIX IT, yet here they are toying with it and making it a complete mess for users

I would usually rate this app a good 5 but I have had a major problem that has not been fixed despite my desperate attempts to do so. Around a month ago I went to a foreign country, and when I landed and tried to open the app, it has logged me out of both my accounts. I was only able to sign back into one while the other one said it was deactivated. but I’m not sure if it is deactivated or suspended. This is because when I try to sign back into the account it says that it’s been deactivated but when I try forgot password, it says it has been suspended. So I’m not sure which one it is which does nothing to help the issue. Over the past month I have sent 11 emails (yes I counted) to Pinterest Help Center, yet nothing has changed. No one has gotten back to me besides the automatic message they send to each email in my efforts to get my main account back. All of the past emails were sent spaced to give them time because I know that they can be extremely busy but no one has gotten back to me. Honestly it doesn’t seem like they even care to fix the problem on my part which I think is unprofessional. I don’t understand why my account would be deactivated I don’t believe my activity was suspicious. I also have no knowledge to why it would be suspended since I don’t have any memory of viewing or saving anything inappropriate, this could have something to do with the recent Minor Safety updates but being a mature minor myself I don’t believe it is. I hope that this catches the attention and urgency of Pinterest, and I hope that I can get my account back soon. I would also like to have some closure onto why my account was deactivated or suspended so that whatever the issue is I can avoid it in the future.

This is the coolest app I been on. But I just got something to say. When I first came on to this app I did not know what it was. But then I looked at the Messages and I know that I would have someone to talk. But when I said something like hi then it keep on saying the same thing all over and over. But I just want someone to talk to about my life. When I first got my phone I thought I can just open up to people and share my life story with them. But that only bought me to be talking to the walls. I just want a friend I get bullied for the way that I am. And it is not my fault I can not Control it. Some people to not understand but that is ok no one gets me. Like one time it was my birthday and no one came and I got not gifts and we did not go anywhere we just sat in all day in the house on our phone when I wanted to be out there doing something fun. So my life it is not easy. But I just want you guys to know I want someone to talk to like this app that will be nice and cool☹️😊

reviews.t: stolen art, app is going downhill
reviews.x: i've been using pinterest for years now, and i'll start off by saying it's a great app for organizing ideas and i enjoy posting on here more than i do on other socials. over the past year or so, though, almost every update i've seen has been negative. they removed the option to add pictures to comments, changed the layout more times than i can count, and made it so you can't even see the accounts of minors. i get that this is supposed to be a safety feature, but i share an art tips board with some of my friends and it made 10 sections completely invisible to everyone except the person who made it because their account is a minor. also, stolen art is insane on here and there's little done to prevent it. i'm writing this review specifically because i found an account that has almost 20k followers from spam-posting art without crediting the original artist, to the point where it takes ages to reach the bottom of their page when i scroll, and there's no option to report it unless posts violate MY copyright/trademark. pinterest is my main social, and the only one some of my friends have, but i've considered deleting my account because seeing so much stolen art can be discouraging as an artist myself. wouldn't recommend it to people until some of the issues are fixed

I love Pinterest so much I used to use it everyday until I got deactivated about 2 weeks ago. I emailed them twice and they said they would review my account but 2 weeks just passed so I emailed them again just now. Come to find out, other people are also getting there account deactivated for no reason or for the wrong reason. Also having to spam the life outta Pinterest just to get their attention to get their account back; because for some reason Pinterest just ignores you in this dire situation. I myself got mine deactivated for NO REASON at least it wasn’t explained why it got deactivated. It’s extremely wild that this is happening and Pinterest are just ignoring people who are trying to get their attention to get their account back. I know it might seem like me and other people are overreacting but Pinterest is truly such a fun app, and having that taken away for no reason is so frustrating. This shouldn’t be happening and it should never happen. I know it could be a mistake by bot reviewers but bot reviewers should not be able to deactivate or suspend accounts. Bot reviewers should only be able to report their triggers to a human reviewer and let that human reviewer decide what’s actually happening. Overall this app is amazing but this is the only thing that vexes me, truly. (Sorry if there were any grammatical errors I’m kinda stressed out from this.)

reviews.t: Features to add, problems to solve 👀
reviews.x: I absolutely love Pinterest and it’s a great app but there are some features that I think would make it even better and some problems that I have ran into. When I save a pin that I like, I have too many boards to count and it is hard to find some boards and I have to go back on my profile to search what it’s called, so I think you guys should add a search bar when you save a pin so that we don’t have to try and find it using the “abc” tab on the side because sometimes I forget what my boards are called. Another thing is that my messages are not there anymore. I like to send pins to my friends!! Did you guys remove it or is it just not appearing?😭 Also there is a problem I have came across. When I want to follow my friends on here, sometimes I can’t find their names and I type the @ and everything so I came to find that mine or their account is privated. I even went into setting and clicked public so they can find me but still nothing pops up. Idk if it’s just me or if I’m just being silly but idk. Is there something you can do about this Pinterest?

reviews.t: i love this app but there’s one thing that i’d almost make it 3 stars
reviews.x: i’ve loved this app since quarantine. i’ve saved thousands of pins. but since i started it removed photos on pins, creator circles removed, and comments and dms turned off (which i understand because i’ve heard of the situations). as a normal user it’s almost 5/5 stars. but as a creator it’s at best a 3. im hoping one day the creator circles will be back but im not super hopeful. but it’s very frustrating because i’m getting no engagement. i have almost 400 followers and i might get 1 person liking it. i get a single comment and i’ll be practically jumping excited. its just annoying because i used to get engagement on almost every pin. it used to be a community of my favorite people and artists. now it’s hard for me to find their stuff and for them to find my stuff. i wish the creator circles would come back. i almost want to give pinterest a 3 for the updates but i really like this app so ill give it 4. im critiquing it because i want this amazing app to be more creator friendly. so pinterest if you are seeing this please consider changing things. the updates are getting annoying and the point of them should be to bring features TO pinterest not AWAY

Pinterest has gone completely downhill. It’s now a slightly different version of every other video based app in circulation. It’s clear that they’ve shifted their application to contain almost identical algorithms to IG, TikTok, and the like. Pinterest USED to be a fun collage type bulletin board where you could plan out projects and brainstorm. It’s now a poorly designed algorithm based app that will spit out droves of the exact same things the moment you look at or pin something. Looking at a couple pairs of linen pants does not mean I ONLY want to see linen pants. What nonsense. I so deeply wish they weren’t trying to be competitors of the likes of IG & TikTok, but everything must be monopolized upon at this point. I never thought of Pinterest as a social media app, but they sure dedicated their time and resources to change that. And what’s worse is that they did so and it isn’t a GOOD social media app. What used to be a fun, low stakes app is now filled with the same slightly agape mouthed influencers I can’t seem to escape on IG. Pinterest was an app for creators and creatives, NOT content pushers. What a disappointment, truly. If you remember the fun, ease, and excitement of Pinterest from five years ago, this is not that, and what a shame it is.

I have multiple things to say about this app but i will start with the pros before addressing the cons. First Pinterest has a lovely community and is very entertaining, there is so much inspiration and is wonderful if your only planning on consuming the content. As for if you want to create the content its a massive headache. Pins are getting harder to view and see who posted, so views on pins have gone down for small creators drastically. I used to get hundreds of views but now i only average about 35. And it is even harder to get hearts and comments. Also today while i was trying to post a video the sound will not work no matter what i do. Ive tried reposting it logging into different accounts even going onto different devices to try and see what the problem is. Its very mentally draining and honestly not even worth it. There are so many different problems with the app like the constant updates and changes to the features. there is 0 consistency and it seems like the app changes every day. Then again its still a great app I would recommend downloading if your not planning on making any content.

Me and my friends absolutely LOVE this app. We’re always checking out each others boards, sharing pins, etc. However there’s recently been a huge issue that’s sprung up, and despite looking all over the web, no one has said a word about it. This is something me and my friends are all experiencing, so I know it’s not just me. Firstly, whenever I’ve tried to see my followers so I can go to my friends’ profiles quickly, I’m greeted with that spinning button that just keeps going. They never load, but that’s not the worst issue. The worst part is that some of my friends’ profiles appear to have been completely ERASED from the app? Yet I’ve seen them scrolling and I know their accounts are still active, but they don’t appear in my following. It says I’m following 9 people, but only 5 show up. Their accounts are not private. To one of my friends, I don’t show up for him while he doesn’t show up for me. We haven’t blocked each other. Whenever we try to send each other’s accounts through links, we’re greeted with an error message. I’ve updated the app and it’s still not fixed. Pinterest is a special app for all of us, and if I can’t even see some of my friends’ ideas, it’s just a huge bummer.

reviews.t: Loved it! Until a recent bug..
reviews.x: I’ve been using pinterest for some time now, having it for pfp ideas, different pictures to look at, just really trying to use it for the pictures, and aesthetic ideas. I’ve enjoyed Pinterest and used it so much when it came to profile pictures. However, I came across a bug that is very aggravating today, which is whenever I click on a picture, it shows “more like this” And yes, I know this is a feature when you click on the picture you want, and it shows you who made it, etc. And when you scroll down or click the image again, it shows more like this. But that isn’t what I’m talking about. It’s like as soon as I open pinterest and try to click a picture it just automatically shows the “more like this” instead of the actual picture. I was hoping if you could fix this since it is indeed annoying and I even have a screen recording of it (If you don’t know what I’m talking about, I could send the recording.)

I really love this app, I use it everyday and it is probably my most used app. However, there are a lot of issues that are very annoying. For one thing, one of my boards got age-restricted, even though there is nothing inappropriate, and since the board is “temporarily removed”, I can’t even fix the issue. I think this happened because I accidentally set my age to be under 18, and was going to fix it, but then they updated and now I can’t. I can’t find any info on how to fix it, either, which is very annoying. The worst thing on that board was maybe something that swore, so not very bad. Another thing that just started happening today (might be a glitch) is that whenever I click on a pin, it doesn’t take me to the pin, it takes me to the “more like this section” I would have been able to access if I had clicked on the pin. I’m going to try my normal glitch fixes, but it so far has been super annoying. The worst thing is, whenever I click on a pin the more like this, it just takes me to the more like this for the pin I clicked on. I hope this is just a glitch, not an update, and gets resolved soon.

I really like my Pinterest, that is until today. I am an avid Pinterest user, because I have no life, and if you see my board you would immediately know that. I have 74 boards and over 56,000 pins, so obviously I like looking at new and interesting things. Well no more my friends. Every time that I click on a pin it takes me to another section of “More pins that you may like” or “More clothes like this to buy” or “More pins like this”. I am unable to click on any of those pins as well, without doing the same thing. Oh so irritating!!! Now the usual fix to these type of issues is that I need to update my device. Well, I am unable to do that because I am poor and I can’t afford a new device. So, I do hope that this issue is a fixable bug or something because I would really hate it if I lose my ability to access my account or live vicariously through others on Pinterest. Please HELP, this how I get my creative juices flowing. I really do like Pinterest, it is pretty freakin cool. Thank you, Tara.

Just to start, I have nothing against Pinterest. It’s the place where I get most of my ideas for things I’d like to do. But recently there’s been a tiny little problem. Normally when you click on a pin in Pinterest it will send you directly to the pin where you can save it, comment, share, all that stuff! But, just today, when I try to click on ANY pin it will redirect me to pins like it. If I try to click on the pins like it it will redirect me to more pins like it but not to the actually pin. It will continue to do this over, and over, and over. Because of this, I cannot comment on any pins nor can I save them, so this basically makes Pinterest unusable to me. I’ve been using Pinterest for a long time now and I really would like to continue to use it but if I can’t DO anything on the platform there is no reason for me to stay. I don’t know if this is a bug or an “Update”, and I don’t if it’s happening to other people or not, all I know it that I can nor longer use Pinterest because of this and it really does make me sad. If its a bug please fix it and if it’s an update, please rethink it :) - Bobby :D

reviews.t: pretty good but the updates are annoying
reviews.x: i had made a friend on pinterest and we’ve known each other for a few years now. recently there was an update and now i am unable message ANYONE. i reset my phone and updated everything thinking it was a glitch, but no - your team removed the option to message. i loved talking to my friend and other people, sending people pins i liked and thought they’d like, and overall loved the app. and two more problems - 1) i cannot see who my followers are, although i CAN see who *I* am following. so please change that. 2) why is there no option to comment pictures anymore?? it was really nice recreating things inspired by certain pins and then being able to share a photo in the comments but y’all removed that too. overall, it’s a great app and everyone who i know who had it loves it including myself. i just am extremely displeased with all the major changes and hope to get back some of the old stuff (like messaging and posting comment images). i hope the pinterest team sees this and takes this into consideration, thanks.

I’ve had this app for around 2 and a half years now , it was very entertaining to scroll on and it was what i would spend most my time on my phone on . Until recently it has been having updates that take away advantages to having the app . For instance , the first update they had taken away the option to see when creators (people you follow) upload . It was upsetting , but not too agitating . They then had more and more updates that would remove more and more features . For example , they removed the ability to see comments , removed the messages feature , removed notifications , and now the app is having “issues” loading dms , showing peoples pins in collaborated boards , and showing followers and people you follow . Another reason why i dont like the app too much anymore is because the apps filter for pins is TERRIBLE . For instance , it is very bad at blocking websites . I clicked a website that linked from a post that said it was tumblr . What did i get ? A fake warning of a trojan virus and ended up almost getting tracked . Another thing is that they are terrible at filtering nudity . There is tons of nudity on Pinterest that bypasses without Pinterest even noticing . Ive seen tons of nudity that EASILY slips past the policies , and Pinterest doesn't do anything about it . For the glitches , i have tried restarting my phone , updating the app , re downloading the app , but nothing seems to work . I really hope that these issues can soon be fixed and I can finally use the app without having irritation .

I am a 13 year old that loves to use Pinterest with my friends and co-collaborate on boards whenever we are bored. The problem with this new update (don’t get me wrong, teen privacy is massively important and should be protected) is that not only can you not find ANY accounts under 16, there’s not an option to override or change it so that you may. If teens are using Pinterest by themselves and don’t want a creepy old man to see their Pins, that’s understandable. But the problem this creates is NO ONE can see their Pins and what they’ve spent time creating. Think of all the underage influencers in the world, they might spread the word even quicker than adult influencers could. I love the way this update focuses on body positivity, and to me that seems more important than blocking teens under 16 from creating boards for their birthdays on Pinterest. This new update is going to the right place, but I think there should be a way that people can communicate with their friends and not be completely blocked from the outside just because they’re under 16.

I’m not giving my birthdate for anyone’s app. It is too risky in today’s technology universe in spite of your ability or no ability to keep our info private. The less our info is put out there the fewer hacks there will be. #1)You obviously have all the data you need from me as I’ve been using Pinterest for many years now. I do not see how that date is relevant to your explanation that…#2) ”we collect this info to help provide a better experience for the younger people in our community.” You’ve given no explanation on number 2…#3) how does it have anything to do with the younger community.🤷🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️I don’t need the help to personalize my “recommendations & ads”. #4) Over the years I have had only two recommendations…A.) A way to alphabetize our boards; you did that, TY Pinterest. B.) The other recommendation was to install a “button” or whatever for language translations, you have not NOT done that. Thank you for listening. Take the lock off of my Pinterest page that requests a birthdate. I’m not giving that to you and I need access my pins, now.

I have used this app for a long time to love it, I used to use it for almost everything. You can find different things for it, like, clothing, food, hairstyles, nail inspo, shoe inspo, almost everything. But then I got this thing a while back about “Teen Safety” something about how your account is private if you’re under 16. Which, I understand, I understand the thing that if you’re a minor then of course, make the account private, but to deactivate a specific BOARD, is petty. It wasn’t used for anything bad, it was just for my friend and me to save random memes that we thought were funny. But then out of the normal Pinterest decided to make it non-accessible. I was shocked and honestly worried that it might lead to my whole account being deactivated, which I then decided to contact them about. And I haven’t been happy with the app since. I got pretty angry with it too. It happened to my friend’s account too. She couldn’t reach my new account or my old one. I wasn’t able to do the same either. It was a really random thing too, we haven’t done anything out of the community guidelines or terms and conditions, and we didn’t break any rules. Then Pinterest decides to do this, it was petty as heck. I didn’t understand it and I still don’t. If my issue isn’t fixed then it isn’t, but if it is then great. Thank you.

Please change the analytics back to the way they originally used to be. I’d like to be able to see ALL of the interactions I’ve had on my posts as a WHOLE. Not just the ones I’ve had this week or this month. Also in the “Find more ideas” tab. Please don’t feature pins in the thumbnail unless they are actually going to be there when I click on the tab. Scrolling endlessly to find 1 or 2 pins that looked cool, only for them to never be there and wasting all my time is not ok. It’s as annoying as it is stupid. I only clicked on it in the first place because I thought those pins would actually be there. Also, in the “Find more ideas tab” yet again, please don’t have it refresh all of the pins immediately after hitting the back button. Sometimes people just want to quickly go back to their board and check something out. That doesn’t mean I want all of the suggested pins to be gone when I come back. Yet again, this is annoying, and very unhelpful. Lastly. Please STOP trying to guess which boards the user wants to pin to next. Just put the last 3 boards I pinned to last up top and let the user handle it from there. It would be fine if your algorithm was actually good at guessing but it’s not, so plz just stop already.

reviews.t: My formerly fave app is lost
reviews.x: This used to be my favorite app & site - the most original idea for creativity, collaboration & community; growing your ideas, getting inspiration, & discovering new creators (when that word meant people who created THINGS- recipes, design, fashion). I used to spend hours a day here. But over time the UX & features have changed so drastically that there’s no unique offering or value prop. No one wants another video & influencer loaded explore feed. If your feed doesn’t allow an option to see the pins from users & boards you follow, there’s no reason to spend time on the app instead of directly on your fave (real creators’) blogs, sites, or other social profiles🤷🏼‍♀️ Don’t you want us to be on here to view ads & discover other pins or creators? Help it make sense. Becoming more similar to tiktok & ig doesn’t help you, it hurts you. And whoever is telling you otherwise had a poor understanding of product strategy. Maybe someone will make a new site like the original Pinterest…no one’s opposed to ads, but we still need to find things & people we were excited to discover. ******** This app needs some of work after the last batch of updates. My Profile page almost never displays properly - followers vs following - and that is the only way to get directly to a user you follow. I would suggest a separate feed with people you follow & separate lists for both so you can jump to a particular person quickly. The Explore feature seems to have a time limit to full functionality - ie, once I've been exploring for 5-10 min I lose the ability to open up a pin & like/repin. Lastly, a (new) pin option for your mobile browser should be added.

Pinterest is a creative space for me. You are able to create many boards that are easily accessible to use as inspiration for projects or even just to escape for a bit. I looked to see where I could send in suggestions but couldn’t find it even with google so I apologize for leaving a recommendation here! I would love to see a search button for when you are saving a image or video to a board rather than having to scroll. For me personally, I have a lot of boards from the basic fashion, art, etc all the way to color inspo, set design and so on so it would be super useful for others who save a lot of content to various boards to be able to search rather than speed scroll. Thank you for the time, energy and creativity you put into this app to provide a creative space for all sorts of people. I am excited to see the growth the app continues to make as the years add up.

reviews.t: love this app, hate the new update
