reviews.x: I love this app and use it for almost everything, and my boards and pins saved are really important to me. i’ve been using it for almost three years, and in that time i made a different account for a different reason. i added myself to some of my original boards. a few weeks later, that new account was deactivated so i went back to using my main. when the account closed, i assumed it was off the boards i had added it to because i couldn’t try to remove it without the app glitching and sending me back to the home page. i didn’t think much of it until yesterday, when i opened the app to find that all of my boards which i had previously “collaborated” with myself on were “temporarily disabled”. there is no way to remove my old account from them and now i cannot access boards that i rely on or just use consistently. it just tells me the board is currently disabled and links a page to the new updates, where it talks about teen safety but does not indicate why my board is disabled or how to solve this problem. i absolutely understand the importance of safety on the platform, but i, along with many other people, am not being unsafe in any way in the platform, i just want my boards back. i love this app, but this is very frustrating and disappointing. please fix this.

I have been using Pinterest five years now and have loved it. Pinterest has been so useful in finding art inspiration, clothing ideas, and more. Recently though Pinterest added a teenage profile protector where people under the age of 16 can not be seen by anyone. These are good intentions but definitely not the right way to go about it. My sister is fifteen and she has Pinterest. We share boards with each other and share pins through massage. By creating this new safety feature, pinterest has completely erased my sister on Pinterest. Please change this because I do not want to lose all those messages and pins we shared on Pinterest and I especially DO NOT want to lose the boards we created. This safety feature should be optional and up to the parents not pinterest. Some children are more mature than others and by creating this you have disabled those mature children. I know that Pinterest said that they are trying to add a way that personal close friends can see your account but I still don’t think that’s good enough. As a long lasting pinterest user I kindly request that you fix this right away.

reviews.t: New update ruins people’s hard work
reviews.x: can no longer check out the videos my sister has created, nor can her followers, in fact we can’t even see the names of the profiles we’re following under 16! They barley exist! My sister has worked very hard on her content, taking over an hour to create a video from start to finish. This new update has taken away the joy of posting videos, people no longer being able to view her hard work and ideas. Even though she is set in business account, there is no point in having a business account when they too (under 16) are revealed with the same consequences. In all desperateness, we tried changing the age of her account to 16+, but in the settings she can no longer even change the age! What?! I am not only speaking from the voices of my sister and her friends, but the thousands of young content creators who no longer have a public profile and have no more motive for Pinterest. I acknowledge that Pinterest is caring for the safety of teens and I deeply appreciate it, but this is not the solution. If there isn’t an update soon, her, along with some friends may cease the use of Pinterest and switch over to a platform such as tiktok that allows her to post all of her ideas and creations which bring her much joy. If you have came to the end, I give thanks for your reading. Pleas to reconsider the update.

reviews.t: Used to be my favorite app.. but now i can’t even get into it!
reviews.x: I got pinterest back in 2019 and started a account. i had many memories and boards and things saved. Well a week ago, pinterest deactivated both my accounts since they were linked. I Lost all access to my pinterest, board and saved. i cannot create a new account bc it doesn’t allow you if you are using the same email. now i have nothing. no way to go into pinterest, no way to see my old accounts. my personal account had so many pins and my business account have over 28k followers. i was devastated. and it’s very common. So many other have lost their account due to pinterest newly deactivating accounts. they didn’t even warn me. MY ACCOUNT WAS JUST DEACTIVATED OUT OF THE BLUE. no email to ask me to get rid of pins that went “against community guidelines” or anything. i lost everything. 5 years of pins SAVED 😣 i sent a request for wrongful termination but they haven’t responded and it’s been 7 days. Pinterest was such a positive place where i could save ideas and share ideas, now it’s not what it was like. i’m really upset. i lost my accounts, my pins and my favorite app. if you could somehow create a way to let people sign up for more than one account on the same email, that would be great! or just not deactivate so many accounts. tons of my friends lost their accounts too!

Been using Pinterest for a while; for the most part it works as it should, although I’ve noticed that the bugs only seem to get worse as time goes on. The ads look just like regular pins, so if you’re not paying attention, you’ll accidentally click on one thinking it’s something to pin and be sent elsewhere (or even if you just tap it by mistake). The recent update also feels invasive to me: Pinterest now (instead of just asking) requires a birthday before logging in. The reasoning stated was to “help younger users” and to use my age to target advertising me to. I guess I’ll be uninstalling, because I’m not keen on having targeted advertisement based on my age. The only valid excuse I could think of for requiring this is to protect younger users from predatory people (but that only works so long as everyone is honest about their age, and not everyone will be). Overall, the app used to be okay. It’s good for making aesthetic boards, links to outside resources, or browsing for inspiration for art. Beyond that, it’s hard to recommend, especially with the recent bugs before this update.

I, like a lot of you have been on Pinterest for years. It’s fun, I spend way to much time on it, but have always felt it’s worth while. A couple days ago I tried to get on and now all of the sudden they want my birth date? Why you ask, after almost 7 or 8 or maybe even 10 years of use, well that’s what I want to know. Plus the fact why is it their business what my age is. ( and for anyone interested, I’m 63 years young 😉) I’ve never seen anything on there that was inappropriate, one of the things I like most about Pinterest .So, being me I just punched in a date and NOW my account has been deactivated! What the Heck… And to top that off if I want to get my account back up, I have to show them a government ID or my birth certificate. Come on people, what’s going on here???? I deleted my account lost all my info and I’m not sure if I want them back… I have always told friends and family how awesome Pinterest is and have turned a lot on to it. If this problem isn’t resolved, I’m spreading the word to everyone I know and on Facebook to all my friends “ user beware”

ETA: lousy app with a history of seriously awful updates. Now it says I can’t use it unless I enter my birthdate. Well guess what? I am NOT entering my birthday. I see no good reason for this. I just downloaded the latest update and now the app crashes every few minutes. Pictures either load slowly or not at all, and it's a lot slower than it was before I downloaded the update. I don't understand how you can do consistently make the app worse. Surely the law of averages would make at least an occasional update an improvement. I also don't understand why it immediately returns to the top of the home screen if I leave it for a few minutes. I find it much easier and faster to open links in my browser, but I'd like to be able to return to where I was in the app. Pinterest is painfully slow at opening links, plus now it crashes every few minutes. Please stop with the lousy updates...at least until you hire someone who knows what he or she is doing. Ideally, the app would go back a few updates to where it actually worked. I used to love Pinterest, and I still like the premise. However, every update makes it a little worse.

I’ve used Pinterest for about the past two years. it was all going great in fine I loved the app. but lately there’s been tons of glitches in the system. Whenever i’d tap on my follower button it shows up that I don’t have any followers when I do. A whole bunch of accounts I used to know have completely gone off. I know the accounts are still there because I still see them but whenever I tap on them the app goes haywire. I don’t know what is happening but it needs to be fixed. I know it’s not just my device because other devices I use to access Pinterest have done the exact same thing. and it’s not just my account if I tap on a friends account it says they have whatever amount of followers but when I click on the follow button it says they don’t have any or it will say I’m following or someone else is following X amount of people but only half of that number is actually there. reporting also needs to be taken more seriously. I have had experience with people making very interesting Pinterest boards containing threats and mean words. situation like this need to be taken more seriously and possibly ban accounts not just forget about it. messaging on Pinterest has also gone very off. The way it used to work you would press on the account you wanted to message with and there you had it. But now I am unable to message completely. I have tried contacting Pinterest on the app through the messages to get the problem resolved but it does not work. I don’t know if someone did something or what but everything needs to get fixed and taken care of asap.

i’ve been using pinterest for so long and i spend so much time on pinterest so it’s kinda frustrating because this has never happened before. i upload/post things on my pinterest feed and i never get notifs when someone comments on my stuff so whenever i look randomly that’s when i find them. yesterday i was scrolling through my posts and i noticed i had some comments so i went to go like them and the “liked by creator” never showed up like it usually does. i thought nothing of it and tried highlighting the comment and a message came up on my screen saying “something went wrong on our end. sorry about that.” i replied to the comment and when that person responded to me, i tapped on the notif and it brought up MY post but had a DIFFERENT user name on it when it was MINE. and now whenever i look at what’s supposed to be MY comments, OTHER creators comments show up but again, with MY pictures that i upload. I’ve logged out, deleted the app and reinstalled it and it still continues to do this. i recently uploaded something and when someone commented, i liked their message and the “liked by creator” showed up but it still won’t for my older posts. i tried ignoring it but it’s really frustrating and i hope pinterest fixes this soon. i really don’t want to delete everything and re-upload it or delete my account entirely.

reviews.t: Good but I need something’s changed back
reviews.x: I live the app don’t get me wrong but there I things I wish I could get back. Like when you add to a certain board, the most recent ones are up at the top. I have ADHD and none of my boards can go order when adding something. I also like it better when the save icon for products with links was higher. Where it was next to the links themselves. I started with the cons because they’re little. I love how you can organize items in the boards and how you can move them around. I do wish you had a button that can send you to the bottom and back up of your boards though. The sensitivity of the switching on something’s might be because of my phone or the Pinterest l, either way it’s frustrating when you saving something and it moves. I do wish we could change the theme of Pinterest such as changing the back ground on some areas. Also be able to change the app icon like other trending apps do now and days would also be great! I enjoyed this app for years and it’s great but there are things where I wish it could add it a little “SPICE”

reviews.t: Pinterest is great, but the ads are wayyyyy too much.
reviews.x: Don’t get me wrong - I love Pinterest as much as the next girl, but the ads are getting out of hand. I have performed several tests to find the frequency of the ads in comparison to regular pins, which have produced a result that about 30% of all pins (or 15 out of every 50 pins) are ads. They drastically take away from the experience of Pinterest and are highly distracting. Pinterest is supposed to be “aesthetic,” correct? It has devolved into a ghost of its former self with all of these ads. If Pinterest is gearing up for a “premium” or “pro” service, anticipate a LOT of pushback. That would betray the interest of the consumers and ultimately hurt the app. There are better ways to have ads and earn revenue, such as incorporating more ads into the “watch” section of the app instead of on the main interface. Also, given that Pinterest has had an incredible increase in revenue in the past 4 years, you would think that the developers would be using those extra funds to continue improving the experience of the user, but the opposite has occurred. Ads do not aid in a sense of discovery and do not enhance the Pinterest experience. Please decrease the amount of ads.

reviews.t: BEST APP BUT A FEW PROBLEMS
reviews.x: i love this app so much i have two accounts im on here 24/7 but sometimes on pinterest i want to delete a chat, so when i delete the chat it goes away and then ahen the person texts me agian it comes back , i tried blockinf them which pervented it from coming back but if i try texting them agian our old messages are there , and i dont know how to fix it , and sometimes when you click on on a picture and scroll under to see others like it, nothing pops up but the stuff related to what you saved recently, which i find very unpleasant. also , when you write comments they dont always show up, even if the creator dosent delete it they dont ahow up and its very weird, and lastly you cant delete your account , no matter how hard you try or press deactivate and delete data it dosent work, it still stays and lets you log in which i found really annoying. other than that i love this app so much⭐️⭐️

I have used Pinterest for years. And it used to be so great, i found it so relaxing, this is the only app that I consistently use. What happened to you?! 1) the ads are so suffocating, I absolutely hate them. They make it where unless you are on your personal boards that you’ve pinned, you cannot not see ads. I miss when you used to be able to search something and on the top of the screen would be more ideas to help “pin” point what you specifically are looking for. I would pay to have ads removed or least see way less then there is. 2) there’s been this annoying thing where you can’t swipe down on a pin to exit out, now you have to reach over to the other side of your screen to exit out, it’s like a workout for your arm just to get out of a pin. 3) when I want to look at one of the sections that I use to organize within my board, it does this thing where I’ll be scrolling and then my finger exits the section. Then I have to start over from the beginning and scroll to see what I was looking for. 4) the costumer support is terrible. You would think that a company would care what there consumers have to say since they are the ones they use the app, and without them Pinterest wouldn’t exist. I feel like they don’t care, and they don’t ever explain anything to you. Old Pinterest please please come back.

EDIT: (january 21, 2023) When I look through my boards and then hit the go back button, it refreshes and takes me back to the top. Extremely annoying and unnecessary. Please fix this!!!! It almost makes the app unusable. I love this app but i’m rating it one star in hopes this catches the attention of the developers. The amount of accounts popping up that are filled with sexual content, including some accounts that have boards of CHILDREN and the boards have the most horrible sexual titles ever, is horrifying and very concerning. I wish there was a way to report the whole account for sexual content/pedophilia/children in danger, etc… but when i try to it says pinterest ONLY removes accounts that post misleading content and spam or unsolicited commercial messages. I would really love for this app to be a safe space for all, but it seems impossible at this point. There are so many pictures of young girls and children on this app, and when you see the comments it’s full of these perverted accounts and there’s no way to be able to report the account as a whole, only the comment itself, and who knows if that actually does anything to ban the account. Please please please, give us a way to report these accounts for endangerment, explicit content, etc… and let us receive updates on our reports. Pinterest should be safe for everyone.

I love this app! It helps me find cool stuff that I wouldn’t find on Google and it has a lot of stuff I have actually wanted to know about plus it has videos although I wish we could download them it’s fine. The downsides are whenever I go to my saves and scroll down to get more images and I click on the image it makes me scroll up to the top automatically, and another is that when I try to make add another account my age isn’t available?? I checked to see what age is the limit to be on Pinterest and im already older than the limit yet it still won’t allow my age? I don’t know if this is something that is on purpose or maybe I need to delete some accounts but it’s just not doing it for me and a friend of mine that had barely just downloaded this had struggle with the age as well so I don’t know if im so sure if this is a problem need to be fixed but more so just the way the app is. Anyways if I could fix these problems I’d give it a 100% / 5 star rating 😊 other than that everything is fine.

rating this 5 stars so people will see it.. i’ve loved pinterest and have for years! although i kept getting bored with my accounts so i often made new ones for my new obsessions. i just made one last night called localstfan_ , where i just saved photos and videos of stranger things and the cast etc, sometimes i’d also save horse vids and pics and stuff like that. i hardly commented or anything. i went to get on my account this morning and it said my account was deactivated. i did nothing wrong, i hardly commented and when i did it wasn’t negative, nor rude in any way, shape or form. and i didn’t save anything bad either, i had JUST made the account..? which i misspelled my email so i can’t even get an appeal on my deactivation, nor can i log back in to change my email.. this really upsets me but i did make another account, aleasequestriandream and i’m hoping it doesn’t get deactivated.

I’ve used Pinterest for YEARS! I absolutely love this app and use practically everyday. For the last few weeks, I have noticed a small glitch. I would look at a new Pin, maybe go to the pin creator’s page and fry to click another pin or short. When I click on the new pin it takes me back to the original pin/video I first clicked on. If I try another pin on the same page I continuously get the same issue happening until I back off the page and tap onto a different pin and then sometimes the same thing will happen again. Only one short or pin will play. I’ve tried to clear all running pages in the background and have even checked to see if the app needed to be updated, and I’m coming up with nothing. So I figured I’d try to let someone know. Would you all mind taking a look into this? I would greatly appreciate it! Happy New Year! - A huge lover of Pinterest! 💜

reviews.t: Love to see the world see me in more than one way
reviews.x: This app will put a smile on your face when it says that some liked your style or your board and then says you got style or you got taste or something like that positive. As a transgender person it’s trying to fit in the world again but a lil bit differently than I originally intended and there’s been a lot of ups and downs and mostly truthfully more down but this app has really made me want to look up again and share with others my experiences and views and to have them like it or have similar experiences and views has really helped me to understand and realize whats important in life and how I reaching out to others and being patient and understanding and actively listening to others and respecting them is really showing them how I am as a person and how they interact in the world is just as important as when they interact with their family friends that is really what I feel that has made me feel so strong with the Pinterest community. Love to you all

reviews.t: Love it but needs a lot of work
reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest for years. I love it! I use it as a visual search engine as I’m sure many others do. Imagine my utter disappointment when it seemed that it was broken. When I tried to search I would receive messages that there were no pins for that search. I was annoyed to say the least. So why did I give Pinterest 5 stars? They earned their stars! I sent them a message letting them know my problem and attached screenshots. I receive multiple follow up emails from them. They work hard to correct any bugs in the app and sure enough they figured it out and fixed it by the next update which is every single week. I don’t know many other apps that are constantly fixing bugs and updating like this. While I was annoyed I couldn’t use it for those few times I attempted to use it I’m beyond impressed with the turn around time in which they solved the issue!

reviews.t: Great app, but theres one thing that bugs me.
reviews.x: I love pinterest, i have for years. With the recent rise and popularity of Tiktok, many social media apps have taken it amongst themselves to make formats similar to Tiktok’s, including pinterest. This is exactly where my problem lies. When i go to search things up on pinterest, ALL the things that pop up are videos! I personally dislike the videos because they don't recommend similar ideas when you scroll down like it does with the photos, and photos already have the item i want right in the picture, as for videos i have to sit through a whole minute to see one second of the item/example i was looking for. Whats even more frustrating is when i search up pins, most of the results are videos! Its become so agitating for me that i was compelled to write this complaint. I’m not saying to completely remove the videos, but at least make a filter so you can see only images or only videos, or both when searching up pins. Because from my knowledge, i can’t seem to find anything to fix this.

i LOVE pinterest, i use it everyday(or i did). there are so many cute videos, ideas, and posting is so much fun! these reason make me even more disappointed in what has happened. my pinterest was working wonderfully, with no bugs for a long time. after a while, it would stop loading, so i had to turn on airplane mode and turn it off again to reset my wifi. and that worked, but i would have to do it at least 20 times every hour or so. sometimes i would have to swipe away the app for it to work. today, it stopped working. it says i’m in my account, and i can see the “browse” and “watch” on top of my screen and the bar on the bottom, but it doesn’t work. it just keeps loading🥲. i tried doing the airplane mode, swiping it away, nothing. i even tried restarting my phone. nothing. this exact thing is happening to my sister too, and i don’t think that is a coincidence. our phones are pretty knew. we both have the iphone 11 and we got them January of 2022, so i don’t think my phone is the problem. please fix this, thanks for reading.

reviews.t: “Pin stats” menu is in a distracting place.
reviews.x: for business accounts, the “pin stats” menu is super annoying and distracting. i do not find it very appealing that it’s constantly visible while viewing my pins. it gets really frustrating when i’m just trying to scroll through the pins i’ve published, but instead have numbers in my face. while it’s a helpful tool for business accounts to track their interactions and engagements, i don’t think it’s necessary for it to constantly be there while viewing a pin i’ve published. as an owner of a business account and frequent pinterest user, i would appreciate it if there’s a way to hide the “Pin stats” bar, or at least put it in a drop down menu so it only shows up when you actually /want/ to look at your statistics. also, i changed my review to 3 stars, as the “hide pin” button is STILL in a horrible spot - right above the “download image” button. this is such a horrible design flaw and i can’t believe it’s been overlooked by the developers for this long. i imagine it would be an easy fix, just put the hide pin button someplace else!! i’m not sure if anyone on the pinterest team even reads the reviews, but please don’t take my considerations lightly.

reviews.t: it would be amazing with these improvements💔💔
reviews.x: i LOVE pinterest so much, it’s very helpful with art, interests, styles, clothes, honestly anything but over the years the quality has gotten… worse honestly. You used to be able to post a photo in the comments, which I’ve wanted to do so many times to show my art of a refrence photo.. but they got rid of that feature for some reason?? The app has also gotten VERY glitchy, when someone tries to comment, pinterest glitches and sends their comment like 20 times .. also when I send a pin to my friends it will send multiples. Also when I click the profile button to get back to my profile, i have to manually click back through each pin i went on. Also, there’s a glitch we’re some people were getting 500 people unfollow them randomly?? and I remembering following my friend and then later it showed that I had unfollowed him… please please please fix the glitches!!! (and add back the comment pictures)

I have not had Pinterest for that long but I overall feel like it has change the way I do basic life skills. it was my birthday recently like yesterday and I needed to clean my room and I use a Pinterest idea that I have got and it basically just helps you with like daily activities so cool. I recommend for looking for ideas like say for instance or ideas to decorate your new bedroom or to decorate your bathroom or your car and it’s just I can help you decorate anything at all I’ve been so much happier with Pinterest because I feel like I can look at peoples ideas and not for copying people. The app Pinterest is an about copying people and get the most followers about getting ideas from people that had a really good ones I love Pinterest and I think I will continue to love Pinterest. it’s also cool because the safe instance a lot of people don’t have phone numbers you can message on pintrest10/10 rating from me

The algorithm used to be smart and I find as more social platforms aim to make a profit, this no longer the case. My main reason for going on Pinterest is to find great recipes and DIY projects. Occasionally I’ll look up a make-up tip. The latest update shows pictures of food without the description now. That isn’t useful since I do not want to click on every picture to figure out what I’m looking at. Actually, when I look up a specific recipe, the next time I open the app I have a dozen posts showing how to make the exact same recipe from other bloggers. That’s excessive, don’t you think? Then there is the proliferation of influencers featured on the app. *sigh* Again, this isn’t what I came here for. I also don’t like the Tik Tok style of videos featured. Every app is not in competition with the latest fan favorite. Every app has their role and Pinterest is having a serious identity crisis. Lately, I try with the app for a bit and then give up and just Google recipes. At least that way my search results are more relevant than what I find here and there is no guessing game of what I am looking for.

Pinterest has been absolutely overtaken by ads. Instead of looking at aesthetic clothes, scenery and vegan recipes you are absolutely bombarded with advertisements. I used to love Pinterest, the organizing how stress relieving it all was. Being surrounded by such lovely personalized imagery and positive vibes. But now anytime I want to listen to audio, whether movies or music the ads interrupt every five seconds with loud music and words. The opposite of relaxing. I find myself constantly scrolling to get away from ads and see an aesthetic Pinterest page. But it never happens. I understand Pinterest needs to make money but this has gone absolutely wild. It’s ad after ad after ad. I can’t even enjoy my feed anymore as it isn’t really “my” feed. It’s selling me something. Something I don’t want to buy. If it was knitting patterns or the latest hiking boots I’d enjoy it. But it’s fast food, which does not fit the Pinterest user looking for quick and creative vegan recipes. I’m not even vegan, but Pinterest used to make me believe I could do anything. It was the calm on the storm of my life. It was how I coped. Now I am just sad. I miss the old Pinterest. Also seriously the ads with audio kill the vibes!! I still use Pinterest every day hoping I’ll come to the same serene state as I used to before the loud tacky music that takes me away from looking at ethereal fantasy concept art. I am truly saddened by Pinterest, ads I can deal with, but now it is all ads.

reviews.t: Am addicted to this app, but was better before
reviews.x: I love this app and I am honestly on it way to much😅However, I hate that they took away the tried section on pins. We can l No longer post picture or videos in the comments. In my opinion, that was one of the best features. I loved putting my art in there and getting advice and seeing others and giving advice. It’s also fun to see people try singing videos and such. I wasn’t allowed to post and a lot of people are the same way, so that’s a way to share that isn’t actually posting. I understand what issues can occur, such as bad or inappropriate photos, but you can’t really escape that. There’s a reason reporting comments is a thing. Another thing, the home feed is always refreshing without me wanting it to. I will see a pin that looks really interesting and go to tap it but it will refresh randomly without me even swiping down and I lose it forever. Very frustrating. Other than that, I love this app. Edit: each update brings more issues lol. Not the report/edit/delete button on comments is gone. And I keep finding profiles of pedophiles and I try to report but the only option is for spam. I report anyways but I would like more options for reporting profiles like on comments. Still want picture comments back

this is a very good app overall, there aren’t too many bugs and i love this app. BUT- there is something that angers me to the core, gets me on my nerves, boggles my brain even. For some reason whenever i “save too many pins” it says i’ve hit a block and i can’t save any more which ,in fact, ruins the whole point of the app, youre supposed to save a lot of pins that’s literally the main thing in this app. I am fueled with rage whenever i get the message that i need to take a break and i can’t save any more pins. So far i’ve gotten it atleast hundreds of times and it needs to be addressed. I cannot stand this anymore, i am so sick and tired of being in my feels saving fear street pictures to my board with a sad song playing in the back when suddenly i am stopped and i have to take a break. it isn’t even that hard to get the message you have to save 50 pins minimum to get it or something idk i’m not counting but i get it frequently and it ruins my mood. I go from depressed to infuriated real fast. i really hope you can fix this because your app went from 5 stars to 3 maybe 2

i actually really love pinterest, ive used it for a long time as a sort of thing to just store my pictures privately and i like that i can organize everything well as well as find new pictures ofc. However once i made a new account theres this new feature where if i press to save a pin, id expect to be able to select which board id like to save it to, section etc. but now it just goes into a public section on my profile I cant delete???? I cant even find the pin i tried to save if i dont instantly click the pop up every time. This wastes so much time and its extremely EXTREMELY annoying. i just wanna save my pin and be on my way but no. makes me never wanna use the app anymore because it makes everything so inefficient. Especially when im decluttering and trying to move pins I already had organized into another board. Not to mention half the time I do that method, the pins all dissapear forever once I delete to original section or board they were in. With all the updates this app is becoming absolutely unusable for a lot of people. I wish there was at least an option to disable the unirganized/quick save sections because I hate it to my very core

reviews.t: It’s a great app but please stop taking away features!
reviews.x: I’ve used the app for years, and it’s great, but PLEASE stop taking away features. Where you can “try” pins or comment with a photo has been removed, and it’s annoying. One of the original things from Pinterest were that you could “try” things in the comments. Or even just put a specific reaction picture. Seeing people try and recreate crafts and projects or funny reaction pictures feels like it was the point of the comment sections- to discuss the pin. Long story short it’s a feature that shouldn’t have been removed. Aside from that, the updates to the comment sections as a whole haven’t been my favorite. The new “react” feature seems a bit pointless; in the past you could like a comment and it was simple. There was a number of people that liked it and a heart lit up when you liked it. The new feature not only shows other people’s reaction in color- it only changes to “loved” or “helpful” in a dull color, which makes it really hard for people with poor eyesight, dyslexia, etc to discern which comments they have reacted to (since they are already in color) The helpful option as opposed to the loved option makes sense, but it seems more trouble that it’s worth. In short, the lack of commenting with pictures and the reaction mechanics need work. Otherwise, it’s a great app.

Writing this as a review since contact information for any help or representative line is hidden beyond access for general users. I received an email that one of my pins that I had more than likely re-pinned from it’s original source. I don’t mind this, as I understand copyrights and other reasons come up with just cause for removal. However, the same email claimed that the pin removed was flagged for pornographic or explicit content - which is not my intended use for my profile. Furthermore, these emails never show or list the deleted pin in question. Again, it doesn’t raise hairs on my end for a pin I only saved to a private board - however, it does get me up in arms to hear that because of a pin I cannot see, my account may be deleted for violation of policy. Threatening account deletion seems extraneous, considering I am not able to see the pin in question and therefore have no idea what I would be “appealing” when making a request to what I assume is another bot and get no further platform to voice my concerns. My account by no means is intended to harbor anything of a pornographic nature and is simply meant to be a storage place for ideas and aesthetics, so I personally doubt that the pin was actually in violation. I have actually left reviews in the past that explicit content was an issue on the app, but it seems Pinterest has taken it to the opposite extreme. I’d love to chat further with a representative about resolving this (if there even are any), as I feel this airs on the side of ridiculous, and is an ignorant way to enforce decency policies - considering this app has lost so much popularity in the last few years.

Want an app seems worthwhile but is guaranteed to inundate you with garbage on a daily basis? Pinterest is for you! Just when you think you’ve got a handle on things Pinterest’s algorithms will decide you’re really interested in something completely irrelevant. If you want to follow grown-up subjects like art or graphic design Pinterest will make sure you see nothing but fingernail painting and revolting foods. Interested in architecture? Pinterest has you covered with hundreds of pins showing home-schooling plans and dodgy financial advice. Like book design? You’ll see more hair braiding and weight-loss tips than you can shake a stick at! And the advertising! Always on target. Pinterest knows you’re sure to decide on your next car or make other major financial plans on the basis of companies they promote. You’ll see plenty of pins about vacations you can’t afford and products no sensible person would buy. But don’t bother blocking them (or anything, really) - they’ll be back next week whether you want to see them or not. And the support team TOTALLY has your back! Pinterest takes your concerns seriously, with responsive feedback that ignores your complaints, blames you for problems, and retaliates by doubling down on content you’re guaranteed not to love. Pinterest? Might as well be Insta. Or FB. Or nothing at all. P.S. All these problems are worse since I posted this review! Nice way to treat a user!

I love pinterest, but the updates and glitches sometimes make me want to delete it. One problem I have is that when you click to see comments, it will say “one more” or however many comments there are on a pin, but when you click it none of them appear. Pinterest also removed the feature where you can comments pictures which is also really annoying because they made the comments worse instead of fixing them. Aside from that, they keep adding more useless updates and updates that would be good if they actually worked. For example the pronouns feature is great, but after you open and close the app it will make the pronouns you selected go away. They added a “read more” button in your bio that people have to click to see the rest of your bio which is really annoying and pointless since people could see your entire bio already until the update. In general, the app is very glitchy and doesn’t work properly. When I try to download images, it gives me a notification that says my request couldn’t be completed even if the image did download which is very annoying, and when you add a business account the profile cover glitches out and looks really bad. I could go on about this forever. PLEASE FIX YOUR APP!!!

Just like everyone else who’s ever used Pinterest I love it(!) especially the part where you can try something & post your results however; & this might just be me due to (old) mobile phone restrictions but, I’m not so “in love” with the limited amount of new “pins” being offered in my home feed(?). There used to be a wide variety with a touch of everything in it but lately it seems to be more tailored towards only the pins I’ve saved, visited, or are exclusively from boards I’m following(?). Again this could be something that only I’m realizing & it could all come from me having an older iPhone so therefore I’m restricted by feature availability (even though I’m up to date with the latest of upgrades) but I’m not so very bothered by having to paruse the plethora of pins people post for our enjoyment… I mean that is what it’s all about right?!? LoL! It asked for a review so I had to right something!?! LoL! It’s Pinterest… we just love it!! TTFN ✌🏼

reviews.t: Banner after I ‘pin’ in my way
reviews.x: I really like this app to browse ideas, save pictures of things I enjoy, get ideas for projects, etc. In that regard, the app is great. As to function, I am repeatedly annoyed by the banner that appears after you save a pin confirming the pin was saved as the banner is in my way when I immediately am about to ‘exit’ or ‘close’ that particular pin! It takes a second to appear- obstructs the “x” to close the pin, and takes about 5 precious seconds to disappear. Or, I must take the added step to swipe up on the banner to rid the banner before I can close the pin and move on to save additional pins. It’s not long before I just stop browsing pins due to the this unnecessary step. The banner should not obstruct the “x” to exit and it should be a clean, smooth exit. I tend not to go to Pinterest as my time to peruse it is precious and instead of feeling like I accomplished my search fully, I am frustrated throughout the process. Please consider revamping this feature.

Used to be 5 stars. Lowered it because I do not like that some ads play sound. I am trying to browse on a bus or something when all of a sudden it blasts out this ad for a tv show. Very embarrassing. I love Pinterest because every time you open it there is something new to look at. There’s a never ending amount of things to see. Your feed is totally customizable so you can see things you’re interested in and avoid things you’re not. If Pinterest shows you something you’re not interested in you just say I don’t want to see things like that and it learns your preferences. You can keep everything you see saved on boards organized however you want. I don’t even have any other apps on my phone for entertainment except Pinterest because nothing else compares!! Also, you don’t have to be a girl to use Pinterest! There’s tons of guy things from cars to fishing and hunting to at home DIY projects. You can use Pinterest for literally everything in your life whether it’s cooking or clothes or entertainment or nature or music, it doesn’t matter.... it has everything!! Do not like the new borders around the pins when you open them.

I love this app and I’ve used it for years. It is both creative and fun, I’ve never had a dull moment with this app. BUT recently I’ve gotten a lot emails about pins being removed because it’s against the community guidelines on seemingly random boards, I eventually got around to submitting a bunch of appeals but just before I did so I received another lot of emails reinstating all of my previously removed content. It still happens on and off but it’s starting to get annoying. The reinstatement emails are also vaguely threatening about taking additional action against my account where I obviously haven’t done anything wrong. Like I said, I love this app and the content but if this keeps up, my annoyance may override my love for the app. I understand people report pins and they’re automatically removed, but waking up to emails every day about pins being removed and put back is getting a little out of hand. ALSO I think the language recommendation needs work due to the fact that I hide pins because I don’t understand the language but still get recommended things in that language.

reviews.t: Good app but has major problems
reviews.x: I’ve been using Pinterest for years now and I primarily use it on my phone and iPad since it’s most convenient. But, for a long while now, Pinterest has this feature(?) where you can open a board and simply swipe away to return to the previous menu/screen. BUT IT’S SO ANNOYING! I hate to be critical but when I’m trying to quickly scroll down a board and accidentally swipe *even just slightly* diagonally in any direction instead of straight down- or tap too high up when trying to scroll back up- the app will “swipe away” my current tab. If this was an occasional problem then that’s one thing, but this happens CONSTANTLY. I’d really like this fixed.. I’m not sure why it was implemented in the first place because it’s not as if it was hard to return to previous pages beforehand. I also have many of the same complaints as other users: The app constantly updates and makes huge changes each time- often these changes are for the worse and do nothing to improve the app. Second, leaving one screen and returning to it refreshes the entire page. Sometimes it just does this randomly.

reviews.t: Favorite app that fell down hill.
reviews.x: I don’t know how to explain that I LOVED this app back in 2019 when the app was good. But now they’ve added too many USELESS features and layout changed that are frustrating. I liked how Pinterest before used to be very simple and minimalist. They used to have it when on the main feed (home) at the top you can swipe between pins and I loved that till you guys put “watch”. About Watch… it’s really annoying to scroll on your feed and see a cute pin for it to be a freaking TikTok/Reel?!? And it’s annoying that half of my feed is it now. They they got rid of the top feed for this stupid watch. Then they put Pinterest TV which was cool but useless. But I still want the swiping between pins. That brings me to how you moved the alerts/messages to the top right. While all those annoying changed that no one uses you decided let’s make the bottom icons (home,search,post,profile) fill up the bottom. It used to float which was nice. Also the shopping thing is annoying Pinterest has a good shopping platform but they should learn from instagram and see that it doesn’t do well. Obviously every app has to change but these changes have made the app too cluttered and annoying to use.

Pinterest has a great collection of easily searchable topics that I’m interested in. I find it easier to find more specific topics, in comparison to Instagram. What is really annoying is these pop up dots, and marketing suggestions on EVERY PIN!!!. I have been less interested in the political climate of facebook, and because I, myself work in social media in the age of the influencer, I’m just over being a frequent user of Instagram culture, and the desperation, the race for “getting followers,”. Since taking break, and also redecorating my home, I have turned to Pinterest. Don’t get me wrong, I get a lot of inspiration from the app. But these pop ups!!! My gosh…I understand every social media company is under pressure from sponsors, but with those pop ups(the dots and marketing suggestions/price tags to links) it feels like a really pushy sales person following you around with a cosmetic/perfume sample that won’t leave you alone!! Pinterest I get it everything is about selling selling selling, but it has ruined the user experience in so many ways. If I’m really interested I’ll search it and hit visit. I invite to ask your users how they feel about this. Without it there is still product placement all over the feed, there are still user friendly, links to visit any website you are truly interested in..that is the thing about the social media company I work for. It Feels SPAMMY.. and it’s of your doing. I’m sure you can relate, how annoying it is to be trying to read an article on a website w/click bait popping up, interrupting your reading…that is the good thing about Facebook and Instagram. The scrolling is smoother, and they still have product placements, that don’t make you want to tear your hair out!!!

reviews.t: Just a couple things need fixing :)
reviews.x: I absolutely love Pinterest, I’ve used it for years. The only reason I’m giving it a 4 instead of 5 stars is that recently (meaning a few weeks ago) I realized I can no longer “try pins”. At first I just thought it was a little glitch but seeing as other people have updated the app and said the option is gone is kind of a bummer. I mean, Pinterest is an idea app and a diy place where you share your ideas and how they turned out with other people. How are you supposed to show how it turned out without the try pin? I’d love it if this feature came back. Another thing that disappointed me was that I saw another review saying the sections inside of boards were taken away? Of course, this review was left a year ago but still, I’ve been hesitant to even update my Pinterest in case this is still happening. I use sections inside all of my boards because sometimes I’ll have a board for my house but I section them off from bedroom, bathroom, etc. and it’d be really difficult to find what I’m looking for if that’s taken away. Anyways, I know I just went on and on about all the things I wish could be fixed but honestly it’s not that much and I really do love Pinterest, it’s my favorite app. :)

Why bring the quick saves back? It was better without them, how can we tell if we saved that pin before or not it’ll involve clicking out of the photo and trying to save it to see. Advertisements are literally taking over and videos/shopping are at the top. I don’t want video/pictures to click into I want pictures to save, ideas to save not videos. I mean sometimes videos are okay I save them sometimes but they are repetitive videos at the top when looking for similar pictures, at least put them in the middle they are disruptive especially the ads when scrolling up. Fine! Keep the ads, get rid of the excessive video pop ups! I change my mind, so many excessive ads and random auto playing of advertisements, it’s too loud! Keep the videos! Also give us back pictures in comments, it’s an enjoyment to share especially art! Don’t take that away please! Update: Also, before the update into quick saves it was easier to save, didn’t have to scroll to the certain board I created. Now they are suggesting me my boards that I have that aren’t even nearly related to the photos I try to save…don’t even get me started on the automatic refresh when there are so many brilliant photos to be saved, I cry!🥲😂

Features to be fixed: • AUTO REFRESH: Seriously, every time I leave a tab and go back to it, it always refreshes even if I do nothing. I’ve lost many good finds because of this feature, and it’d be less maddening if you could manually refresh a page yourself. • ARCHIVED BOARDS: I can no longer scroll down tofind my archived boards. The only way I could find them is if I search for them in the search bar! There should be a sub tab in your saved where you can see your archived boards and manage them. Features to be added: • CATEGORIES: I’m pretty tired that I have to manually scroll down a long list of boards just to find the one I’m looking for. It would be much more efficient if you had the option to sort your boards into categories (ex: Inspiration Boards, Art Tip Boards) and not have to delve into the midst of some unrelated boards around it. • BOARD TRANSFER: There should’ve been an option to transfer boards you can edit to another account. I manually have to save individual pins to another account myself. I rely on Pinterest for worldbuilding, and it really bums me out that it is still lacking greatly.

What the heck are you doing to your own app!? What is this “unorganized pins” section? Whenever I click “save” it no longer brings up the board options like it used to. There was no issue with this but you still had to change it. Now when you click “save” it automatically saves it to the unorganized board instead of bringing up the list selection. what the heck. Stop making the app so annoying. There is no reason that the pins should automatically save to this section. Unnecessarily, annoying, and just an overall horrible decision. Fire whoever came up with this idea. Oh, I also found out that you took away the ability to reorder my boards. WHAT THE HECK! Stop making this app horrible and aggravating. Let me do what I need to do. Stop making it complicated, taking away features, and saying it’s improvements. update: the unorganized pins went away but you know how it is. with every pinterest update comes another pinterest glitch. now my home page will not refresh. i have to swipe to refresh it at least 3 times before it works. sometimes it doesn’t work at all. i have a good internet connection too. FIX YOUR APP!

reviews.t: The ads have gotten too obnoxious
reviews.x: I’ve used Pinterest for so long - and I understand that when an app is free, the user is the product. You’re selling our data and you’re selling ads to us - totally get it. But first your ads started moving. Half the time they are stuck and just flash for me which is so terrible. Then your ad to content ratio flipped to almost completely ads or shopping pins or sponsored in some way. And now, you’ve got videos that play sound. Sound that I can’t seem to be able to turn off. Your ad content is just SO distracting on this platform than I can’t even use this in the way it’s intended. Not to mention everything you serve me is related to exercising or makeup or dieting. Which means I get on here to find inspiration for illustration projects and just end up finding messages about how I should lose weight and buy makeup. Totally incongruent to my actual values and interests - which you should know…given the amount of data you have on me. Never once have I pinned makeup. Never once have I pinned diets or food or workouts. So I finally deleted the app today. Sad day. But I just get annoyed and angry every time I’m on here.

Pinterest has been one of my favorite apps for years. As a person obsessed with fashion, art, cooking, etc, Pinterest has been perfect place for me to get ideas and see what people are making. However, I think one of the most recent updates has made Pinterest loose part of its charm and it’s a pretty awful change, all things considered. Of course, I’m talking about the removal of being able to comment photos on pins. Having the option to share photos was wonderful, I especially loved it for crafts or recipes because you could see how things went for other people who tried it. It felt like it gave Pinterest a charming little community of people sharing what they’ve done with others. When the update took that away, it’s made Pinterest feel hollow; it makes Pinterest feel like it’s not about sharing ideas with a community anymore which kinda goes against what the app was designed for if you ask me. Overall, it’s a really disappointing change and I wish they would bring it back. Do better, Pinterest or you’ll loose your user base with these regressive updates :/

Pinterest is a cool app, I like it a lot but it does have a good amount of problems. Like when you swipe down to your notification screen and it reloads the whole page, or when your playing music and it forcefully gets cut off by the ads, you can’t see your liked pins, it now no longer has each individual board name where you can save things to that one specific board, it refreshes wayyyy to much, its no reason for it to refresh as much as it does, we can’t use emoji’s while naming a board. When i’m in a board and i’m swiping down/ up it goes out the whole board it’s like to loose. When I exit out of one board that’s farther down on my screen it goes back to the top of my boards. Even if i’m still in the app but just not at the home page when I go to it, it still reloads. The ads are so overwhelming and irrelevant to me. Recently, Princess Diana has been showing up all over my home feed just because I clicked her picture one time?All these things make me not want to use the app

reviews.t: Terrible customer service and app performance. Misrepresentation of maximum allowable store pins.
reviews.x: For the las several months I’ve consistently tried to understand how the Pinterest can misrepresent the maximum number of stored pins as being 200,000 The embarrassing Pinterest app algorithm doesn’t send error message prior any such 200,000 pin limit. It allowed 55,000 additional pins to saved before an error message was sent to user that they reached their number of stored pins. Meanwhile, the number of boards allowed has increased four fold? That’s absurd. The capricious response to question about why someone is forced to tear six years of work because the app developers didn’t include a basic feature that prevents any pin count over the alleged 200,000 pin limit. Just so I’m clear the solution to this problem issue is do nothing but adopt intransigence as customer service tool. The poor performance behavior of Pinterest app isn’t the burden of the user. The ethical response to the problem is to add a solution to the problem in Pinterest app feature, not insult the intelligence of career customer service reps like myself. What I described was clear example of maxim, you get what you pay for. My phone could never get away with redundancy and deflection as response to horrible lack foresight by Pinterest app developers.

I’d like to start off by saying I’ve used Pinterest for a decade now, and it still remains a favorite of mine. That being said I have had to adapt to countless, pointless updates. I understand the need to occasionally modernize the app and to fix bugs of course, but its frustrating when everything I like about the app is suddenly gone. 1. I really loved being able to go to the search tab, see one of my board titles, and swiping to find new ideas specifically for that board without searching anything. Now the feature is completely gone and I have to search something specific. I thought maybe I could use the “more ideas” tab on a board but that only prompts content based on your most recent pin. I’m very frustrated about this. It was a great feature, and I really have no clue why it was discontinued. 2. The constant refreshing of the home page is so annoying. Sometimes it’s by itself, sometimes it happens just when I exit a pin. I can’t even pin something fast enough before it refreshes sometimes. Only refresh when I want to refresh. Please. 3. The switch towards stories and reel type media is understandable because of general social media trends, but at the end of the day, that is exactly the type of media I am getting on Pinterest to avoid. I used to love the organized clean look of Pinterest, but now it’s cluttered with all this extra stuff I don’t want to see. The stories I can ignore and that doesn’t bother me, but now having an entire “watch” page when other popular features were removed frustrates me Pinterest is one of my favorite apps and probably my most used. I want it to continue being my favorite but Pinterest needs to get it together and figure out how they want their app. I open it up to use countless times a day and just close it because it’s not the same for me rn.

reviews.t: automatic refresh feed is ruining my life
reviews.x: i love pinterest, it’s great and cool, but im giving it three stars because of how many freaking times it refreshes it just because i left the app for a second or checked my dms or something or other. for the love of god PUT A NOTIFICATION FIRST BEFORE IT REFRESHES ASKING IF WE ACTUALLY WANT TO. IM CRYING. please. i will only be happy if you make this update. i’m so sad, depressed even and on the brink of spiraling into extreme mental insanity. my life is completely ruined and i don’t know how i will go on if changes are not made! it really is not hard. a simple notification double checking if i’d like to refresh before it just completely changes my feed when i was eyeing a pin! i am NOT the only person who feels such. there is a great plethora of memes made by teenage girls complaining about this unfortunate disfunction , but do not be fooled with the silly laughing emojis for we are actually crying on the inside. this is not okay, you cannot treat your loyal customers as such. we want CHANGE and we want it NOW. i am DEPRESSED and it is quite literally YOUR FAULT!!! FIX IT!

I have loved Pinterest for years, but recently they have made is so ads (which are already irrelevant) can play incredibly loud sounds/music as you are scrolling along! It has made me avoid using Pinterest for most of the day. I can’t use it when I’m near people or in bed, or basically anywhere because I have to turn off my phones sound. I don’t want to forget to turn it back on or I’ll miss a text, alarm, or call. I like to spend all my free time scrolling through Pinterest, but since I have to edit my settings every time I use it; I don’t use it. I’m too nervous I’ll accidentally forget to turn my sound back on and miss something. I have tried to find a way to edit it in the settings, but nothing seems to work. The videos that are a part of pins are silent unless you click them. They cause no issues, but the ads don’t follow the same protocol and have created quite a problem.

look, i am an avid Pinterest defender. i believe it is one of the most useful and aesthetically pleasing apps out there and has a format that is simple enough to get used to. but over the last year or so i’ve been getting disappointed in the newer updates. im all for change and growing as a company and moving with the industry, but Pinterest used to be able to cater and filter specifically to pictures and pins that i was searching for. i think thats what made Pinterest so easy to enjoy and find glee in making boards. i really liked the feature of making your profile as one of your existing boards and then boom, that feature seems to have just been removed completely and if you change it to something new you can’t remove the cover at all. and the small topic/tabs being completely removed from searches and making it so difficult to find specific pins. its just the small details that are coming and going without reason. i used to really love this app and i still do but it is just so frustrating. i really hope there can be improvements in the future because all this is causing is me to be constantly frustrated with the app.

I always loved Pinterest since 2014 when I was 14 and I’m 21 now. Since then I’ve considered it a ‘safe place’ free from ads and the traps of marketing where I could gather ideas and get creative without the pressure of social media. I have never made a review, but this app is just too close to my heart and it hurts to see it fall down. Recently, it’s just the same as other platforms. I can now rarely find a good recipe or a creative outfit. Every other pic is an advertisement for a waist trainer or TikTok influencers. I wouldn’t mind too much if it was less frequent like it was before but now it’s every other pin. It’s distracting to the point where I can’t find any good pins. Instead of it being a curative list of pins in your style, it’s tiktoks of influencers showing you the most recent trends. I can now barely find any pins that appeal to my style. It’s all those short videos or tiktoks that are just ads. The videos distract from the picture pins so I end up not seeing what I came to Pinterest for. It’s an ad fest just like Instagram and TikTok where the strategy is to get you hooked on watching those short useless videos for hours. I deleted TikTok and Instagram for a reason, and now all apps are turning into it. Pinterest has almost completely lost its individuality and I’m sure it’s just downhill from here. It’s a shame, but if it continues this way I’ll be forced to get off of it.

Ok, I have been using this app for over 5 years now. I understand some of your policies, catering to the masses and you made some changes; then more changes and now you allow people to use their own opinions to judge another’s opinion and repot them for conspiracy theories? Umm hello, where’s the First Amendment? Oh just in case you forgot , that’s free speech or freedom of speech, how technically do you any to get? .…ok, but one of my biggest problems is there’s no way to contact anyone. Your little link you got posted for the web is the same as in the app. Not helpful at all. I have a question about your ads. I understand you need to run ads because it’s a free app, ok fine, but do you have to play audio with the ad? It’s very freaking frustrating trying to listen to my music and have it get shut off every single time I come across one of the many video ads. I’m mostly writing my complaints here because there is no other option! I’ve looked and looked and there absolutely no way to contact anyone. App Market has now become tech support.

I’ve been a loyal Pinterest user since I was sixteen years old. I’ve always found new ideas, inspiration, and even just good pics on there. And then the app updated. Now I see videos and tiktoks all recommended for me. Instead of swiping left on my pinterest homescreen to see more ideas for my boards, I now can swipe left to watch tiktok-like shorts- just like on every other social media platform now. The reason I’ve been so loyal to pinterest was because it was unlike every other platform. But now I’m realizing that they’re apparently not. I honestly don’t care if other people want to collect videos - good for you - but pinterest was started as a diy and picture collecting site, not as a place to watch things (some of you may remember the old days when gifs were even hard to find on the old ‘rest). I guess I’m more disappointed than anything. After years of having the app on my phone, I’ve just recently begun contemplating deletion simply to escape the temptation of getting stuck in a seemingly endless loop of fifteen-second videos. Very disappointed that this is what the app has become.

Content is lovely, Pinterest is good at recommending stuff I like. I also enjoy that images can have any dimensions. But there’s a few issues that drive me crazy. 1. The comments. Sometimes there’s ones missing, sometimes it says there’s comments but none show up, sometimes you can’t click on replies. I’m not sure how but it never works completely. Just spent 20 minutes trying to post 4 replies and failed, so I’m a bit frustrated. 2. Zooming in on an image is very difficult, since it opens “more like this” which covers about a third of the screen. You can’t even scroll down to the bottom of the image without having to keep your finger on the screen so it doesn’t get covered by More Like This again. 3. The visual search button on the bottom right that sometimes covers content there the bottom, you can zoom in to read text underneath the white magnifying glass, but then you gotta deal with the More Like This pop up. 4. Personal preference, but I don’t like the story format that automatically switches image, I can never read/look at everything in the image before it already moves on to the next, so I have to click to go back constantly. As far as I know there’s no way to block that form of content.

reviews.t: Disappointed with moves away from original product
reviews.x: Pinterest continues to make more changes that move the app further and further away from why I use it: to find, save, and share ideas. I finally decided to write this review because the primary “+” button now isn’t for pins but for Instragram-like “stories”. Now you have to hunt to find the right “+” button under profile to add a pin from a website. Additionally, users no longer have control to edit the title and description of pins. Just notes to self or comments. I used to use this heavily for describing my modifications to recipes or notes on what I’d like to do on a particular project with my wife. The loss of control is frustrating. Lastly, Instagram’s approach to advertisements is anti-customer. I understand the need to monetize, but PLEASE don’t make the interaction so challenging that it “traps” your users in the ad. Two examples of this: 1) you can’t swipe down to dismiss an ad like you do any other pin - you have to reach up to the top-left of your screen and tap on the small back arrow, and 2) swiping up opens the ad instead of showing similar content - so then you have to tap “done” and the back arrow to get back to normal content. Instead, you should make the interaction/navigation similar to all other content. Your ads are “landmines” and I get so frustrated when I tap on one. Doesn’t have to be that way.

1) I don’t understand this apps block feature at all. The bare minimum for a blocking feature is to make it so you don’t see a user or their content again while they remain blocked and Pinterest doesn’t even ensure that. As far as I can tell the only thing it does is remove the blocked person from your sight if blocked through a comment but that’s not enough 🙃 I’m tired of being harassed because of fan art by people too young to be on the app anyway then not even be able to ensure I won’t see them or their pins again. 2) Desperately needs more options for reporting users for breaking guidelines! The fact the only option to report a users account is spam is ridiculous. If someone admits to being too young or is obviously breaking rules it should be much easier to get them removed or at least checked out. Stop putting all your energy into removing “inappropriate” content that’s not actually breaking your rules 😒 3) The volume of ads these days is absurd and the targeted ads swing and miss so hard it’s genuinely funny when it’s not insulting 🤷🏻

reviews.t: I love Pinterest, hate the update
reviews.x: Okay. I’ve had Pinterest on various accounts for the past 5 or so years. I love it, however the update completely killed the purpose of it for me. I used to spend hours adding pins to my favorite boards by using the quick add feature (you know how there was a top bar which you could use to click through your boards and it would suggest pins for it) HOWEVER, Pinterest decided to remove that feature and replace it with a walmart version of tiktok. I miss being able to click through super easily and adding lovely art or recipes. yes, i understand that you can still go to your boards and click the ‘more ideas’ icon, but it’s just filled with videos and not photographs. I understand that pinterest is trying to get the younger targeted audience to attract to it, however i want the old pinterest back! hey, and i’m in the target audience anyway (14). and also, if we wanted to watch tiktok, we would go on tiktok! i go on pinterest to find inspiration to do things and to organize my ideas. anyway, i guess i’m done with my review~ please consider this in your next update. Hopefully my review will go back to 5 stars.

reviews.t: Half the time, it doesn’t work!
reviews.x: Whether it’s on chrome mobile, chrome desktop, or either app, after pinning a bunch of pins, it simply stops working. I’ve cleared cashe, logged out, logged back in. After a while it will say “oops, you’ve been logging in a lot. Either wait 30 minutes or log in with Facebook or google.” It’s ridiculous! If I want to pin 100 times, why won’t it let me? I’ve seriously spent two days trying to pin 150 pins. I’ve only been able to pin 97. It’s like it doesn’t want you to use it or something! I agree with everything admod08 said in her “so sick of it” review. While browsing pics in chrome or safari, if you tap on the photo that is on Pinterest, it forces you to download the app. Then when you want to go back to the photos you were looking at, Pinterest takes you to the home page. I’ve gotten to the point where if I see a pic that says it’s on Pinterest, I just look over it and find a different pic. I hate how Pinterest has completely taken over everything. We have no control. It’s not very user friendly. You want to go to the website where the pic is, and it’s so hard to figure out what to tap, that half the time I can’t find the website. It takes me to other pins or to the homepage of the person who pinned it. I just want to go to the bloody website where the original pic is!

reviews.t: Recent updates have altered its essence.
reviews.x: There have been numerous changes over years that have altered the Pinterest experience but recent changes have radically altered the essence of Pinterest. Pinterest at its core is, or was, a great way to save ideas or to curate a finely tuned aesthetic. The best way to do this to find content you like and “pin” it and to find other people with boards that interest you and then follow the board or the entire account. One could actively search a topic or actively search the accounts and boards you have followed, but you didn’t need to actively search in these ways to find content that you wanted to pin. Instead of actively searching, you could casually browse updates on what had been pinned by those you followed and to see who you followed had in turn followed. This was the most efficient way to discover new appealing content. This was the essence of Pinterest - or at least one of core essences of Pinterest - following certain boards and accounts to get to the content that you were most interested in. Now, in addition to all the ads and the new tiktok type pins, the updates regarding the activity of accounts you’ve followed have been removed. There is little purpose in following anyone. Finding new content is now almost entirely based on the home feed and the algorithm that controls that home feed. You could actively go and look at the accounts and boards you have followed but if you have followed more than a few this becomes tedious and inefficient. You are now forced to settle for the content that you are given by the algorithm. Choice and individuality have been removed. I have unfollowed the 300+ accounts that I had followed because it was pointless. I tried to unfollow the many boards that I had followed but earlier changes have made this a very difficult. Pinterest just isn’t Pinterest anymore.

So i’ve been using pinterest for years and I absolutely love it. I have countless pins saved and even more than one account for all the interests I have! But there are a few recent updates that I haven’t be super happy with. The newest update is probably the worst, apps really need to stop trying to be like TikTok. We like your app the way it is, that’s why we use it. The new watch section with video pins is super weird to me, leave that kind of stuff for other apps, pinterest is perfect the way it is. Also, the pins where you can “stack” multiple images together is the absolute most annoying thing pinterest had ever added. I like being able to see one pin at a time without it skipping to the next really quick. I love pinterest, it is overall my favorite app. i just think it was perfect before the new updates were added. Anyway i hope anyone who reads this has a lovely day! :)

reviews.t: It used to be great, nows it’s just good.
reviews.x: I used to love Pinterest! Especially for home decor and recipes! But now I care a lot about rearranging boards in certain order, yet it gets scrambled up. I like my accounts boards and pins to look a certain way, but when I rearrange them the format gets crappy. And I don’t like the constant video advertisements because when I’m in Pinterest I enjoy listening to music at the same time but I can’t do that when an ad shows up. I remember when ads weren’t even on Pinterest. I miss that. I’m okay with short ads with pics instead of videos so it doesn’t mess up my music. But Pinterest please fix the reordering/rearranging the pins(I’m tired of putting a certain pin I want next to the other, but it end up under it or farther from it) please, it’d be a lot of help and I’d probably like the app extra more. Also, I’d like to go back to when I could search up board names of other profiles not just profile names. Also, better hashtags options.

reviews.t: Too much focus on commerce, ignoring users
reviews.x: Pinterest has become a clunky chore to navigate and is much less effective these days at its original intent. It’s focusing more on pushy commerce “features” and needless social crap than on discovering, organizing, and sharing ideas. I’m now exploring alternative apps. While I’m not a fan of ads (who is?), I know they’re usually necessary in order for an app/site/service to stay free, so I typically just try to ignore them. Pinterest has become a frickin obstacle course of ads. To top it off, they added a “Shopping List” board that no one asked for and no one is allowed to disable. (I’m lucky that I only have one… some users had up to a dozen identical Shopping Lists appear.) Everyone hates this feature. Every. One. It’s pushy and gross, and blatantly broadcasts how Pinterest only regards their users as potential sources of revenue. If anyone did want a shopping list, they’d make the board themselves. No one likes it when their consent and power of choice are disregarded. I contacted Pinterest about it, and they basically said “too bad”. They keep adding new garbage like commenting on pins (why? It only invites toxicity from the few people who actually care to comment), “trying” a pin (again, no one cares, and the only things shared are absolute crap), and “quick save”. No one asked for these. Pinterest isn’t better for them. None of it drew in new users. They’re typically awkwardly implemented and only invite complaints. So why do this $#~@, Pinterest? Just stop. Revisit your original purpose and refine what you have, and try listening to your users instead of pushing them away.

Pinterest has come a long way from what it used to be. Some of it was for the better, but for the most part it’s just gotten worse. I’ll have random pics come up and I’ve never searched for them before and when I just ignore and keep scrolling hoping that maybe they won’t show me another pic if I don’t do anything with it, they flood my feed with either the same or other pictures like it. Like for example: SZA. Never listened to her music a day in my life nor do I care to, but she pops into my feed so often you’d thing I have a board solely dedicated to her. I don’t, but Pinterest seems to think I do. Even if I block the picture it’ll say something thing like “Got it! You won’t see this again.” but like 2 minutes later it’s just a different picture of her. I’ve unfollowed nearly everyone to see if that was the issue, but it’s not. So I’m stuck with SZA forever I guess… And I’m not sure who decided that Profile Saves would be a time saver, but they were wrong. The feature is annoying. Just bring the old Pinterest back or at least have an update that negates the newest update.

reviews.t: Pinterest is pretty great, but it needs some work
reviews.x: I truthfully spend way to much time on Pinterest, I have 150 boards and nearly 60k pins. It’s extremely easy to use, a decent amount of organization ability, has plentiful pictures, ideas and products, and not to worry about privacy since it has that too! The only thing I’ve ever really had a problem with is the limitation on organization/categorization for personal boards. I don’t know if it’s because of the need to save space on Pinterest or even for personal profiles and on the app. But the limitation to only 2 steps in the sectioning pyramid(board and section) can be frustrating. For example in order to further divide a project from 1 and 2 to 1 and 2 and 3 you’d have to make a new board or overload the board with just more sections. Which while achievable makes a board extremely cluttered. One of my boards as an example on Star Wars, has 116 sections, due to the inability to put a section in a section.

reviews.t: This used to be my favorite app!
reviews.x: Like the title says, I absolutely loved the old Pinterest. The update last year maybe made it a whole lot harder to navigate. I was accustomed to searching for boards so that I could easily follow other people who shared my very specific interests, but now that option has been gone for months! I’ve been meaning to write this review since then, but this newest update from a few days ago expedited it. Another of my main issues is the shopping aspect. In the older versions, it was more geared to crafting/diy/budget ideas. Now, I search for something simple like knitting ideas, and all I get back are shopping suggestions and priced items for sale.
